jobs.title: E-Trading Application Support
jobs.description:
Location: NYC (Hybrid – at least 3 days onsite/week)

Visa Sponsorship: Talan does not sponsor U.S. work permits or employment visas.

The Credit Trading Application Support team provides production and application support for critical Credit Trading, Pricing, STP, and Risk platforms across both in-house and vendor applications, including ION, JAG, NEXUS, QuartzC, Lynx, Omega, ONCA Risk, Focus, Client Clearing, and E-TRAD.

The team acts as a key bridge between traders, Technology, Developers, Business Analysts, Infrastructure, and vendors, ensuring production stability, minimizing downtime, and supporting the full trade lifecycle across fixed income and credit products.

Responsibilities

• Provide L1/L2 production support for Fixed Income trading applications, ensuring platform stability and timely issue resolution.
• Monitor applications, perform troubleshooting, log analysis, and log scraping to identify and resolve production incidents.
• Support trading, pricing, risk, analytics, and booking workflows with a strong focus on the RFQ lifecycle.
• Manage Incident, Problem, and Change processes using ServiceNow and support releases and enhancements through JIRA.
• Collaborate closely with traders, developers, infrastructure teams, and vendors to resolve production issues and improve system reliability.
• Support platforms such as ION MarketView, Bloomberg, and MarketAxess while contributing to automation and operational efficiency initiatives.

• 5+ years of Application/Production Support experience within investment banking or capital markets.
• Strong knowledge of Fixed Income products, pricing, risk concepts, and the RFQ lifecycle.
• Experience supporting trading and risk applications; exposure to ION MarketView, Bloomberg, and MarketAxess is highly preferred.
• Strong troubleshooting skills with hands-on experience in production support, log analysis, and incident management.
• Knowledge of FIX Protocol, Linux/Windows environments, and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, and Geneos.
• Familiarity with SQL, Python, ServiceNow, and JIRA, combined with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Company’s Benefits

At Talan, we invest in our employees' well-being and empower them with benefits, including:

• 💵 Competitive salary between USD $105,000 - US$125,000
• 💸401(k) retirement plan with company matching
• 🌴15 days of paid vacation per year at hire and up to 27 according to seniority (annual untaken vacation days are cashed out)
• 📴8 paid holidays + 5 sick days + 2 personal days per year
• ❤️‍🩹Company health, dental, and vision insurance plans + FSA
• 🦺Voluntary STD and LTD
• 🚍 Commuter/transit benefits

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Animal Health & Pets Associate
jobs.description:
North 40 Outfitters in Lewiston, ID is looking to hire a Full-Time Animal Health & Pets Associate to join our team.  We believe that each team member plays a vital role in the success of our company.  We are looking for authentic and enthusiastic people who love our lifestyle and believe in service before self.  As a Animal Health & Pets Associate at North 40, you play a key role in the overall customer experience by providing outstanding customer service, generating sales and suggesting products, stocking and merchandising, maintaining a clean and organized department and safeguarding company assets.

This full-time position requires the ability to work all scheduled shifts between the business hours of Mon-Sat 7 am to 7 pm, and Sunday 9 am to 5 pm. This shift can include working weekends and certain holidays and will require flexibility in scheduling based on business needs.

• Willingness to share credit, work with others in a team environment, and define success collectively rather than individually
• Ability to take initiative, embrace change, and learn new things
• Drive to be dependable, and to perform well against the expectations of the role
• Ability to work independently or in a group setting
• Committed to supplying our North 40 guests with phenomenal customer service
• Good communication skills and the ability to effectively engage with individuals on a regular basis
• Must be able to multitask and prioritize
• Ability to work in a fast paced environment while remaining detailed and focused
• Working knowledge of small and large animals in areas of vaccines, feed and livestock equipment, equine and tack, and general animal health required
• Previous merchandising experience is helpful
• Ability to educate and assist customers on the brands that North 40 sells
• Understanding of correct lifting and loading techniques. Physical ability to lift and carry 0-15 lbs. continuously, 15-50 lbs. frequently, and 50-55 lbs. occasionally, and team lift anything over 55 lbs. Spending 100% of work time on your feet, including use of ladders, rolling staircases and pallet jacks.

BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive wage, a rewarding work environment, and generous benefits and perks such as paid holidays, a 401(k) option, Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a phenomenal employee discount on all products North 40 sells.

jobs.title: Lift Mechanic - Snowmass Mountain
jobs.description:
The Lift Mechanic is responsible for the maintenance and inspection of ski lifts and related equipment utilized in on-mountain operations. This is a technical position that requires learning all aspects of resort and mountain operations. This position reports to the Lift Maintenance Director.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until November 15th, 2026

Essential Job Functions

• Assist in scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of lifts and related equipment
• Assist in maintaining maintenance records
• Assist in lift operations, including operating ski lifts
• Being familiar with the location of ski lifts on the mountain
• Know how to turn on & operate the lift controls
• Run lift on auxiliary or evacuation diesels
• Manage maintenance tools and equipment
• Assist in daily preventative maintenance inspections
• Communicate effectively with co-workers & supervisors about maintenance issues
• Update maintenance procedures & maintain records
• Develop a working knowledge of the Colorado Passenger Tramway Safety Board (CPTSB) & American National Standards Institute (ANSI) codes pertaining to ski lifts
• Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience Requirements

• Must be 18 years or older
• High School diploma or equivalent preferred
• Valid, current, unrestricted driver’s license required
• Previous mechanical experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to communicate and follow oral or written directions in English is required
• Ability to communicate effectively with co-workers & supervisors
• Ability to work in collaboration with others to achieve team goals
• Ability to remain focused, organized, flexible, and detail-oriented
• Ability to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
• Follows all safety policies and procedures and exercises caution when working

Work environment and physical demands

• Ability to reach, crouch, kneel, stand, bend or be on your feet for extended periods of time
• Regularly work in wet, cold, hot conditions requiring the use of protective apparel/equipment to prevent exposure to the elements and may be required to walk on slippery and uneven surfaces
• Must be able to frequency lift, push or pull up to 50 lbs. individually or with assistance

jobs.title: Behavior Intervention Specialist (Non-Profit) - Queens
jobs.description:
AHRC NYC is looking to hire a Behavioral Intervention Specialist (BIS) for their Queens Adult Day Services program. The BIS provides behavior support services, diagnostic evaluation, and treatment services as a member of departmental or inter-departmental interdisciplinary teams.

Compensation Package: $62,000 per year....plus this position comes with a generous, low cost and comprehensive health Benefit package. See Benefit information below.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• After completion of Functional Assessment, develops individualized behavior support plans and staff intervention plans following required format for content and quality.
• Implements and monitors effective behavioral data tracking systems.
• Completes additional behavior health related plans and documents as needed.
• Provides training to staff on behavior treatment plans, and on topics/plans related to behavioral health.
• Completes assessment and Psychological Evaluations as needed.
• Engages individuals in individual and/or group treatment as needed.
• Coordinates psychological care and behavioral programs with families, medical providers, residential settings or other relevant stakeholders in the individual’s service provision.
• Provides crisis intervention, as well as instructs staff in appropriate techniques for addressing challenging behaviors.
• Attends interdisciplinary team meetings, as appropriate, providing input particularly on individuals with identified or emerging behavioral challenges.

• Conducts other related tasks as needed or required.

• Master’s degree in a clinical or treatment field of psychology, along with documented training in assessment techniques and behavioral support plan development, required.
• At least 2 years of experience working directly with individuals with developmental disabilities (including creating, implementing and monitoring behavioral support plans) and/or providing supervision and training to others in the implementation of behavioral support plans necessary.

• Strong and effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Demonstrated effectiveness in overseeing administrative tasks related to regulatory mandates and program service operations.
• Proven capacity to work productively in highly collaborative settings and to coordinate needs of multiple stakeholders.
• Flexibility to operate in a rapidly-changing work environment, with ability to adapt and be sensitive to organizational culture.
• Committed and collegial team worker.

• Demonstrable passion for the agency’s mission.

• Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Miami, FL.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers

To Apply:

• Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.

• Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).

• Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBCUniversal Telemundo Enterprises is a world-class media company leading the industry in the production and distribution of high-quality, Spanish-language content to U.S. Hispanics and audiences around the world. This fast-growing multiplatform portfolio is comprised of the Telemundo Network, Telemundo Deportes, Telemundo Global Studios, Universo, and a Digital Enterprises & Emerging Business unit. Telemundo Network features original Spanish-language entertainment, news and sports content. Telemundo Deportes is the designated Spanish-language home of two of the world’s most popular sporting events: FIFA World Cup™ through 2026 and the Summer Olympic Games through 2032. Telemundo Global Studios is the company’s domestic and international scripted production unit.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

• Telemundo News: delivers timely, accurate journalism focused on the stories and issues that matter to Hispanic audiences in the United States. The team covers breaking news, current events, politics, immigration, and other important topics through digital and social platforms. Its work combines news gathering, research, verification, and digital storytelling to keep audiences informed as stories develop.
• Telemundo Digital: creates and distributes content designed to engage audiences across Telemundo’s digital and social platforms. The team supports digital storytelling and audience growth by adapting content for how viewers discover, consume, and interact with media online. Interns gain exposure to the fast-paced digital media environment and how Telemundo connects with Hispanic audiences across platforms.
• Telemundo Research: tracks, analyzes, and reports on audience consumption across linear, streaming, digital, and social platforms. The team transforms audience data into insights that help inform programming, content, and broader business decisions across Telemundo. Its work provides a holistic view of audience behavior and content performance across the company's media platforms. The Telemundo Marketing team helps connect audiences with Telemundo's entertainment, news, sports, and digital content through strategic, audience-focused marketing. The team supports the development and execution of campaigns that strengthen the Telemundo brand and drive awareness and engagement across platforms. Interns gain exposure to how marketing strategy, creative development, audience insights, and cross-functional collaboration come together within a major Spanish-language media company.

Basic Requirements:

• Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

• Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).

• Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

• Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.

• Must be willing to work in Miami, FL.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

Desired Characteristics:

• Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.

• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Interest in Spanish-language media, news, digital content, marketing, audience insights, or entertainment.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, digital platforms, social media, or data visualization tools is a plus.

• Spanish-language proficiency is strongly preferred; some opportunities may require professional fluency in Spanish.

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. jobs.title: Accountant I
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accountant, General Accounting to join our

team. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end accounting operations across fixed

assets, capitalized software month-end close reporting, and SOX compliance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at tight close deadlines,

collaborates effectively with site managers and corporate reporting teams, and is able to travel

approximately one week per month.

Key Responsibilities:

Fixed Assets & Construction in Progress (CIP)

● Oversee corporate and site fixed asset accounting, ensuring timely recording of

additions, transfers, and disposals.

● Coordinate monthly with site managers and operational leaders regarding asset activity,

physical tagging, and system updates in Sage.

● Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations for fixed asset accounts and review AP

invoices to validate capitalization criteria.

● Maintain compliance with corporate Fixed Asset policies

Software Capitalization

● Manage the monthly Software in Progress (SIP) calculation and prepare Day 1 journal

entries.

● Track software development milestones, identifying completed projects ready for

capitalization and amortization under SOP 98-1.

● Reconcile SIP/SOP project balances against Authorization for Expenditure (AFE)

trackers.

● Coordinate asset setup in ERP systems (Sage) upon project completion.

Month-End Close & Corporate Reporting

● Execute core month-end close procedures under a structured schedule:

○ Prepare and post closing journal entries

○ Complete and upload statistical files and corporate schedules

○ Generate and distribute the monthly Trial Balance

● Prepare comprehensive balance sheet reconciliations

● Manage quarterly reporting deliverables, including Property, Plant & Equipment (PPE)

roll-forward

● Address Corporate Financial Reporting inquiries regarding deferred charges and other

balances

● Manage lease accounting adjustments

Internal Controls, SOX & Audit Support

● Execute key internal controls, including Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) testing

on key reports (e.g., Prophix) during the monthly close

● Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external audit requests, delivering PBC

(Prepared by Client) schedules and documentation

● Partner cross-functionally with outsourced service providers, Accounts Payable, and

FP&A to resolve reconciling items

Required Qualifications

● Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

● Experience: 1–2 years of progressive general ledger and general accounting

experience in a mid-to-large corporate environment.

● Technical Knowledge:

○ Strong working knowledge of US GAAP (specifically Fixed Assets, ASC 360, and

Software Capitalization / ASC 350-40).

○ Experience with SOX 404 compliance

● Systems & Software:

○ Experience with mid-to-tier-1 ERP systems (e.g., Sage, SAP, or Oracle).

○ Familiarity with financial consolidation systems (e.g., Oracle HFM / FCCS) and

reporting tools (e.g., Prophix).

○ Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP,

pivot tables, SUMIFS).

Key Competencies

● Time Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multi-day close calendars and hit

strict reporting deadlines.

● Collaboration & Communication: Skilled at working with non-financial site managers

and external service teams.

● Problem Solving: High level of ownership in researching variances, resolving AP/GL

discrepancies, and streamlining processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status.

If you require accommodations to view or apply for a job, alternative methods are available to submit an application. Please contact (440) 534-6000 or NA.TA.Operations@averydennison.com to discuss reasonable accommodations.

To maintain the integrity of our hiring process and protect our candidates from identity fraud, we require video and/or in-person interviews. As part of this verification, we may also ask you to take a brief photo. This image is used exclusively to ensure identity consistency and will be permanently deleted once the hiring process concludes.

jobs.title: Media Measurement Analyst (Contract-to-Hire)
jobs.description:
Vestcom is seeking a Media Measurement Analyst to drive in-store media performance analytics across key retail accounts. In this role, you will design test-vs-control evaluations and use SQL to dig deep into underlying POS data to determine exactly why a campaign worked or underperformed.

You will act as the analytical engine supporting our Data Strategy & Insights (DSI) client-facing and internal sales teams—equipping them with the reporting, dashboards, and diagnostic insights they need to deliver client recommendations. This role within the Data Strategy and Insights (DSI) team is ideally structured as a contract position, offering up to 40 hours per week with the potential for contract-to-hire. This role is ideally based in Cincinnati on a hybrid schedule of two days per week in the office, though we will consider fully remote work for highly qualified candidates. The standard schedule is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and the compensation is $35.00 to $40.00 per hour (W-2). This role does not provide visa sponsorship now or in the future.

• What this role IS: Hands-on SQL querying, executing test-vs-control (TvC) measurement, extracting POS data, and diagnosing the root causes behind campaign performance or designing optimal campaigns, to support internal stakeholders and clients; as well as general brand and category trends and insights.
• What this role IS NOT: Building predictive algorithms, machine learning modeling, data science modeling, architecture, engineering, machine learning, or platform design.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct test-vs-control performance analytics for in-store media programs across retail channels.
• Extract and analyze POS datasets using SQL to evaluate brand trends, determine campaign success factors, and optimize future media plans.
• Prepare results, dynamic reports, and dashboards to equip internal sales and client-facing DSI teams with clear, actionable insights.
• Support data integration initiatives, document technical requirements, and collaborate with technology and operations teams to improve analytical processes at scale.
• Translate complex quantitative findings clearly for internal technical and non-technical stakeholders across Vestcom’s solutions portfolio.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency with SQL for data extraction and querying, alongside experience in Tableau, Excel, and Google Workspace tools.
• Analytical Capability: Strong quantitative background with a proven ability to design TvC analyses, interpret performance metrics, and diagnose underlying data trends.
• Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner cross-functionally and effectively package insights for internal sales and client services teams.
• Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
• Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This role does not provide visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Experience

• 2+ years working in CPG, retail, or in-store media analytics environments.
• Direct exposure to value channel, drug, or grocery retail analytics (experience analyzing promotions in the value channel is a strong plus).
• Background in pricing, merchandising, promotional analysis, or marketing analytics.
• Prior involvement in data integration or operational process improvement projects.

jobs.title: Assistant Front Office Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Front Office Manager is responsible for supporting the overall management and daily operations of the Front Office Department. This position ensures the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining SLS LUX standards, brand standards, operational procedures, and financial objectives.

The Assistant Front Office Manager serves as a key leader and point of contact for guests and hotel departments, providing guidance and support to Front Office colleagues while fostering a culture of service excellence, accountability, empowerment, and teamwork.

DUTIES & FUNCTIONS

• Assist the Front Office Manager with the overall daily operation of the Front Office Department, including Front Desk, Guest Services, and VIP Services.
• Serve as a visible leader and primary point of contact for guests, colleagues, and other hotel departments, ensuring prompt resolution of guest needs and concerns.
• Plan, organize, facilitate, attend, and/or participate in hotel and departmental meetings as required.
• Ensure compliance with SLS LUX and brand standards, operating procedures, policies, and service expectations.

jobs.title: Safety, Health & Environment Site Officer II
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking Safety, Health & Environment Site Officer II for an onsite position based in Bloomfield, NJ. This position is expected to begin in February 2027.

The selected candidate will be responsible for implementing the requirements of AECOM’s Construction Manager’s (CM) EHS Management Plan (EHSMP) and Environmental Health and Safety Plan (EHASP) as well as support the CM in preparation of Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) in accordance with BEDC’s Standards.

jobs.title: Civil Inspector
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a highly talented Civil Inspector for construction inspection services to oversee the construction a new tunnel between the Kensico Reservoir and the Catskill/Delaware Ultraviolet Light Disinfection (CDUV) Facility for NYCDEP situated in Westchester County, New York.

The Civil Inspector is a full-time on-site role. The Inspector will conduct routine inspections of civil infrastructure, identifying defects and potential hazards, and documenting contract compliance.

The selected candidate will produce detailed reports and communicating findings to management. The Inspector will have the primary responsibility for assuring quality of the construction.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

• Observe Contractor’s construction activities. Accepts work completed in compliance with contract documents, rejects defective work, maintains log of rejected work, assists with resolution of construction issues.
• Coordinate with Contractor to identify upcoming work; verifies upcoming work against issued look ahead schedules.
• Review contract requirements, submittals, shop drawings, and other associated documentation.
• Communicate daily with the AECOM Resident Engineer in execution of his/her duties.
• Communicate daily with Contractor’s field team.
• Track progress of work in field. Monitors Contractor’s adherence to schedule and provides input on Contractor’s payment requests.
• Inspect work for conformance with contract documents, approved change orders, clarifications, etc.; identifies and reports all nonconforming work; documents all work with daily reports, photos and videos.
• Track and verifies Contractor time and material or force account work.
• Conduct inspections to ensure that the work is performed in compliance with the contract documents. Ensures delivered materials comply with approved submittals. Observes and approves Contractor’s testing and QA/QC activities.
• Maintain necessary project documentation, including daily, weekly, and monthly reports and logs. Prepares other required field documentation as necessary.
• Provide input for construction changes. Assist with preparation and negotiation of field orders and change orders.
• Observe implementation of health and safety procedures and practices.
• Perform other assignments as determined by AECOM Resident Engineer.
• Assist with coordination of contractor work activities with Plant Operations, with focus on civil and structural items coordination.
• Ensure the delivered materials and equipment is the correct product from approved vendors.
• Verification that the quality of the work is acceptable
• Witness and verifying the acceptability of all field testing.
• Track quantities installed on a daily basis.
• Prepare T&M reports as appropriate.
• Verify Contractor maintenance of As-Built drawings; confirm with Contractor that this is being carried out; review look-ahead schedules. Verification that work is in accordance with the approved shop drawing and sample Submittals.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• HS + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Demonstrated experience in construction inspector roles for heavy site civil infrastructure construction projects
• NICET Level IV Certified
• ACI Certified
• Concrete Field-Testing Technician Grade II
• Demonstrated ability to work in confined spaces and at heights
• OSHA 10-hour Construction Health and Safety Course
• Valid US Driver’s License
• As a condition of employment, candidates must pass a drug screening

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

• BA/BS in Engineering or related field
• OSHA 30-hour Construction Health and Safety Course
• NYCDEP 4-hr Scaffolding Training
• NYSDEC 4-hr Erosion and Sediment Control Training
• NYCDEP BEDC EHS Standards Training (4 Hour)

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician I - Water/Wastewater Treatment
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

A CDL-B is strongly preferred.

The Maintenance Technician I, inspects, maintains, repairs and installs mechanical, electromechanical, pneumatic and/or hydraulic equipment at plant and/or pump stations. Operate Centrifuge, Dump Truck, Sewer Cleaning Jet/Vac Equipment. Perform Maintenance and Operational Task with minimum oversight.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Operate the centrifuge and drive a 10 ton dump truck and sewer jet truck as well as lift station inspection and repairs.
• Performs routine and preventative maintenance, lubrication and minor adjustments on machines and related equipment which may include pumps, engines, centrifuges, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors, blowers, dryers, chemical feed and odor control, disinfection equipment, vacuum filters and belt presses. Promptly reports any operational problems with machines or equipment to Lead or Supervisor.
• Learns to inspect and becomes proficient at mechanical troubleshooting to determine repairs needed. Dismantles equipment to gain access to and repairs defective parts using hand tools, power tools and precision measuring and testing devices. Re-assembles and tests equipment ensuring safe and efficient operating conditions are restored. Learns to troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and electronic equipment and instrumentation.
• Performs facility maintenance and repair and may replace or install light bulbs, fluorescent tubes, damaged glass, windows, doors, partitions, ceiling or floor tiles, door locks, carpet, and/or paint.
• May perform manual labor including cleaning equipment, facilities and grounds as required and properly dispose of waste according to safety and environmental policies. Operates vehicles for plant operational purposes.
• Cover on call rotation for both the Water and Wastewater plants.
• Learn to estimate time and material costs for various projects. May assist in other areas of the plant as directed.

Work Environment:

• Spends 100% of the time in the operations environment.
• Typically spends 25 – 35% of time exposed to outdoor and sometimes inclement weather.
• Company service vehicles are used as required.
• Travels 1 – 2 times per year for company provided training.
• Serves rotational 24 hour emergency on-call.
• Possible Work Hazards: May be exposed to possible operations hazards including fumes, dust, toxic and caustic chemicals, noise, rotating machinery, high pressure and hot and cold temperatures, slippery surfaces, water and electrical hazards.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma or GED with the ability to read, write and comprehend English (operational, process, safety and quality instructions) and be able to carry out verbal and written instructions.
• Six months to two years of experience in a related position with ability to comprehend specifications, blueprints and manuals.
• Experience using power, pneumatic, hydraulic, and hand tools and shop tools such as drill press, band saw, bench grinder, and torque wrench preferred.
• Experience using material handling equipment, pressure gauges and precision measuring instruments.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
• Some vocational training and mechanical aptitude preferred, with the ability to read, interpret and record data from meters, gauges, scales, panels, computer consoles and other equipment.
• Must have ability to operate Computer Maintenance Management System (software).
• Must consistently demonstrate the ability to learn and independently perform assigned duties and meet or exceed production and quality goals.
• Must demonstrate ability to work in a team environment and willingness to assume additional or new responsibilities readily

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must possess, or be able to obtain within three months, a commercial license class B (CDL-B) with air brakes and tanker endorsement.
• Minimum water / wastewater license as required by regulatory agency at site - preferred
• Ability to be certified to perform public drinking water analysis within six months - required.
• Must possess a valid driver’s license and a safe driving record.
• Employee Orientation, Departmental Operating Procedures, Safety, Confined Space training, OSHA and Quality Training.
• HAZWOPER (Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response) Level I and II First Responder Certification if required by site.
• Must become proficient in the care and use of all site specific, facility required PPE (Personal Protection Equipment), including respirators, gas detectors, confined space equipment, etc.)
• Forklift Certification if required by site.
• Training in operation of mechanical drives, hydraulic pumps and valves, pneumatics, electronics and control systems.
• Obtain or maintain HVAC, Electrician, Plumber’s or other trade License if assigned to that area.
• Note: Tech will not perform duties unless properly licensed.
• Training in the use of energy management systems as needed.
• Works toward increasing skills in additional functional areas or in obtaining advanced skills / maintenance certifications.

Physical Requirements:

• Amount of time spent – Standing 25%, Walking 75% for as many as five miles per shift.
• Requires close visual and hearing observation to detect non-conformance and machine malfunction.
• Constantly uses hands to finger, handle or feel and frequently reaches with hands and arms.
• Works in various positions; works on ladders, catwalks, and supports at heights of 50 feet above the ground; and works with hands extended above and below head and body up to 40 minutes using hand tools weighing up to 15 pounds.
• Must be able to lift and carry 50 pounds (occasionally 60 pounds) distances of 10 feet.
• Occasional stooping, bending or kneeling and entering confined spaces.

In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Materials Development
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly innovative Materials Scientist with deep expertise in non-traditional solid-form strategies for beyond Rule-of-5 (bRo5) molecules, including PROTACs, RIPTACs, and molecular glues. This role will support the design of advanced solid form screening approaches, amorphous solid dispersion (ASD) formulations, predictive mathematical models.  The position is based in Groton, CT (USA).

Role Responsibilities:

• Conduct advanced solid-state characterization of large bRo5 molecules of pharmaceutical relevance.
• Apply novel crystallization techniques to recrystallize bRo5 molecules.
• Support multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate with colleagues to define and implement crystallization, polymorph, salt, and co-crystal screening activities according to project timelines.
• Collaborate with colleagues in Medicinal Chemistry, Formulation and Biopharmaceutics to define and implement screening and characterization strategies consistent with solid form selection for clinical studies.
• Solve scientific problems using contemporary Materials Science experimental techniques.
• Contribute to the development of new scientific approaches and knowledge within the Materials Science organization.
• Ensure contemporaneous and accurate entries are made in the electronic laboratory notebook system according to accepted good practice.

• Master’s Degree (MS) with 2+ years of experience in a related field.
• Strong pharmaceutical, API, small molecules testing for drug production is required
• Experience in pharmaceutical solid state characterization techniques (such as x-ray powder diffraction, polarized light microscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis, spectroscopy, etc.). Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
• Experience and understanding of infrared spectroscopy (FTIR, NIR, FT-Raman) and/or SSNMR.
• Experience with solving Materials Science problems related to large molecules, e.g., solid state chemistry and particle characterization using experimental approaches and team collaboration.
• Experience with amorphous solid dispersion strategies and ability to develop innovative solid form screening strategies.
• Understanding of physical, analytical, and organic chemistry.
• Good organizational skills, the ability to work independently, and excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
• Experience in mathematical modeling.

• The position is full-time, M- F 8 am to 5 pm
• May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs.
• Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CT are encouraged to apply.
• Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• #LI-EB1

jobs.title: Patient Care Tech-General Medicine 16E Part-time Nights
jobs.description:
The Patient Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Patient Care Technician’s primary function is to assist and support the Professional Registered Nurse in all aspects of direct and indirect patient care activities.  The Patient Care Technician functions as a member of the unit staff under the direction and supervision of the professional Registered Nurse.

Responsibilities:

• Direct Patient Care Activities Assists with admission, transfer, and discharge process.Takes and records temperature, pulse, respirations, weight for adults and/or neonates, height, and blood pressure.Measures and records intake and output including output from drains.Applies cardiac monitor/oximetry.Obtains EKG.Adheres to the infant security protocol (accurate assessment of band placement).Performs normal newborn hearing screening.Obtains capillary blood glucose for adults and/or neonates.Performs phlebotomy.Applies Fetal Monitor equipment on pregnant patients.Discontinues heplocks and foley catheters. Administers enemas.Collects specimens (urine, stool, blood and sputum) on adults and/or neonates. Makes rounds of patients and anticipates their needs and observes newborns in the nursery.Responds to patient call lights in a timely manner, especially emergency lights.Distributes fresh drinking water and nourishments to patients. Prepares patients for meals; assists or feeds patients as necessary. Feeds normal newborns as assigned.Provides morning care, bed baths and evening care according to established Nursing Care Procedures. Provides peri-care to appropriate patients.Provides newborn care to the infant including bath, dressing, obtaining foot prints, assistance with feeding (bottle and breast), glucose checks.Makes occupied and unoccupied beds.Ambulates patients and instructs on walker, cane and crutch walking as appropriate for assigned unit. Assists with pre-and post-operative care; positions patients as ordered; applies special equipment for safety; lifts and turns patients with proper and safe body mechanics and available resources.Applies comfort and safety measures (side rails and call lights). Sets up oxygen and suction equipment and other respiratory equipment for adults and/or neonates.Applies dressings to Stage I and Stage II skin breakdown. Prepares patient room for MD or RN assessment, evaluation, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Assists with procedures in the normal newborn nursery as directed.Transports patients, equipment and/or supplies during urgent and emergent situations and to front door on discharge.Responds to emergency situations, secures assistance and initiates basic life support.Reports observations and documents appropriately. jobs.title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Materials Scientist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly innovative Materials Scientist with deep expertise in non-traditional solid-form strategies for beyond Rule-of-5 (bRo5) molecules, including PROTACs, RIPTACs, and molecular glues. • Solve scientific problems using contemporary Materials Science experimental techniques.

• Experience with solving Materials Science problems related to large molecules, e.g., solid state chemistry and particle characterization using experimental approaches and team collaboration.
• Experience with amorphous solid dispersion strategies and ability to develop innovative solid form screening strategies.
• Understanding of physical, analytical, and organic chemistry.

Purpose

The Associate Director, Customs Valuation Compliance & Reporting, is a critical compliance role that actively partners across the enterprise and leads the operations and strategic design of the end-to-end customs valuation and reconciliation process.  Responsibilities include leading the financial planning and reporting of customs tariff impact to AbbVie’s imports (primarily focused on the Americas region) by conducting relevant variance analyses, scenario modeling and developing executive-ready reports; leading customs valuation initiatives in collaboration with stakeholders from other departments; and ensuring accuracy and predictability of tariff costs and other customs reporting metrics.

• Develop opportunities to utilize technology and enhance existing processes related to declaring and reporting final customs values through the reconciliation process
• Develop and manage the program governance and controls for key trade program strategies for AbbVie
• Primary SME on the review of contracts to determine potential customs valuation considerations (e.g., royalties)

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager — Nuclear Power Generation
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead delivery of complex projects in the nuclear power generation industry. This role is accountable for project success—including scope, safety, quality, financial performance, schedule, and client satisfaction—while also contributing to business development through a seller–doer model. The Senior Project Manager leads multi-disciplinary teams, manages nuclear quality and regulatory expectations, and partners with clients to identify and convert new work opportunities.

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

• Lead end-to-end delivery of nuclear power generation projects (e.g., plant modifications, life extension, uprates, new equipment integration, engineering studies, licensing support, outage support, and capital programs).
• Establish delivery approach, governance, and execution plans, aligning scope, deliverables, milestones, and acceptance criteria with client expectations.
• Direct multi-disciplinary teams (engineering, environmental, licensing, project controls, procurement support, construction/outage coordination as applicable) and manage subcontractors/vendors.
• Drive strong interface management across plant stakeholders (operations, maintenance, engineering, licensing, supply chain, and site leadership).
• Ensure effective closeout, lessons learned, and transition to operations where applicable.
• Maintain a strong nuclear safety culture and ensure work is planned and executed with appropriate rigor, conservative decision-making, and accountability.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and quality requirements (e.g., client QA programs. ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, NQA-1, configuration management, document control, records retention) as required by contract and project scope.
• Oversee technical reviews and verification/validation activities; ensure deliverables are complete, traceable, and audit-ready.
• Manage project risk, including nuclear safety, regulatory, schedule, and supply chain risks; implement mitigation plans and corrective actions as appropriate and relevant to AECOM’s scope.
• Own project financial performance: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, revenue recognition inputs, invoicing coordination, and margin outcomes.
• Lead schedule development and performance management, including resource loading and critical path awareness; drive recovery plans when needed.
• Control scope and change management: evaluate impacts, negotiate equitable adjustments, document approvals, and maintain contract compliance.
• Provide clear internal and client reporting (KPIs, earned value/progress, risk register status, and executive summaries).
• Serve as primary client interface and trusted advisor; maintain strong working relationships at multiple levels (PM, engineering managers, licensing, and site leadership).
• Proactively manage expectations, communicate progress and risks, and resolve issues early to protect nuclear safety, delivery outcomes, and client confidence.
• Facilitate decision-making through clear recommendations, option analysis, and documented action plans.
• Identify, qualify, and pursue follow-on work with existing nuclear clients and strategic accounts; support account planning and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the US nuclear strategy development
• Lead or support capture activities: client discovery, solution shaping, teaming, pricing strategy inputs, and risk/opportunity evaluation.
• Contribute to proposals and interviews: scope definition, execution approach, staffing plans, schedule basis, and technical narrative development.
• Maintain awareness of nuclear market trends (fleet life extension, digital modernization, reliability, carbon-free generation strategy, SMR/advanced reactor ecosystem where applicable) to support growth conversations.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
• 8 years of experience delivering projects in the nuclear power generation industry (utility, OEM, EPC/AE, or nuclear consultancy).
• Demonstrated success managing complex, high-stakes projects with accountability for scope, schedule, and budget.
• Experience and understanding of nuclear industry expectations related to safety culture, QA, configuration management, and document rigor.
• Proven client-facing leadership and experience supporting pursuits/proposals or expanding client scope.
• Ability to meet site access requirements (background checks, fitness-for-duty, security badging) when required by the client as a condition of ongoing employment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• PMP (or equivalent) and/or advanced technical degree.
• Familiarity with NQA-1 programs and/or regulated nuclear design environments; experience working under client 10 CFR 50 Appendix B programs (as applicable).
• Experience leading multi-office teams and managing subcontractors/suppliers in a regulated environment.
• Experience coordinating with field teams and supporting construction activities

• Sponsorship is not available for this role
• Relocation is not available for this role

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Procurement
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We are seeking a technical and product-minded Engineering Manager  to lead our Procurement engineering team and product through an exciting 1 → 100 growth phase.

Following 2.5 years of incubation, the Procurement product officially launched in August as the strategic wedge designed to push our broader Finance suite upmarket into the enterprise sector. Early traction has proven commercial viability: Procurement was instrumental in securing two of the top five largest deals in the Finance suite’s history, driving major enterprise contracts.

What you will do

• Manage and mentor: Directly lead, mentor, and coach a balanced 6-person full stack engineering team ranging from senior to early-career engineers.
• Drive product strategy & commercial viability: Partner closely with Product, Design, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership to define product direction, delivery roadmaps, and business alignment.
• Engineering leadership: Lead technical design and system trade-offs, evaluating buy vs. build options, platform leverage vs. custom components, and database structures while safeguarding the team against irreversible "one-way door" architecture decisions.
• Remain hands-on: Rippling managers are expected to be technical and stay close to the daily engineering execution by shipping and reviewing code and getting involved in high-stakes projects to ensure flawless delivery.
• Establish high-leverage processes: Implement scalable operational workflows that enable a lean engineering team to maximize output and drive outsized revenue impact.

What you will need

• Engineering leadership experience: Proven track record managing and developing full stack engineering teams within fast-paced, high-leverage software environments.

jobs.title: Cytotechnologist
jobs.description:
Basic Function and Scope of Responsibility:

The Cytotechnologist evaluates cytological samples using manual and/or automated microscopes to diagnose cell patterns on cytologic specimens including Pap smear, Non-gynecologic and FNA specimens.

Essential Job Duties:

• Perform essential functions as described in QCD defining Cytotechnologist requirements for a High Complexity Lab.
• Determines specimen adequacy for all cytology and histology samples.
• Examines and evaluates cell samples for normal cell patterns, non-malignant or benign conditions that might exist such as microorganisms, therapeutic change, inflammation, repair and hyperplastic changes and makes appropriate recommendations on the report.
• Examines and evaluates cell samples for the presence of abnormal cells.
• Determines severity and cell type of the abnormality and if needed, provides criteria to identify origin. Makes appropriate recommendations for the report.
• Uses recognized terminology to document and transmit the diagnosis/findings in the laboratory information system.
• Documents daily, weekly, and monthly workloads.
• Maintains legal limits for all types of microscopic work.
• Reviews cases at the microscope and discusses diagnostic criteria with pathologists, senior cytotechnologists and other cytotechnologists as needed.
• Identifies individual screening issues observed through quality control activities.
• Completes all procedures expected in the scheduled time without loss of work quality.
• Performs and documents daily, monthly, quarterly, & annual maintenance.
• Adheres to standard operating procedures, work instructions, and policies.
• Notifies management regarding trends, changes, or problems as they occur.
• Follows HIPAA regulations.
• Follows the College of American Pathologist (CAP) requirements for performing proficiency testing and reporting results.
• Receives a passing grade on any state/national exam deemed necessary to evaluate specimens.
• Participates in laboratory quality management functions.

Experience and Qualifications

• ASCP registration or eligible
• Successful completion of Thin Prep & Imager Training
• Pass the national cytology proficiency exam or equivalent
• Meet qualifications as described in CLIA 88’, 42 CFR Part 493 Cytotechnologist for Cytology Laboratories Performing High Complexity Testing.

Education

• BS or BA degree
• One year in an AMA approved Cytotechnology program or a 2+1 program.

Competencies

• Possess high standards for organization and quality.
• Knowledge of current medical terminology to perform various laboratory tests and to communicate with physicians, staff, and patients.
• Knowledge of laboratory equipment and testing to perform quality control checks and troubleshooting of instrumentation.
• Knowledge of safety requirements to provide instructions and to recognize hazardous conditions.
• Ability to read and understand information about instrumentation in the laboratory field.
• Ability to read, comprehend and create instructions, correspondence, reports and memos.
• Ability to interact and communicate with a variety of people, both on a one-on-one basis and in meetings and group presentations; must be able to relate to and work with ill, emotionally upset, and sometimes-hostile people. Ability to maintain confidentiality.
• Ability to anticipate and react calmly to emergency situations.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, decimals, compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
• Ability to follow direction and to apply common-sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
• Ability to think logically in order to troubleshoot, analyze situations, and make appropriate decisions.
• Proficient computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, e-mail systems, and web-based programs.
• Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

Other

• Ability to work in a fast-paced laboratory & office environment.
• Strong sensory skills, such as visual acuity, good hearing, and dexterity.
• Use of hand and wrist repetitive motion to position and operate microscope
• Ability to stand and sit for long periods of time in static position.
• Ability to occasionally push, pull, lift, move, and/or carry up to 3 lbs.
• Good speaking and listening skills.
• Ability to perform focused work with close attention to detail.
• Ability to operate office equipment, including computers, copiers, fax machines, and phones.
• Ability to interact with others, both in person and through phone, e-mail, and written correspondence.

Compensation:

What we offer:

• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.title: Customer Support Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly qualified, Customer Support Manager to lead the CTrides customer support center. This role will primarily be a remote position, with the caveat that training will be in person, and the team may be required to attend in person meetings and trainings in the office and the remote work is subject to change.

The role centers on three things: developing the team, controlling the quality of what customers get, and making the operation work better over time. The Customer Support Manager is accountable for the full customer experience, including training, quality, procedures, scheduling, and service improvement. The goal is a support operation that runs efficiently, meets project and customer expectations, and builds customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

The successful candidate will lead the Customer Support team and hold it to clear standards for service quality and accountability. The selected individual will be the point of contact for onboarding and ongoing training so staff know the policies, procedures, and systems and handle customers well.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

• Coach and mentor each team member through regular one-on-ones, performance feedback, and clear development goals. Use QA findings and performance data to decide where training and coaching are needed most.
• Prepare and lead team meetings, training sessions, performance reviews, and operational updates. Run a structured QA program that reviews a consistent sample of calls, emails, chats, web inquiries, and case documentation against defined service standards.
• Maintain the QA scorecard and standards and hold calibration sessions so reviewers score consistently. Review automated responses, including the AI agent and chat automation, and flag errors and gaps for correction.
• Track trends in QA scores, customer feedback, and performance metrics, and report findings to leadership. Use what QA turns up to fix problems, whether that means coaching someone, updating training, or correcting the knowledge base.
• Work with the Program Director to identify ways to improve support tools, workflows, and automated customer responses, and help set priorities for changes. Give input and help test during system changes and rollouts, and train staff on what’s different afterward.
• Own the content of the knowledge base, standard operating procedures, job aids, FAQs, and training materials, and keep it accurate and current. Monitor how the AI agent and chat automation perform with customers and identify where they fall short.
• Use Zendesk, databases, reporting tools, and standard office software to track service levels, workload, and quality results. Build a strong understanding of Connecticut transportation programs, services, routes, schedules, and mobility resources. Make sure staff know CTrides policies, practices, and service standards, including how to handle service alerts and disruptions.
• Work with transportation providers, partners, and stakeholders to gather, verify, and keep current route, schedule, and service information. Take ownership of escalated and complex customer issues, see them through to resolution, and communicate outcomes clearly to customers and stakeholders.
• Support representatives with day-to-day challenges. Provide accurate, courteous support by phone, email, web platforms, and other channels, and step in as a representative when needed.
• Build and maintain team schedules with enough staffing to cover service.
• Manage workload and resources, and monitor attendance, time-off requests, and schedule changes to protect service levels. Keep accurate records of customer interactions, resolutions, quality reviews, and departmental activity.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• BA/BS + 6 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Valid U.S Driver's License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM's Motor Vehicle Records Review

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 6 years of customer service experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role leading a customer support team
• Experience helping improve support tools, workflows, or knowledge content
• Demonstrated experience training, coaching, and developing staff, including running onboarding programs
• Demonstrated experience running QA reviews and using the results to improve coaching and processes
• Experience with customer support platforms such as Zendesk or similar ticketing and case management systems
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
• Proven experience using management methods and techniques
• Familiarity with AI agents or chat automation in a customer service setting.
• Awareness of current customer service technology, trends, and applications

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position
• Relocation assistance is not available
• Primarily weekday hours. Some weekend work required to support service coverage, QA, and training
• Primarily a general office environment, with occasional travel to project or client sites
• Ability to lift up to 30 lbs

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Distribution & Partnership Marketing (IVD)
jobs.description:
The Senior Marketing Manager, Distribution & Partnership Marketing (IVD) is responsible for developing and executing commercial marketing strategies that accelerate growth for LGC’s Diagnostics & Genomics portfolio through strategic partnerships, distribution channels, laboratory networks and regional commercial teams. The role translates global product and portfolio priorities into partner-ready value propositions, campaigns, sales enablement tools, and measurable demand generation programs. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Quality, Digital Marketing, and external partners, this position supports market expansion, adoption, revenue growth, and consistent customer experience across channel and alliance routes to market.

Strategic Partner and Alliance Marketing

• Lead co-marketing plans and joint commercial initiatives with strategic IVD platform providers, laboratory networks, pharma sponsors, distributors, and other priority B2B partners.

• Translate global product, portfolio, and brand strategies into partner-specific messaging that communicates clinical, operational, and economic value to diagnostic and laboratory customers.

• Develop partner enablement materials, sales presentations, campaign toolkits, launch assets, and technical crosswalk content to support effective field execution and customer onboarding.

• Own day-to-day marketing communications with priority partners, supporting business reviews, performance reporting, action tracking, and escalation of commercial marketing requirements.

Distribution and Channel Optimization

• Develop and deploy regional channel marketing strategies that strengthen distributor engagement, customer adoption, share of voice, and commercial pull-through while maintaining alignment with the LGC D&G brand architecture.

• Support key sales accounts and distribution networks with trade marketing programs, product positioning, campaign assets, launch support, and category or segment-specific initiatives.

• Build multi-channel demand generation and account-based marketing programs tailored to laboratory segments, pathology networks, channel partners, and priority customer groups.

• Monitor market, channel, and customer insights to identify opportunities for growth, retention, cross-sell, and improved customer journey execution.

Cross-Functional Leadership, Governance and Performance

• Lead through influence across a matrix environment, partnering with commercial, product, digital, medical, regulatory, legal, quality, supply chain, and regional teams to align priorities and execute programs effectively.

• Ensure promotional materials, partner programs, and campaign activities are developed in accordance with applicable healthcare, regulatory, quality, and compliance requirements.

• Define and track key performance indicators for partner and channel marketing programs, including campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, adoption metrics, and return on investment.

• Prepare concise performance updates, insights, and recommendations for marketing leadership and relevant commercial stakeholders.

• Identify process improvements, governance opportunities, and reusable templates that improve speed, consistency, compliance, and customer impact across partner and channel marketing activity.

Essential Knowledge and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Biochemistry, Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
• Significant progressive experience in commercial marketing, channel marketing, product marketing, alliance marketing, or demand generation within IVD, laboratory diagnostics, life sciences, medical technology, healthcare, or another complex B2B environment.
• Demonstrated ability to translate scientific, technical, and commercial information into clear value propositions, partner messaging, and customer-facing marketing assets.
• Experience developing campaign plans, sales enablement materials, launch support, account-based marketing programs, and performance reporting for commercial stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of regulated marketing environments and the importance of quality, legal, regulatory, and brand governance in customer-facing communications.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, or project management tools is advantageous.

Desired Knowledge and Qualifications

• Advanced degree, MBA, or additional commercial, marketing, life sciences, or diagnostics qualification.
• Experience working with distributors, strategic alliances, channel partners, laboratory networks, pharma sponsors, or platform providers.
• Knowledge of immunoassay workflows, molecular testing, clinical biochemistry, core laboratory diagnostics, quality assurance applications, or adjacent diagnostic markets.
• Experience using Salesforce, Pardot/MCAE, HubSpot, Power BI, Asana, or similar commercial, marketing, analytics, or project management platforms.
• Strong business acumen, including segmentation, pipeline development, forecasting, pricing considerations, and campaign ROI measurement.

Behavioral and Interpersonal Competencies

• Operates in line with LGC’s values of Passion, Curiosity, Integrity, Brilliance, and Respect.
• Highly collaborative and able to influence stakeholders across functions, regions, seniority levels, and external partner organizations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for commercial and customer-facing audiences.
• Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities, campaigns, partners, and approval routes in a dynamic environment.
• Analytical and performance-oriented, with the ability to interpret data, identify insights, and make practical recommendations.
• Customer-focused, commercially aware, and committed to improving partner experience, field readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

Willingness to travel both nationally and internationally at least 40%

jobs.title: R&D Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Summary

The R&D Laboratory Technician is responsible for providing support to the Research and Development (R&D) department by performing a variety of laboratory procedures of technical nature. These procedures include, but are not limited to, gathering, and preparing samples and substances for analysis; maintaining laboratory inventory; handling sensitive equipment to analyze samples or substances; collecting and analyzing data; and reporting findings to a Project Manager. The R&D Lab Tech will work with potentially hazardous materials such as pathogens or chemicals and is well-trained to maintain safe laboratory conditions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Gather and prepare samples and substances for laboratory testing and analysis
• Maintain laboratory inventory of samples, reagents, and other related laboratory supplies
• Ensure that all safety guidelines are followed at all times and maintain a clean and orderly environment
• Maintain and operate sophisticated laboratory equipment
• Conduct experiments using sound scientific methods to verify/reject various types of hypotheses
• Run both manual and automated assays (ELISA, Western Blot, and others) to produce reliable and precise data
• Clearly document work, including procedures, observations, and results
• Effectively communicate results of experiments and/or assays to others

Non-Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Set-up, maintain, and clean laboratory instruments and equipment
• When time permits, provide assistance to Validation Specialists and aide in the kit assembly process

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Biological Science, Chemistry, or a related field required
• 1-2 years of previous work experience in a similar position preferred
• Previous ELISA and/or Western Blot testing experience preferred

Computer Skills

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
• Internet Explorer, Google Chrome, or Mozilla Firefox
• Must be willing and able to learn other software programs as needed

Knowledge, Skills, and Other Abilities

• General Laboratory knowledge (use of equipment; pipetting; personal safety, general lab practices)
• Must have strong attention to detail
• Must be able to work both autonomously and as a member of a team
• Ability to comprehend scientific materials and instructions
• Preferred understanding of statistical methods and probability

jobs.title: RN (F/T) Group Home - Queens
jobs.description:
AHRC NYC is looking for a Full-Time Registered Nurse (RN) to oversee multiple Group Home residences in Queens. The RN's will evaluate and monitor health and safety needs of individuals with developmental disabilities to promote wellness. Ensure that these services are in compliance with all federal and state regulations as well as agency policy

Compensation Package: $95,000 per year plus a very generous and comprehensive Benefit package. See Benefit information below.

Schedule: Monday- Friday 9am-5pm....35 hours per week.

Locations: Queens 11366, 11361, 11367, 11106

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinate medical care for assigned individuals, monitor and assess health needs including arranging for follow-up care as needed.

Assessment by direct observation on consumer health status. Observe observation for signs and symptoms of discomfort, distress or illnesses. Evaluation of physical status changes for exacerbation of existing conditions, onset of disease, and/or responses to care and treatment. Documentation and follow up of all findings.

Communicate with physicians, families, interdisciplinary team members and clinicians involved in providing services to individuals.

Communicate and follow up on consumer hospitalizations, emergency room visits, reports of injury, trauma, accidents, illness, distress and other health issues as individually required.

Accompany individuals on medical appointments when necessary to advocate for and discus health issues. Communicate with team members as to findings.

In urgent/emergent situations, the nurse may receive phone calls outside of routine working hours regarding individuals assigned to that nurse's caseload.

Attend meetings with management, staff, families and clinicians to discuss any health related issues regarding consumers served.

Develop individual specific nursing plans and protocols as needed. Update and revise these documents to reflect changes in consumer status.

Supervises AMAP administration of prescribed medication and routine treatments in accordance with federal and state regulations and agency policy. Administers STAT medication and treatments as prescribed. Participates in in-services and trains AMAPs as needed. Completed AMAP certification, recertification and decertification processes as necessary.

Regularly reviews medication administration records (MARs), treatment and adaptive equipment records, logs documenting vital signs, elimination, glucose readings, weight, menses, and other records as individually specified. Reports significant issues to appropriate clinicians and team members, including need for ordering medications, renewing or updating prescription orders and individual specific drug information sheets. Monitor and manage medication storage and disposal procedures in accordance with federal and state law.

Develop and monitor health goals, nursing plans and protocols that are individual specific. Review, update and revise these documents to ensure they are reflective of current consumer status.

Monitor consumer dietary and nutritional needs. In-service and support staff in managing special meal and feeding of individuals served. Observe meal times for appropriate food choices, portions, use of adaptive utensils, etc.

Participate in the -re-admission intake review with preparation of a preliminary plan based on available health records.

Participate in discharge planning meetings, including writing recommendations for referrals to other agencies and follow up on plan of care.

Write individual progress notes, annual nursing assessments/summaries for each individual. Submit for physician's review and signature as needed.

Ensure that referrals are made for routine and special medical services, and follows up afterwards to ensure that recommendations and orders are appropriately carried out and managed.

In compliance with OSHA mandates, monitors infection control, environmental changes and ensures that all guidelines regarding universal precautions are appropriately followed. Order and maintain necessary first aid and medical supplies as needed.

Review Incident and Medication Error Reports. Provide appropriate follow up action as necessary.

Participate in program clinical review and other means of evaluation to assure continuous improvement in the quality of care provided for individuals served.

• Must be currently licensed as a registered professional nurse (RN) in New York State.
• CPR certification required.
• Experience working with consumers with developmental disabilities preferred.
• Must demonstrate excellent written and oral communication skills.
• Ability to handle multiple priorities and work as a member of a team.
• A valid NY State or Tri-state area Driver's License for more than one year, in good standing, Preferred.
