jobs.title: Associate Director, Global Sales Support
jobs.description:
Taylor & Francis is seeking an experienced operations leader to take ownership of global sales support services across all regions. As Associate Director, Global Sales Support, you will be accountable for building a consistent, efficient, and well-controlled quote-to-invoice process, driving data accuracy across regional commercial records, and preparing our support function for readiness under the new Unified Commercial (UC) model. You will lead the four Regional Sales Operations Managers and, through them, the regional support teams who keep our commercial engine running smoothly every day.

This is a pivotal leadership role sitting within Commercial Strategy & Operations, working as a peer to the Global Sales Operations Lead and the Global Systems & Data Lead to ensure our sales support infrastructure scales with the business.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Service Delivery & People Leadership

• Lead and develop the four Regional Sales Support Managers, setting shared objectives, capacity priorities, performance standards, and development plans.
• Define service levels and establish a regular operating cadence covering backlog management, turnaround times, quality, escalations, and process adherence.
• Harmonize processes globally while accommodating documented local requirements, and scale best practices across regions.
• Manage cross-regional escalations and provide strong support to Sales and Inside Sales teams, without assuming ownership of the Inside Sales function itself.

Quote-to-Invoice & Commercial Transaction Execution

• Own the sales-support operating process from quote preparation and approval through to accurate order and invoicing handoffs, working closely with Finance and order-management owners to agree clear boundaries.
• Ensure commercial terms, customer details, and approved pricing/discount conditions are captured correctly, applying rules set by the Global Pricing Director and escalating exceptions as needed.
• Reduce rework and errors at transaction handoffs by defining clear controls, ownership, and resolution paths for common issues.
• Translate changes arising from the UC model into standardized workflows, training needs, and operational acceptance criteria.

Data Capture & Operational Controls

• Own the timeliness, completeness, and accuracy of information entered by regional teams into account, opportunity, and other commercial records.
• Implement front-line validation, exception handling, and remediation routines, aligned with data definitions and standards owned by Systems & Data.
• Ensure data captured at source properly supports forecasting, invoicing, reporting, and incentive calculations, resolving regional input issues promptly.

Partnership & Continuous Improvement

• Partner with Sales Operations on forecast inputs, deal status, territory changes, and recurring data defects.
• Work with Systems & Data to specify usability needs, test process changes, and manage adoption (while Technology retains technical build ownership).
• Collaborate with Global Enablement to maintain practical instructions, playbooks, and training materials for regional support users.

Decision Rights & Role Boundaries

• Sales Support owns frontline data entry and transaction execution; Systems & Data owns data structures, standards, and CRM business governance.
• Sales Operations owns forecasts, performance metrics, and incentive reporting; Sales Support supplies correct and timely regional inputs.
• Pricing owns price and discount policy; Finance and billing functions retain their designated accounting, invoicing, and cash-control responsibilities.
• Inside Sales remains a separate commercial sales capability unless an explicit reporting-line decision changes this.

What Success Looks Like:

• Consistent quote-to-invoice workflows with documented exceptions across all regions.
• Agreed service levels consistently met, with visible improvement in turnaround time, backlog reduction, and first-time-right processing.
• Measurable improvement in the completeness and accuracy of commercial data at the point of entry.
• The four Regional Sales Operations Managers operating with clear accountabilities, resource plans, and performance routines.
• UC process changes implemented smoothly, with a stable support service and minimal disruption.

What We're Looking For:

Experience & Knowledge

• Proven multi-region people leadership and change management capability.
• Strong understanding of quote-to-invoice and institutional/subscription sales processes.
• Experience in service operations, capacity planning, and process standardization.
• Working knowledge of CRM systems and a strong commercial data discipline.
• Excellent judgment, escalation management skills, and confident stakeholder communication.

Relevant Experience

• Proven experience in sales support, sales operations, or commercial operations.
• Demonstrated experience leading managers or distributed teams.
• A track record of setting service levels and standardizing processes across multiple regions or units.
• Experience with institutional, academic, subscription, journals, or eBook business models, along with system transitions, is highly desirable.

Key Working Relationships

Regional Sales Leaders; Finance; Global Pricing; Commercial Strategy; Global Enablement; Technology; and the other two Commercial Operations leads - all with clearly defined ownership and escalation paths

Closing date: Monday 23rd November 2026

Applications are shortlisted on a rolling basis. We therefore encourage you to apply at the earliest opportunity.

You must have the right to reside and work in the United States.

Location: We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely. The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of the Philadelphia office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location 3 days per week.

What we offer in return:

• Annual salary of circa $100,000- $120,000 USD + bonusSalary commensurate with experience
• 15 paid vacation days
• 10 paid sick days
• 2 paid floating holidays
• Paid parental leave
• Paid leave for life events; i.e. wedding or moving
• Medical, dental, & vision benefits
• 4 paid volunteering days per year
• Paid day off for your birthday
• 401(k) match
• Flexible working schedule
• Seasonal social and charitable events
• Training and developmentWe’re passionate about ensuring you have all the tools and resources at your fingertips to reach your short and long-term career goals. We’ll support you in your journey by working together on your own bespoke Taylor & Francis Development Plan, ensuring you have the resources, tools, support and coaching that will get you where you want to be.

If you’re excited about working with Taylor & Francis to foster human progress through knowledge, we invite you to apply even if your existing skills and experience don’t fit every item listed above. At Taylor & Francis, we are at our best and most successful when colleagues can be themselves and make a contribution regardless of their identity or background. As a colleague, you will have the opportunity to further innovate and develop in areas that you are passionate about. Our goal is to empower you with the resources, incentives, and flexibility you need to enjoy success at work and to live a healthy, balanced life.

Taylor & Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in and value diversity of people and thought, fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where all colleagues can learn and succeed as their true selves. Taylor & Francis recruits, develops, and retains colleagues without regard to any protected personal characteristics or other non-merit based factor.

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

jobs.title: Treasury & Cash Management Analyst
jobs.description:
Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top-tier trading experience.

About The Role & Team

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly motivated Treasury & Cash Management Analyst to join our finance team. This role will support the firm's daily cash management, banking operations, settlement funding, and treasury reporting activities. The analyst will work closely with treasury, finance, operations, and banking partners to help ensure the accurate movement, monitoring, and reconciliation of cash across the organization.

This position provides an excellent opportunity to develop treasury and brokerage finance expertise while gaining exposure to regulatory funding requirements, cash management processes, and financial operations within a fast-paced financial services environment.

In This Role, You Will

• Cash Management & Treasury Operations
• Prepare daily cash position reports across corporate, customer, and settlement accounts.Monitor daily cash balances and support funding activities across bank accounts.Assist with wire transfers, ACH transactions, and other cash movement activities.Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to ensure timely settlement and funding activities.

• Reporting & Analysis

The Skills You Bring

Why Webull?

Webull is more than a fintech company—we’re a global community of innovators, collaborators, and trailblazers. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL, Webull operates in 16 regions worldwide, serving over 20 million users. At Webull, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work makes a real impact.

Investing in our people is a top priority for us, which is why we have a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: 100% paid medical and dental insurance for employees and dependents, vision insurance, and more!
• Financial Support: 401(k) match, commuter benefits for NY positions, and short-term disability coverage.
• Work-Life Balance: Generous time off that increases with tenure, paid parental leave, personal days, sick time, volunteer days and company holidays.

jobs.title: Market Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Market and Implementation Specialist at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.



Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Experience coordinating launches, projects, or rollouts from planning through go-live.

 - A track record of keeping multiple moving pieces on track without things slipping through the cracks.

 - Experience building or following readiness checklists, project plans, or similar structured processes.

 - Fluent in project management systems, such as Notion, Monday.com http://Monday.com or AI-based tools to manage projects effectively.

 - Comfort being the point of contact across several teams at once.

 - Comfortable in building simple and easily digestible training manuals and SOPs.

 - A proactive communicator who flags risk early rather than waiting to be asked.

 - Detail-oriented and organized, but able to move fast when a launch timeline is tight.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE

This role sits within our Implementation team, reporting to the Implementation Manager. You'll own the operational coordination of every new market and Imaging Center (IC) launch, acting as the connective tissue between Implementation and the functional teams being launched. Early on, your priority is learning the current implementation process end-to-end and successfully coordinating at least one launch from kickoff through stabilization.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

 - Own the market and/or Imaging Center (IC) implementation coordination process, from kickoff through go-live and early stabilization for the operations teams.

 - Build and maintain readiness checklists and go/no-go criteria for every launch.

 - Act as the operational point of contact between Implementation and the teams being launched.

 - Track launch timelines closely, flag risks and blockers early, and escalate before they become delays.

 - Coordinate with Trainers, QA, and WFM to confirm training, quality monitoring, and staffing plans are in place before go-live.

 - Run or support go-live day logistics, troubleshooting issues in real time.

 - Maintain clear, up-to-date launch status reporting for leadership visibility.

 - Document lessons learned after every launch and help turn them into playbook updates.
   
   


AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.

Tier 2 — AI-Amplified

For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data.

 - AI is part of your daily default. You use it to draft, analyse, research, and pressure-test your own thinking.

 - You can show concrete examples where AI made your work meaningfully faster or better.

 - You know its failure modes: you check its work, and you don't paste sensitive data into public tools.

Assessment: we'll ask you to walk through how you'd use AI to tackle a real task from the role.

One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.




A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.




HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.

 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!
    
    


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $80,000 - $90,000

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget

 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage

 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401k retirement plan

 - All the equipment you need to do your best work

 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

 - Atlanta office perks: Complimentary team lunch every Wednesday, on-site gym access, roof terrace, and on-site lunch options




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:

The Neurodiagnostic Advanced Analyst reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Advanced LTM Analyst is independent and proficient in the performance and training of all duties and responsibilities for LTM/ICU/EMU/cEEG monitoring and may act as the physician extender in collaboration with the supervising physician and other healthcare staff.

Responsibilities:

• Performs Neurodiagnostic review for noninvasive and invasive EMU studies/ICU Video EEG/cortical mapping/Ambulatory EEG/routine EEG and EEG during PET/Wada/Tilt table procedures according to facility/department policy and procedures
• Responsible for daily scanning, documentation and annotation of ictal, interictal and paroxysmal events

• Review and interpret Quantitative EEG and post processing of EEG
• Extensive knowledge of medication and its effects on EEG waveforms and patterns is required
• Is relied on to act as department educator
• Maintains continuing education requirements of ABRET for CLTM* by reviewing current literature and attending continuing education meetings and seminars
• All other related duties that are consistent with patient and technical care for this level
• Collaborate with Physicians and Education Coordinator to plan educational lectures/case studies/CEU courses
• Assists with teaching EEG monitoring of fellows and residents rotating in the department
• Develop and maintain relationships with END programs
• Review continuous/prolonged EEGs for appropriate start and stop times in the Nihon Kohden Database and in Epic
• Perform audits of EEG annotation and Epic documentation for quality assurance and accreditation submission

• Additional FunctionsProvide administrative coverage in other areas of NTC as necessaryParticipate in departmental in-services, monthly staff meetings, and continuing educationProvide consistent feedback and suggestions for improvement to NTC Resource Coordinator and/or Manager, and be involved in improvement initiatives/projects.Provide written and/or verbal feedback to NTC Medical Director, Coordinator and/or Manager on Neurodiagnostic Technicians and/or student preceptor's performance
• Quality Management Responsibilities:Participates in organizational and departmental quality improvement activities.Serves as a role model for others in terms of quality of work and self-improvement.Provides ideas and suggestions for process improvements within the department.

This position is full-time, 80 hours per pay period, day shift, weekday position with possible weekends.

Required:

• Registered in both through the American Board of Registration of Electroenephalographic and Evoked Potential technologists (ABRET) as an EEG Technologist (R.EEG T.) and Continuous Long Term Video Monitoring (CLTM)
• Eligible to sit for NeuroAnalyst-CLTM Exam through ABRET and month obtain within 12 months
• At least 7 years of experience working in Neurodiagnostics
• CPR certified in basic cardiac life support (BLS) through the American Heart Association (AHA)
• Performance in each of the multiple modalities at the level or superior to a technologist registered in that modality
• Associates Degree or higher

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.

Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front.

Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur.

Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.

Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre.



Ce que tu vas faire chez nous

 - Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production.

 - Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler.

 - PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité.

 - Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes.

 - Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs.

 - Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi.

Ce qui t'attend techniquement

 - Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo

 - Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry

 - Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour



Profil recherché

 - 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs.

 - Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps.

 - Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run.

 - Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework.

 - Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion.

 - Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique.

 - Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite.

 - Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs.



Processus de recrutement

 - Echange RH

 - Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe

 - Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO

 - Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs

 - Prise de référence et offre



Conditions

 - Salaire: 50-65 k€ selon expérience

 - Télétravail: full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie)

jobs.title: General Manager, Subscription Business
jobs.description:
About Us:

Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental, or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

About the Job:

As the General Manager (GM) of Subscription, you will lead and accelerate the growth of RTR’s core membership business, the subscription that gives customers ongoing access to our shared closet. Members choose their plan, rotate styles through the month, and can pause or change their plan as their lives change. This role gives you a meaningful opportunity to serve millions of women over time and shape the experience that keeps them coming back.

As a GM, you will have P&L responsibility over this core revenue stream for RTR and will be responsible for setting the vision, driving an aggressive growth strategy, and executing against a comprehensive roadmap to unlock the next phase of growth for Subscription.

You will operate at the intersection of acquisition, retention, product, merchandising, pricing, inventory, and operations, leading a cross-functional team to deliver a best-in-class member experience and strong financial performance. This is an ideal role for a strategic, data-driven operator who can move seamlessly between vision and execution, and is excited to scale a consumer-facing membership business.

This is a full-time role reporting to one of RTR’s Executive team members overseeing Commercial Revenue and will be part of the company’s extended leadership team.

Responsibilities:

• Own the Subscription Business (GM + P&L Ownership): Own the P&L for the Subscription business, including revenue growth, contribution margin, and cost structure. Define and execute a strategy to scale membership, including new growth levers, member segments, and plan options. Establish clear KPIs and performance dashboards to measure success.

• Drive Member Acquisition & Growth: In partnership with Marketing, drive new member acquisition across paid, organic, affiliate, and partner channels, with a focus on efficient customer acquisition cost and payback. Build the measurement and attribution approach that tells us where growth is coming from and where to invest.

• Lead Retention, Pausing & Lifecycle: Reduce churn and improve member lifetime value through lifecycle marketing, personalized recommendations, loyalty program optimization, and proactive engagement. Design and test offers and plan changes that keep members active without eroding margin.

• Optimize Pricing, Promotions & Add-On Revenue: Set the framework for membership pricing, promotional depth, and add-on revenue, balancing acquisition, retention, and margin. Maximize traffic, conversion, and revenue per member.

• Guide Product & Technology Roadmap: Define and prioritize the subscription product roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering. Build and ship features that create a seamless, frictionless, and delightful end-to-end shopping experience, including UX from discovery and onboarding through personalization, conversion, and self-serve member management.

• Optimize Assortment & Inventory for Members: Partner with Buying, Site Merchandising, and Inventory teams to curate assortment that keeps members engaged and drives improvements in inventory utilization, availability, and new-unit efficiency.

• Improve Operations & Fulfillment: Partner with Operations to ensure a reliable shipping, returns, and reverse logistics experience that supports the monthly membership rhythm.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead a cross-functional team spanning product, engineering, merchandising, marketing, and operations while serving as the central point of accountability for Subscription performance. Present regular business updates, insights, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

(Our AI Agents team builds the agent platform; you make it real across the stack.) Director, Security Compliance
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

The Director, Security Compliance will lead CLEAR’s security certification portfolio, helping earn the trust of travelers, enterprise customers, and government partners. You’ll move compliance from document-heavy processes to evidence-backed systems across CLEAR’s commercial and federal products and the Enterprise.

What you'll do:

• Lead CLEAR’s certification and assurance portfolio, including FedRAMP Rev. 5, TSA programs, SOC 2, PCI, SOX IT controls, and customer frameworks; build trusted relationships with auditors, assessors, and customers.

• Translate requirements into reusable, testable controls, mapping each control across applicable frameworks and defining what it must achieve and what evidence demonstrates it.

• Partner with Engineering and other technical teams to embed evidence and control requirements into systems and platforms at design time; use sound judgment to assess evidence and resolve disagreements.

• Set the direction for CLEAR’s compliance platform and infrastructure, defining the capabilities and workflows needed by compliance, engineering, and other users.

• Keep external security claims accurate and evidence-backed; lead customer security responses and help the team use AI responsibly, with human review of claims and outputs.

• Work with the business and cross-functional partners to align where necessary when new regulations are required to enter new markets.

How you'll measure success:

• The compliance program not only satisfies audit requirements but ties into the maturity of CLEAR’s security program and risk management.

• Certification and assessment milestones are completed on schedule, with continuous readiness maintained across the portfolio.

• Control evidence is complete, current, reusable across frameworks, and available to support audits and assessments.

• Audit findings and control gaps are tracked through resolution within agreed timelines.

• Customer security questions and framework requests are answered accurately and within agreed service levels.

What you're great at:

• 10+ years of experience in security compliance, audit, or GRC, including team leadership.

• Direct FedRAMP experience and the credibility to work effectively with assessors and auditors.

• Working fluency in cloud environments and technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, APIs, and infrastructure as code; able to interpret a Terraform plan or Kubernetes policy and explain what it demonstrates to technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Experience designing controls that auditors relied on and owning a modern GRC platform, modernizing a multi-framework program, or applying AI to compliance work.

• A record of leading change and communicating clearly with executives, engineers, customers, and cross-functional partners.

How You'll be Rewarded:

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you’re at your best, we’re at our best. You’ll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well-being and learning & development with stipends and reimbursement programs.

We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base salary range for this role is $225,000 - $275,000, depending on levels of skills and experience.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of CLEAR’s salary range for this position. Salaries will vary depending on various factors which include, but are not limited to location, education, skills, experience and performance. The range listed is just one component of CLEAR’s total compensation package for employees and other rewards may include annual bonuses, commission, Restricted Stock Units.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

CLEAR provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities or protected needs. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include, but are not limited to, time off, extra breaks, making a change to the application process or work procedures, policy exceptions, providing documents in an alternative format, live captioning or using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

We are committed to a transparent and secure hiring process. All communications related to this role will come directly from a CLEAR employee through valid CLEAR channels (e.g., a valid @clearme.com email address or verified CLEAR LinkedIn profile). jobs.title: NEO Lower - K-8th Grade Principal
jobs.location: Northeast Ohio College Preparatory School - Lower Campus
jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Principal at Northeast Ohio College Preparatory School in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students.  We are seeking leaders who are excited to create a rigorous and nurturing environment that prioritizes student engagement and achievement.

Be part of the difference at Northeast Ohio College Preparatory School! Founded in 2010, Northeast Ohio College Preparatory School is the only public charter school in Cleveland that offers a continuous EK-12 college prep education. Located on adjoining EK-8 and high school campuses in the Tremont neighborhood, NEO College Prep offers a well-rounded education that supports students as they grow academically, socially, and emotionally. The campus features separate buildings for K-8 and high school with extensive education facilities. The school’s nurturing teachers, wide variety of specialty classes, and focus on social-emotional wellbeing create a positive school culture. Northeast Ohio College Preparatory School is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

The Principal serves as the instructional and administrative leader of the ACCEL Schools campus – responsible for the development, implementation and achievement of the school’s academic vision, student advancement and daily operations.  The Principal will ensure successful academic outcomes for all students while employing long-term instructional sustainability measures involving professional development, teacher quality assessment, curriculum and pedagogical advancement.

The Principal shall be responsible for:

Instructional Leadership

• Leading the strategic instructional design and practice, including: implementing an integrated curriculum; directing instructional coaching and evaluation; systematic use of assessment data to guide instruction; and, maximizing impact of the blended learning model (where available).

• Develop, implement and lead the instructional programs of the school, assessing curriculum, pedagogy, lesson plans and observing classes (teaching and learning) on a frequent and structured basis to encourage the use of a variety of instructional strategies and materials consistent with research on the best practices for student learning and development.

• Delivering consistently high levels of achievement and learning for all students through rigorous and engaging programs and classroom instruction.

• Relentlessly work to meet all goals related to student achievement and school culture as well as Adequate Yearly Progress (AYP) goals.

• Facilitate the implementation of a standards-based curriculum, review lesson plans weekly, and conduct frequent walk-throughs/teacher debriefs.

• Assume responsibility for student achievement as related to academics and social-emotional wellbeing.

• Serve as the instructional leader in the building by facilitating a growth-focused professional environment.

• Develop and/or modify the school’s cultural programming and school-wide PBIS process with an emphasis on appropriate class conduct and behavior.

• Work with staff to plan and coordinate teacher-based teams, staff in-service days, data days, etc.

• Develop and implement consistent professional development for teachers, ensuring regular instructional training is consistent with the latest research-based methodologies.

• Implement behavior management practices that ensure consistent norms of orderly, respectful behavior, motivating students through strong relationships with their teachers and positive reinforcement.

• Facilitate and direct the Charter School’s Special Education program and ensure program participants are achieving at high levels.

• Coordinate all phases of summer educational opportunities and before/after school programs as applicable.

Team Leadership

• Establish a strong school community culture by maintaining positive, cooperative and mutually supportive relationships with faculty, staff, parents, students, and all other school stakeholders.

• Skillful and collaborative leadership of all teachers, staff, and school leaders, including supervision, coaching, and performance management oversight.

• Lead the Charter School’s teacher evaluation program and ensure all teachers have opportunities to meet their professional goals and are expertly executing ACCEL Schools instructional best practices.

• Evaluate teachers as per the State Ohio teacher Evaluation System (OTES).

• Overseeing the Charter School’s professional development program ensuring a strong, collaborative professional community, regular training opportunities and a meaningful summer experience.

• Creating a student support system that addresses students’ academic and behavioral needs holistically and involves parents, teachers, and all relevant staff.

Organizational Leadership

• Manage the school’s daily operations, including: facilities management; information/instructional technologies; food services; student data management systems; academic assessment tools; office management; budget and fiscal controls; and, student recruitment and retention.

• With support from the Home Office/Operations Team, exercise full engagement on compliance, budget, procurement, student data, academic assessments, and campus safety. Cooperate with the back-office service provider where necessary to meet all school administrative activities. Make recommendations for improvement as necessary.

• Partner with Human Resources to execute a highly effective talent management system of recruiting, selecting, hiring, retaining, recognizing, and supporting all school site staff.

• Ensure non-discrimination practices in the selection process of faculty and staff by adhering to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements.

• Collaborate with Home Office/Operations Team on the review and reporting requirements of the State, charter authorizing agency and Federal regulatory agencies, school sponsor, including the charter renewal process.

• With support from the operations team, oversee maintenance of school census data, attendance data, and other reporting requirements as mandated by the state or school sponsor.

• With support from the operations team, implement the national school lunch program, transportation, audits, student application distribution, collection, approval, and verifications as applicable.

• Complete all accountability reports and oversee all student enrollment reports to the state; ensure compliance in all areas.

• Manage student recruitment and retention and achieve goals of retaining 85% of students annually.

• Understand and address all compliance items as they relate to the school’s Sponsor Agreement.

• Maintain a master school calendar to be posted for all stakeholders in all appropriate mediums (i.e. website, social media, student/parent guide, employee handbook). Work with the Home Office staff to ensure all marketing and communications tools are up-to-date and active.

• Engage in regular communications with the Home Office/Operations Team about the needs, successes and general operation of the school.

• Maintain open and ongoing daily and/or weekly meetings with the Regional Vice President

• Ensure the safety and wellbeing of all students and colleagues.

• Assist with updating parent and student manuals, policies, and handbooks.

Community Leadership

• Act as the Charter School’s point person to the local community, effectively communicating the school’s mission and vision and soliciting input from parents and families about school performance, areas for improvement, and their needs.

• Understand, accept, abide by, and implement the school’s philosophy and mission statement in all school activities.

• Contribute to a positive climate and culture by exhibiting high professional standards.

• Engage and build strong professional relationships with parents, characterized by timely and regular communication, involving parents wherever possible in the life of the school.

• Cultivate partnerships with external organizations that enrich the culture of the school, as well as strong working relationships with other local districts and charter authorizers.

• Plan and conduct student and family orientations.

• Coordinate special projects, such as peer mentoring, service learning, and community involvement.

• Conduct home visits as needed.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Attributes:

• Passion for improving educational opportunities for all students and for building a strong, highly effective organization aligned to this mission.

• Demonstrated experience raising student achievement among a diverse group of learners, including low income students, non-native English speakers, students of color, and other traditionally underserved populations.

• Knowledge of/experience with innovative school designs and instructional models, including those featuring 21st Century learning strategies like blended, inquiry, problem/project based and personalized learning.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

• Strong, experienced manager with excellent leadership and team building skills.

• Ability to translate critical feedback into effective outcomes.

• Leads with grit, perseverance and a “can-do” positive attitude.

• Ability to productively organize, communicate, and disseminate policies, strategies, and tasks.

• Familiarity with the developmental, behavioral, social, and academic needs of students in the academic years.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Education or related discipline required; an advanced degree in education/educational leadership strongly preferred.

• Current valid Principal license

• Minimum of three years’ experience in a full-time teaching role

• Two or more years of experience in successful school administration/instructional leadership in an urban setting

• Demonstrated skill in developing and maintaining a rigorous academic program that meets the needs of all scholars

• Experience in public education accountability, compliance, and related legal requirements.

• Experience in coaching teachers to improve their instructional planning, instructional practice, and classroom culture

• Knowledge of State Standards and Common Core Standards

• Successful completion of federal and state criminal background checks

• Ability to meet educational standards as applicable

• Ability to work well under pressure as well as effectively prioritize and execute tasks to meet deadlines consistently

• Understanding of and ability to manage confidential information

• Exemplary written and verbal communication skills

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - 100,000.  Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

• Paid time off

• Retirement contributions

• Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance

• Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)

• Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary short-term disability insurance

• Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

• Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

It is our policy to abide by all federal, state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination based solely on a person’s race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status, veteran status (including protected veterans), marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, familial status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected status except where a reasonable, bona fide occupational qualification exists.

jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Operations Director sets the tone for the entire center’s team member culture and family experience. This role is responsible for overseeing and managing all operational aspects within Centria Autism, including developing and managing schedules for Behavior Technicians, coordinating and overseeing assessments for clients, coordinating staffing activities, conducting center tours, and serving as a liaison with facility management to help maintain a clean and safe working environment. This role will partner with Clinical Leadership to support clinical outcomes, high quality care delivery, and to ultimately deliver growth. The Operations Director will lead Behavior Technicians by coordinating training and compliance needs, and issuing disciplinary action up to and including termination, and completing the offboarding process. This role will also develop strategies and initiatives to improve client and Behavior Technician retention. The Operations Director will play a vital role in ensuring smooth operations and maintaining high-quality standards throughout the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Scheduling Coordination Develop and manage schedules for Behavior Technicians, ensuring optimal coverage and adherence to company policies and guidelines. Coordinate and oversee the scheduling of assessments for all clients, including the option to assist with re-assessments when necessary. Align families, Behavior Technicians, and Supervising Clinicians to start new cases and confirm authorization, ensuring a smooth case start. Coordinate staffing activities, including permanent staff allocation, substitution arrangements, and assigning multiple Behavior Technicians to clients as needed. Confirm schedules weekly with Behavior Technicians and families.

• Oversee Behavior Technicians and Operational/Center Processes Assist with coordination of training and compliance needs. Monitor Behavior Technician attendance and professionalism, in consultation with the Area Operations Director (AOD), and implement measures to maintain high performance standards. Monitor and analyze center metrics to assess performance and identify areas for improvement. Ensure adequate leadership coverage during all operating hours to maintain smooth operations and address any urgent issues. Ensure smooth coordination of care for clients at clinical sites, including effective communication and collaboration with healthcare providers. Actively participate in internal marketing initiatives, recognition programs, and Behavior Technician survey feedback, promoting a positive and engaging work culture. Address and resolve issues related to paper document management, implementing efficient solutions to enhance accuracy and productivity. Schedule and manage non-billable Behavior Technician hours and utilization of Behavior Technician hours to stay within budget. Identify staffing needs, interview candidates, issue disciplinary action, and complete offboarding

• Ensure the Operations Workflow Runs Smoothly by Coordinating with Other Departments and Families Partner with the Director of Clinical Services to drive growth, understand and support clinical outcomes, and ensure service delivery is aligned with Centria’s clinical model and philosophy. Facilitate effective communication and handoff processes between the Onboarding and Intake Teams and the Operations Team for seamless transition and service initiation. Collaborate with the Information Technology (IT) Department to address and resolve operational IT issues, ensuring smooth functioning of systems and technology. Review and coordinate conversations regarding insurance changes for clients, changes in case status, and ensure timely confirmation of authorizations. Coordinate community outreach activities to promote Centria’s services, establish partnerships, and generate leads. Develop strategies and initiatives to improve client and Behavior Technician retention rates. Ensure ongoing engagement with clients, including before the start of services and/or while they are on hold, addressing their needs and concerns, and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Maintain Compliance Regulations Enforce compliance with center policies and procedures, accreditation standards, and training requirements, addressing any violations and implementing corrective actions. Ensure adherence to medication administration protocols, coordinating with healthcare professionals and maintaining accurate records. Ensure compliance with the dormant policy, manage offboarding processes for team members, and oversee the collection of iPads from departing team members.

• Oversee Financial Processes Oversee payroll and billing processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with relevant regulations. Take ownership of the profit and loss (P&L) statement, monitoring financial performance and implementing strategies for improvement. Provide administrative triage and one-call resolution for authorization and coordination of benefits (COB) issues, resolving them promptly and accurately.

• Oversee Facility Operations Take pride in the center or academy workspace, ensuring cleanliness and organization as well as quickly addressing issues as they arise. Conduct center tours for prospective clients, providing information and showcasing the organization's services and facilities. Serve as a liaison with facility management, ensuring effective communication and collaboration. Maintain a safe working environment, implementing and enforcing safety protocols and emergency preparedness plans, promoting a culture of safety awareness. Ensure compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements, implementing necessary protocols and training. Ensure compliance with labor law poster requirements, displaying all necessary posters in visible locations. Oversee the purchasing process for operational supplies, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to procurement policies. Manage iPad assets (ordering, inventory management, maintenance, etc.)

You’ll independently guide an engineering team of roughly 3-8 engineers and serve as a primary point of contact for health-system customers on eligibility and coverage questions.

Location

We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. jobs.title: Product Manager (ThrivePages)
jobs.description:
About ThriveStudio:

ThrivePages lets digital creators and online merchants build sales pages, landing pages, and funnels with checkout built in, without code or a designer. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work on features end to end and make building and converting with pages measurably better.

Location:

Remote (EU)

Job Overview:

You’ll work on features from discovery through launch and iteration. You’ll work daily with engineering, design, QA, and support. About 75% of your time is hands-on building: specs, prototypes, rollout plans, and release follow-through. The rest is deciding what comes next. You’ll work AI-first, using AI tools daily for research, specs, and prototypes.

What You'll Do:

• Define the user problem, success metrics, and trade-offs for your feature area, then run discovery through interviews, data, prototypes, and experiments.

• Write PRDs and tickets with clear objectives, non-goals, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a rollout plan.

• Build a clickable prototype with AI for every feature. Engineers build from your prototype, not from a meeting.

• Keep your product queue ranked and trusted, so nobody has to ask what’s next.

• Decide how each feature rolls out (who gets it, behind what gate), and set up monitoring and analytics before launch.

• Keep help docs, release notes, and internal enablement accurate.

• Evaluate where AI genuinely helps users. Write evaluation criteria and a fallback before building any AI feature.

What You Bring To This Role:

• 3–5 years of product management experience, with a record of shipping features that solved real problems and moved a measurable metric.

• Strong discovery and analytics skills. You pull your own numbers and design clean experiments.

• Specs and prototypes that need no interpretation.

• You’re comfortable reading code with an AI agent and tracing a feature from request to database. You can set up test data and run the product yourself without waiting on engineering.

• Working knowledge of AI concepts (prompts, tokens, models) and the cost and latency trade-offs behind them.

• Clear, high-signal communication across product, design, engineering, and support.

• Experience with page builders, funnel or checkout tools, or products used to sell digital goods online is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

Your features move a measurable metric. Engineers are unblocked because your requirements and decisions are clear. You’ll be the go-to person for your product area and ready to own a full roadmap.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

• Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.

• User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.

• Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.

• Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: Senior PR & Communications Manager U.S.
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?



About the Role

Statista is seeking a Senior PR & Communications Manager to lead communications efforts across the U.S. market. Reporting to the Head of PR & Communications, this individual will serve as the primary communications partner for the U.S. business, driving media relations, thought leadership, executive visibility, and brand awareness.

This is a highly visible role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate brings strong media relationships, exceptional storytelling skills, and a proven ability to translate business priorities into impactful and measurable communications programs.

If you thrive on making things happen, enjoy working across different spectra of communication, and want to make a real impact by empowering people with data to make fact-based decisions, this is your opportunity.



Key Responsibilities

 - Lead and execute Statista's U.S. communications strategy in alignment with global communications and business objectives.

 - Serve and act as the primary PR and communications contact for the U.S. market.

 - Build and maintain relationships with key journalists, editors, and industry influencers.

 - Plan and execute always-on PR activities to secure regular earned media coverage across Tier 1 and Tier 2 business, technology, trade, national, and podcast media; exposure to broadcast media is a plus.

 - Develop and execute integrated communications campaigns with high impact tactics, including media outreach, thought leadership, executive positioning, and corporate announcements.

 - Partner with internal stakeholders to create compelling narratives that support Statista's products, services, and brand positioning.

 - Position and prepare executives for media interviews, speaking engagements, and external appearances to ensure impactful and consistent representation in the U.S. market.

 - Manage strategic communications initiatives with Statista’s key technology and AI partners (e.g., Perplexity or Microsoft Copilot), by developing and executing joint campaigns and events, content initiatives, and co-marketing activities

 - Effectively lead crisis communications efforts for the U.S. market when needed.

 - Track communications performance, analyze results, and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.



Qualifications

 - 6+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, brand communications, journalism, or related fields, gained at a PR agency or in-house, ideally within the tech, DaaS, or SaaS sectors.

 - Strong understanding of the U.S. media landscape with demonstrated success securing earned media coverage.

 - Strong, well-established relationships with journalists and editors across U.S. Tier 1 and Tier 2 business, technology, trade, and emerging media outlets (UK media contacts are a plus but not required).

 - Proven track record of developing and executing integrated, tactical communications strategies and campaigns that drive measurable business and media impact.

 - Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences and clearly articulate complex dependencies and solutions.

 - Outstanding organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities

 - Proven senior stakeholder exposure and strong partnership capabilities with cross-functional teams

 - Familiarity with AI-enabled communications is a plus.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Experienced in analyzing data and trends to identify media relations opportunities.

 - Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership programs.

 - Experience working within a global organization or agency



Why Statista

At Statista, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions through trusted data and insights. Join us in shaping how businesses, organizations, and individuals understand the world through data.



What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

 - Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

 - Hybrid work and flex-time

 - International team and social events

 - Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

 - Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

 - Career & training opportunities

 - Attractive locations and modern offices

 - Mental health support with OpenUp

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (United States) ; requires ability to work east coast hours

About Consumer Edge

Join a dynamic team that's redefining consumer data analytics. Consumer Edge (“CE”) is a leading data and insights-as-a-service (IaaS) company specializing in the global consumer, B2B, and healthcare economies. CE delivers real-time, transaction-based intelligence enriched by deep industry expertise. Its solutions equip corporate and investment leaders with best-in-class tools for strategic decision-making, offering granular insights and benchmarking across products, brands, sub-industries, and industries. CE’s unique capabilities turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter, faster decisions.

About the role

We’re hiring a Staff Data Engineer to set the technical direction for identity and audience data in our data products. You’ll design how our data connects across sources and partners, and build the pipelines our data products depend on, working with data science, product, and fellow engineers.

What you’ll do

• Own identity data. Design identity data models and matching logic, and keep them accurate, auditable, and current.

• Build partner data mappings. Build and maintain identifier mappings with external partners, and report match quality and coverage.

• Build data pipelines. Build and run the production pipelines behind our data products.

• Build privacy in. Build consent, opt-out, deletion, and access controls into identity data, working with legal and security.

• Set the quality bar. Create data quality frameworks, monitoring, and anomaly detection for pipelines that carry billions of rows.

• Set technical direction. Lead design reviews and build-versus-buy decisions, and mentor data engineers through design and code reviews.

• Lead how the team builds with AI. Work AI-first every day, and build the agent harnesses, shared skills, and guardrails that make AI-generated work safe to ship.

What you’ll bring

• 8+ years in data engineering or backend data systems, including production pipelines on high-volume data (consumer data is a plus)

• Ad tech or martech experience with identity and audience data

• Hands-on identity resolution experience, such as entity resolution or match tables, and familiarity with common ad tech identifiers

• Experience with advertising data

• Expert SQL and Python, with deep BigQuery or Snowflake experience and a modern stack such as dbt and Airflow

• A track record of setting technical direction across teams, and clear communication with engineers and business leaders

• Comfort using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex as an everyday part of your work

Nice to have

• Data clean room experience

Established by three experienced legal professionals, the firm is building a collaborative, structured, and client-focused practice while continuing to strengthen its internal processes and operations.

The Personal Injury Paralegal will support the firm's pre-litigation operations by maintaining regular client communication, coordinating medical treatment follow-up, organizing case documentation, and assisting attorneys with assigned case-related responsibilities. Working within a collaborative legal team, the successful candidate will help maintain efficient case workflows, ensure accurate and timely documentation, and support consistent client service throughout the pre-litigation process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

jobs.title: Product Manager (ThriveStudio)
jobs.description:
About ThriveStudio:

ThriveStudio helps people turn information into visuals others actually understand: presentations, reports, infographics, posters, and more. Our users are teachers, marketers, nonprofits, and teams who aren’t designers and shouldn’t need to be. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work on features end to end and make the creation experience measurably better.

Location:

Remote (EU)

Job Overview:

You’ll work on features from discovery through launch and iteration. You’ll work daily with engineering, design, QA, and support. About 75% of your time is hands-on building: specs, prototypes, rollout plans, and release follow-through. The rest is deciding what comes next. You’ll work AI-first, using AI tools daily for research, specs, and prototypes.

What You'll Do:

• Define the user problem, success metrics, and trade-offs for your feature area, then run discovery through interviews, data, prototypes, and experiments.

• Write PRDs and tickets with clear objectives, non-goals, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a rollout plan.

• Build a clickable prototype with AI for every feature. Engineers build from your prototype, not from a meeting.

• Keep your product queue ranked and trusted, so nobody has to ask what’s next.

• Decide how each feature rolls out (who gets it, behind what gate), and set up monitoring and analytics before launch.

• Keep help docs, release notes, and internal enablement accurate.

• Evaluate where AI genuinely helps users. Write evaluation criteria and a fallback before building any AI feature.

What You Bring To This Role:

• 3-5 years of product management experience, with a record of shipping features that solved real problems and moved a measurable metric.

• Strong discovery and analytics skills. You pull your own numbers and design clean experiments.

• Specs and prototypes that need no interpretation.

• You’re comfortable reading code with an AI agent and tracing a feature from request to database. You can set up test data and run the product yourself without waiting on engineering.

• Working knowledge of AI concepts (prompts, tokens, models) and the cost and latency trade-offs behind them.

• Clear, high-signal communication across product, design, engineering, and support.

• Experience with editors, design tools, or content creation products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

Your features move a measurable metric. Engineers are unblocked because your requirements and decisions are clear. You’ll be the go-to person for your product area and ready to own a full roadmap.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

• Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.

• User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.

• Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.

• Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

JOIN A TOP WORKPLACE - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7nlFHnnfvhk

OPERATIONS DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM - First Rotation as a Shift Supervisor

The Operations Management Rotational Program is a leadership-first development role for those building a career in Hydrite manufacturing operations. The program runs two to three years across two to three rotations of nine to twelve months, and it opens in a plant supervisory seat. From the first assignment the role owns safety, team accountability, and daily execution for a production area, learning our processes from the floor up.

Assignments follow real site openings rather than a fixed curriculum. Plant managers and functional leads identify where a participant adds genuine value and confirm they have the bandwidth to develop someone, and participants are matched accordingly. The program concludes in a permanent operations role, with placement agreed during the second rotation so the final rotation serves as onboarding into that job.

Primary responsibilities include:

• Own safety performance for the assigned area, setting the expectation through daily presence on the floor and through how issues are raised, investigated, and closed.

• Supervise a production or shift team, holding accountability for staffing, coaching, performance conversations, and day-to-day execution against the schedule.

• Learn the site's manufacturing processes in depth, developing the technical fluency needed to make sound operating decisions and to earn the confidence of experienced operators.

• Lead or contribute to engineering and continuous improvement projects that run alongside daily supervisory responsibilities.

• Take on a second assignment in process engineering, supply chain, maintenance, quality, continuous improvement, or EHS, applying the same ownership to a functional or cross-site problem.
