jobs.title: Senior Motor and Power Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
A New Paradigm For Space Operations.

Who We Are:

Space Kinetic is a dual-use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations – one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low-cost, operationally flexible, attainable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem's reliance on consumable fuel. In a world where many companies are focused on incrementally improving the status quo, we are focused on creating something entirely different – an architecture underpinned by new first principles to meet the opportunities and challenges of the third space age head-on. Our goal is to move away from one-to-one space architectures – where each satellite in a constellation has one (or a small # of) primary payloads attached to the bus -- and unlock a ‘one-to-many’ system, where each satellite has a large number of payloads which can be deployed from their host spacecraft at high velocities without firing a thruster.

This is not a role for someone looking for a traditional 40-hour work week. Space Kinetic is building ambitious, first-of-its-kind technology, and that requires urgency, ownership, and a high level of commitment to changing the foundational assumptions for everything we do in space.

What You’ll Do:

As a Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will own the design, development, integration, and testing of power electronics and electrical power systems for Space Kinetic's payload and spacecraft. You will lead the development of high-performance power conversion, distribution, and control electronics that enable demanding electromechanical systems and other flight-critical hardware.

You will work across electrical, mechanical, controls, software, and systems engineering to translate system-level requirements into robust electrical architectures and flight-ready hardware. This is a highly hands-on engineering role requiring technical leadership, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to take complex power electronics from initial concept through qualification and flight.

Job Responsibilities:

• Lead the architecture and design of power electronics for spacecraft and electromechanical systems.

• Design high-power switching electronics, DC/DC converters, motor drives, and power distribution systems.

• Develop power architectures incorporating energy storage, battery management, protection, and distribution.

• Perform electrical, thermal, efficiency, transient response, and component derating analyses.

• Select and qualify power semiconductors, gate drivers, magnetics, and other critical components.

• Develop schematics, PCB layouts, electrical interfaces, and hardware specifications.

• Lead hardware bring-up, debugging, characterization, and qualification testing.

• Collaborate with controls and embedded systems engineers on power electronics interfaces and control strategies.

• Support vehicle integration, environmental testing, and flight hardware development.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship while remaining hands-on with design and development.

What It Takes:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related field.

• 7+ years of experience in embedded systems, motor controls, or power controls.

• Strong embedded firmware development skills in C/C++

• Experience with BLDC/PMSM motor control, commutation, and closed-loop control

• Experience with microcontrollers, PWM, ADCs, and real-time embedded systems.

• Experience integrating firmware with motor drives and power electronics.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

What We'd Love:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• Experience with Field-Oriented Control (FOC) and motor-control optimization.

• Experience with isolated DC/DC converters, battery charging, and high-voltage power systems.

• Familiarity with CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, and embedded communication protocols.

• Experience with RTOS, FPGA-based controls, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

• Experience developing controls for aerospace, spacecraft, robotics, or other high-performance electromechanical systems. Our vision is unique, and so is the team we’re building. So, if your background doesn’t fully meet these qualifications, we still want your application.

Where You’ll Be:

• The position is onsite at our headquarters in El Segundo, CA. Domestic travel may be required, approximately 25% to 40% of the year.

What We Offer:

• Equity-Based Compensation

• 401(k) retirement plan with a 3.5% company match

• Highly Competitive PTO

• Paid company holidays + winter break

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Unique Performance-based bonus opportunities

ITAR Requirements:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about ITAR here.

jobs.title: Diseñador/a Junior de Sistemas de Seguridad – Centros de Datos
jobs.description:
El/la Diseñador/a de Sistema de Seguridad trabajará diariamente junto a arquitectos, ingenieros y diseñadores de interiores, disfrutando de oportunidades de colaboración y desarrollo profesional. Será responsable de desarrollar soluciones  de los Sistemas de Seguridad, como Videovigilancia (CCTV), control de accesos, detección de intrusión, gestión de visitas, telefonía e interfonía, así como los sistemas integrados en el centro de control, operaciones y seguridad, para una amplia variedad de clientes. La persona candidata ideal tendrá un conocimiento profundo de los sistemas de seguridad y demostrará excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de negocio, así como experiencia en la gestión de las distintas fases de diseño de soluciones de seguridad complejas.

Será esencial la capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y comunicarse de manera segura, clara y profesional. También deberá mostrar pasión por la innovación en el diseño y la calidad, equilibrándolas de forma eficiente con la creatividad y la productividad en el desarrollo de soluciones.

Como parte de un equipo de consultores especializadosen Centros de Datos y Edificios Comerciales, la persona seleccionada realizará las siguientes funciones:

• Diseñar sistemas de control de accesos, videovigilancia (CCTV), detección de intrusión y sistemas gestión de alarmas, proporcionando una protección integral tanto dentro como fuera del edificio.

• Elaborar vistas de cámaras CCTV utilizando modelos 3D y mapas de cobertura.
• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los códigos, normas y reglamentos aplicables.
• Elaborar planos, especificaciones técnicas y mediciones/presupuestos.

• Colaborar con diferentes equipos para facilitar la integración de sistemas de ICT, automatización de edificios, gestión de energía y potencia, soluciones audiovisuales y otras tecnologías basadas en IP utilizadas en la operación de edificios.
• Aplicar conocimientos avanzados sobre los distintos tipos de infraestructuras ICT y sus aplicaciones para llevar a cabo proyectos complejos y especializados, incluyendo inspecciones, diseño, desarrollo y supervisión técnica durante la construcción e instalación.
• Recopilar y analizar datos de ingeniería mediante procedimientos establecidos y claramente definidos.
• Desarrollar trabajos de diseño y consultoría, tanto detallados como rutinarios.
• Ejecutar las tareas bajo supervisión, respetando los presupuestos y plazos de proyecto acordados.

Requisitos mínimos

• Grado universitario o titulación equivalente de una universidad o institución acreditada.
• Entre 5 y 10 años de experiencia en el diseño de sistemas de seguridad.
• Nivel alto de inglés, tanto escrito como hablado, para garantizar una comunicación y colaboración eficaces con el equipo y las partes interesadas.
• Experiencia profesional y/o dominio de diferentes herramientas informáticas, incluyendo, entre otras, Revit, AutoCAD, Visio Professional, Bluebeam Extreme (Revu), Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) y otros programas específicos de ICT.

Requisitos valorables

• Certificación vigente BICSI Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) u otra certificación activa de BICSI.
• Conocimientos prácticos del proceso de diseño de la AIA (American Institute of Architects).
• Experiencia profesional y/o conocimientos de los códigos, normas y reglamentos aplicables, incluyendo, entre otros, requisitos de permisos de obras, ordenanzas estatales y locales, la norma IEEE C2 (National Electrical Safety Code), los estándares OSHA 1910, las normas de cableado ANSI/TIA como TIA-568 y TIA-569, ISO/IEC 11801, ISO/IEC 27001, las normas para centros de datos ANSI/TIA-942 y los manuales BICSI TDMM y otras publicaciones técnicas pertinentes.

AECOM es la firma de consultoría de infraestructura de confianza en el mundo, que ofrece servicios profesionales durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto, desde asesoramiento, planificación, diseño e ingeniería hasta gestión de programas y construcción. Nuestros equipos están impulsados por un propósito común de ofrecer un mundo mejor a través de nuestra experiencia técnica y digital sin igual, una cultura de equidad, diversidad e inclusión, y un compromiso con las prioridades ambientales, sociales y de gobernanza. Libertad para crecer en un mundo de oportunidades

Tendrá la flexibilidad que necesita para hacer su mejor trabajo con las opciones de trabajo híbrido. Ya sea que trabaje desde una oficina de AECOM, una ubicación remota o en el sitio de un cliente, trabajará en un entorno dinámico donde se defiende su integridad, espíritu emprendedor y mentalidad pionera.

AECOM ofrece una amplia gama de programas de compensación y beneficios para satisfacer las diversas necesidades de nuestros empleados y sus familias. También ofrecemos un sólido programa de bienestar global. Somos la empresa de infraestructura global de confianza del mundo, y estamos juntos en esto: su crecimiento y éxito también son los nuestros.

Únase a nosotros y obtendrá todos los beneficios de ser parte de una empresa global que cotiza en bolsa: acceso a tecnología y pensamiento líderes en la industria y trabajo transformador con gran impacto y flexibilidad laboral. jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - IIS
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Product Marketing

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $180,000 to $210,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

As the Principal Product Marketing Manager for the Huntress In-house IT and Security (IIS) segment, the lean IT and security teams at small and midsized organizations who are expected to protect everything with a handful of people (or sometimes just one).

Our existing product-aligned PMMs define what each product does and why it matters. You take that work the last mile, creating next-level narratives, new content, and enablement that resonate with your segment so that marketing, sales, and channel partners can have more relevant conversations and close more business, faster.

You are Outcome-Obsessed, connecting messaging, enablement, and demand programs to measurable business results. You bring Perfect Imperfection to research and go-to-market work by acting on useful insight, learning quickly, and sharpening the IIS motion each quarter. Candor guides how you work across teams, giving you the confidence to make recommendations, hold a point of view, and push back constructively.

Responsibilities:

• Own IIS segment positioning, value propositions, message architecture, proof points, and a repeatable bill of materials across the personas and key industries of your segment.

• Conduct ongoing research and analysis to improve the IIS motion, including representing the voice of IIS buyers and their needs in product launch and roadmap conversations.

• Partner with Product Marketing peers to adapt portfolio and platform content for IIS audiences and key industries.

• Partner with Campaigns and Growth Marketing to turn audience insight into demand programs, nurture streams, outreach, livestreams, buyer guides, verticalized content, comparison content, business-case tools, demo narratives, and other mid- and bottom-funnel assets.

• Equip SDRs, AEs, and Customer Account Managers with talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, content, and enablement.

• Support the Channel team with vertical-specific content, battle cards, and the core narratives used to train VARs and distributors, working alongside Channel SEs.

• Work with our Microsoft alliance team to develop and refine the partnership story and related content, including how Huntress helps customers get more value from their Microsoft licensing.

• Use AI to orchestrate repeatable workflows for market and buyer analysis, research, and content development, thoughtfully validating outputs for accuracy, relevance, and quality.

What You Bring To The Team:

• You have 6+ years of product marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B cybersecurity software, with measurable results you can show.

• You have experience marketing and selling to in-house IT and security buyers, with experience serving small and midsized businesses preferred.

• You bring a buyer-centric mindset and naturally frame messages around pain points, buying triggers, personas, decision-making, and outcomes.

• You can turn complex technical ideas into clear, compelling narratives for both business decision makers and technical practitioners.

• You have partnered hands-on with Campaigns or Growth Marketing teams to create programs, nurture streams, and content that contributed to pipeline.

• You have experience working with sales and channel partners, including VARs and distributors.

• You collaborate effectively, hold a clear point of view, balance competing stakeholders, push back constructively, and move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.

• You can orchestrate AI-supported workflows for research, analysis, and writing, while applying sound judgment to validate and improve the output.

What We Offer:

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

jobs.title: Senior Network Administrator
jobs.description:
Network Administrator

AECOM is seeking a Network Administrator to support the Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) District Six SunGuide Transportation Management Center (TMC) in Miami, Florida.  The TMC operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, providing traffic management services throughout Miami-Dade and Monroe Counties. The successful operation of these services depends on a highly reliable, secure, and resilient telecommunications and IT network infrastructure.  The ideal candidate will possess expert-level knowledge of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network engineering with extensive experience in enterprise networking, telecommunications, network security, and troubleshooting. Candidate must be comfortable working in a mission-critical, high-availability environment where network reliability, cybersecurity, and rapid incident resolution are essential.  This is a full-time, on-site position reporting to the IT Manager.

Network Administration and Engineering

• Configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including Extreme Networks Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches and Sophos firewalls
• Provide expert-level troubleshooting of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network connectivity and performance issues
• Configure and maintain network routing, VLANs, redundancy, and other network services to support continuous TMC operations
• Support network high-availability configurations, redundancy, failover, and disaster recovery capabilities
• Monitor network performance, availability, and security using network management platforms, including SolarWinds
• Assist with network architecture planning, infrastructure upgrades, hardware replacements, and technology modernization initiatives
• Maintain accurate network diagrams, equipment configurations, and technical documentation

Telecommunications and ITS Integration

• Troubleshoot telecommunications infrastructure utilizing fiber-optic cable, Ethernet, and wireless technologies
• Support the integration, configuration, and troubleshooting of ITS field devices
• Troubleshoot communication failures involving fiber-optic infrastructure, network switches, wireless systems, and ITS field devices
• Support network connectivity between the TMC, ITS field locations, external agencies, and third-party systems
• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot unicast, multicast, and anycast network communications, including video streaming and distribution
• Assist with integrating new ITS technologies and telecommunications systems into the TMC network

Cybersecurity and Network Protection

• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Sophos firewall policies, VPN tunnels, and network security configurations
• Support cybersecurity initiatives, including vulnerability remediation, security updates, network segmentation, and infrastructure hardening
• Network security assessments and the implementation of cybersecurity best practices
• Support secure connectivity between the TMC, external agencies, contractors, and other authorized network partners
• Network configuration changes follow established security procedures, documentation requirements, and change management practices

Systems Support and Technical Coordination

• Assist with troubleshooting MS Windows Server environments and MS 365 applications including Outlook
• Coordinate with internal IT personnel, FDOT representatives, vendors, and contractors to resolve technical issues
• Plan and support the implementation and integration of new network technologies and infrastructure improvements
• Participate in meetings for networking, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and ITS operations
• Provide technical assistance during network outages and other critical operational events

Minimum Technical Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related discipline
• Eight years of experience in enterprise networking, telecommunications, network engineering, or network administration or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Experience at an expert-level understanding of Layers 1, 2, and 3 network technologies
• Experience in configuring, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching infrastructure
• Experience supporting complex, high-availability network environments
• Experienced and understanding in network redundancy, routing protocols, VLAN configurations, and network troubleshooting methodologies

Demonstrated experience and proficiency or working knowledge in the following areas:

• TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, routing, network redundancy, and troubleshooting
• Extreme Networks switches and enterprise networking technologies
• Sophos firewalls, firewall policies, VPN tunnels, network segmentation, and cybersecurity best practices
• Fiber-optic communications, wireless networking, Ethernet connectivity, and telecommunications troubleshooting
• Unicast, multicast, and anycast networking, including IP video distribution and streaming
• SolarWinds and related network monitoring and diagnostic tools
• MS Windows Server, MS 365, Outlook, and related MS applications
• Network diagrams, equipment configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and change management documentation

Possess or obtain the following certifications within 12 months of employment, subject to applicable training availability and certification eligibility.

• Extreme Certified Associate (ECA)
• Extreme Networks Certified Administrator (ENCA) - applicable switching technology
• Extreme Certified Professional (ECP) - Extreme Switching
• Sophos Firewall Certified Administrator
• Sophos Firewall Certified Engineer (ET80), where eligible through the Sophos partner certification program
• Equivalent or successor certifications may be considered with IT Manager approval

Preferred:

• Experience supporting FDOT TMCs or comparable traffic operations
• Experience and knowledge of FDOT District Six ITS network architecture and telecommunications infrastructure
• Experience with SunGuide ATMS

Under the direct supervision of a Maryland-licensed pharmacist and in coordination with other technicians, the Senior Pharmacy Technician demonstrates mastery of  medication distribution and support activities within the Pharmacy Department and throughout the hospital organization, customer service, and quality improvement.  He/she trains new staff and exemplifies excellence in the timely preparation, packaging, distribution and delivery of medications, as well as provides oversight of supportive operations and resources. • Accurately and efficiently performs drug distribution, medication preparation/compounding, dose calculation, and quality assurance/improvement tasks in accordance with established Departmental procedures. Incorporates practice modifications required by patient age group.

• Maintains extensive knowledge and understanding of the AAMC Department of Pharmacy processes, policies and procedures including, but not limited to, timely preparation of medications for pharmacist check, workflow SOPs, use of appropriate medical terms and abbreviations, patient confidentiality, and punctuality and attendance requirements.

• Delivers medications to appropriate locations manually, via pneumatic tube, or by refilling automated dispensing cabinets. Monitors medication storage environments outside the pharmacy for appropriate conditions and regulatory compliance. Assists with unit inspections when designated. Participates in all facets of the emergency drug supply system and specialty tray maintenance.

Follows all procedures for utilizing Secure-Send function of the pneumatic tube system, completes self-audit reports with follow-up, and correctly maintains all controlled substance counts, receiving documentation, and paperwork.

• Answers phone calls and responds to med messages courteously, follows up appropriately, and maintains a professional demeanor at all times when interacting with patients, coworkers, or other members of the healthcare team.

• Complies with USP797 and 800 guidelines for cleanroom maintenance, education, testing, record-keeping, compounding of sterile products, and ordering of supplies. Shows advanced ability to perform required mathematical calculations and conversions.

Communicates medication needs or observed changes in utilization patterns to those in authority. Generates and accurately interprets reports from the primary hospital information system and other computer-based technology.

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

Our Outreach team members are the lifeblood of our business; they know our product, partners, and patients better than anyone. In this role, you’ll be joining a team of passionate professionals who are dedicated wholeheartedly to our mission.

You’ll build relationships with clinical partners in your local community and provide much-needed resources to thousands of people struggling with their mental health. While this work can be challenging, we set the bar high knowing that every decision we make directly impacts our communities.

In your role, you’ll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers, with room for everyone to excel and grow in their careers. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, WMS - Softeon
jobs.description:
You'll own the roadmap for our flagship WMS and join a Product Management team we're actively expanding. Reporting to the VP of Product, you'll decide what we build next for the warehouses that run on Softeon.

As we scale inside IFS, we're refining and formalizing how product work gets done, and you'll help shape it: our discovery rhythm, how requirements reach engineering, how releases reach customers, and how presales, implementation and support feed the roadmap. If you have strong views on what great product practice looks like, you'll get to put them to work.

What you'll do

Own the WMS product

• Set and maintain the WMS roadmap, balancing new capability, platform health, customer commitments and competitive gaps.

• Run discovery directly with warehouse operators, supervisors and IT leaders, on site and on the floor, not just in conference rooms.

• Turn what you learn into clear problem statements, requirements and user stories that engineering can build and test against.

• Prioritize the backlog with engineering leads, make the trade-off calls, and explain the "why" behind them.

• Define success metrics for what we ship and track adoption and outcomes after release.

Bring the market into the building

• Track the WMS and supply chain execution landscape, from tier-one suites to cloud-native challengers; know where we win, where we lose, and why.

• Spot where AI, automation (AMRs, ASRS, WES/WCS) and IFS platform capabilities can solve real warehouse problems.

• Partner with IFS product teams on integrations and on how our WMS fits the broader IFS story.

Take it to market

• Package releases with product marketing and enablement: release notes, positioning, demo stories and talk tracks.

• Support presales on strategic deals, RFPs and roadmap briefings for prospects and customers.

• Close the loop with implementation and support so field issues become product fixes, fast.

Shape how we work

• Help evolve and formalize our product operating model: PRD templates, intake from the field, roadmap reviews, release readiness and customer advisory input.

• Help select and refine the tools and rituals the team uses as it grows.

• Mentor future PMs and product owners as the team expands.

What you'll bring

• 3-5+ years in warehouse or supply chain software, with at least 2 years in product management. Strong candidates from solution consulting, implementation or business analysis who've shaped product direction are encouraged to apply.

• Real fluency in DC operations: receiving, putaway, replenishment, inventory control, wave and task management, picking, packing and shipping.

• A track record of owning a roadmap and backlog and shipping in an Agile team.

• Comfort with integrations and data: ERP, TMS, carrier and automation interfaces; APIs; enough SQL to answer your own questions.

• Clear writing and confident presenting, from a requirements doc for engineers to a roadmap briefing for a customer's VP of Operations.

• Good judgment under ambiguity. You can set priorities with incomplete information, and you enjoy improving processes as much as following them.

• Willingness to travel up to about 20% to customer sites, DCs and industry events.

Nice to have

• Hands-on time in a warehouse or distribution operation, as a supervisor, engineer or ops leader.

• Experience with warehouse automation: AMRs, ASRS, sortation, conveyor, pick-to-light, WES or WCS.

• Background with 3PL, multi-client or omnichannel fulfillment.

• Experience productizing AI or optimization features such as labor planning, slotting or task interleaving.

• Knowledge of ERP ecosystems, especially IFS Cloud.

• CSPO, SAFe PM/PO or a similar product certification.

• Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.

Why join us

• Shape a growing function. We're investing in Product Management as part of IFS, and the people who join now will help define how the team operates as it scales. Your ideas will show up in how we work, not just in what we ship.

• Grow as the org grows. As the team expands, there's a clear path toward Senior PM, Lead PM, or managing PMs of your own, and we'll invest in getting you there.

• Own a real product, not a feature. You'll steer the flagship WMS that live warehouses depend on every shift, and see your decisions show up on the floor.

• Small-team speed, big-company reach. You get the directness of a focused WMS team, plus the customers, partners and platform investment of IFS behind you.

• Work with people who know warehouses. Our product, presales and implementation teams come from the operations world. You'll be surrounded by people who've run the floor, not just studied it.

jobs.title: Traffic Monitoring Operator - Virginia Beach
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking Traffic Monitoring Operator(s) located in Virginia Beach, VA. The shift hours available for the position(s) are 3rd shift (9:15 pm – 5:45 am).  The pay rate is $22.00/hour.

The operator position uses several software platforms and web-based applications to perform tasks. Transportation Operations Center (TOC) Operators are responsible for using Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) software to monitor Department roadways and manage events/incidents; dispatching incident management personnel through 2-way radios; and communicating, coordinating, and collaborating with other staff, Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) personnel, and partner agencies.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

The TOC in Virginia Beach, VA houses a 24/7/365 program that delivers incident management, dispatching, and traveler information services on Virginia’s roadways. AECOM operations staff serve at the TOC facility on shifts to continuously respond to changing traffic conditions and impacts to traffic flow and safety through direct communication with first responders, VDOT staff, Virginia State Police (VSP) and mobility stakeholders of VDOT.

The routine responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Use software and applications to control and monitor various Intelligent Transportation Systems devices located along freeways, such as closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras, dynamic message signs (DMS), and Highway Advisory Radios (HAR) located on the interstate infrastructure.
• Monitor camera video and other information sources for the detection and verification of events that impact traffic flow and safety, such as motorist assists, traffic crashes, debris removal, abandoned vehicles, stalled vehicles, maintenance activity, and construction activity.
• Log potential and confirmed events that impact traffic flow and safety using software applications, including traffic lane and road shoulder closures related to construction and maintenance activity.
• Dispatch Safety Service patrollers, who provide roadside services on freeways in the Hampton Roads area related to traffic crashes and roadway hazard events using two-way radio systems.

jobs.title: CAD Technician
jobs.description:
Forgen is dedicated to building a better future - for generations.

Location: West Palm Beach, Florida

Position Summary

Uses computer aided design techniques to prepare drawings and draft plans for civil construction, environmental remediation, demolition and geotechnical construction projects, as directed by management.

Forgen Overview

Forgen is a leading geotechnical and specialty civil construction company operating across North America. We are dedicated to delivering innovative solutions for complex civil, geotechnical, and environmental challenges, guided by our core values: We Do What We Say, We Are Passionate About Our Work, We Are One Team, We Work Smart, and We Do The Right Thing.

Key Responsibilities

• Draft plans, and detailed drawings for specialty projects, such as- Civil Construction, Environmental Remediation, Demolition, and Geotechnical Construction.

• Interpret engineering PDF plan sets, rough sketches or notes, to produce drawings using computer assisted drafting systems (CAD), mainly: AutoCAD Civil 3D, and Agtek.

• Incorporate data from topographical surveys, and geophysical reports to prepare drawings.

• Calculate weights, “cut and fill” volumes, and stress factors and their implications for technical aspects of designs. Make calculations for excavation tonnage, and earth-moving operations.

• Use mathematics to solve problems, and the knowledge of arithmetic, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, statistics, and their applications.

• Prepare drawing “take-offs” calculating construction volume quantities from existing design drawings.

• Draw technical cross-sections, plan and profiles, topographical 3D contour surfaces, grading excavation, demolition plans, site plans, maps, diagrams, using engineering plans, surveys, and field data.

• Draw slurry walls, cut-off wall profiles, elevations, and submittal drawings.

• Draw proposed truck haul-route plans, staging area, and traffic control plan drawings.

• Create Excel spreadsheets, for Volume calculations, Stations, Northing & Easting, Elevations, Point descriptions, etc. Create and manipulate comma delimited text files for transferal to field personnel or third-party engineering.

• Create CAD Template Styles for drawings, Title-Blocks, and implement CAD Standard procedures.

• Write reports and written procedures using Microsoft Word.

• Prepare As-Built documentation for submittal processes; calculate final As-Built quantities for payment submittals.

• Estimate quantities from design drawings, to be used for bidding projects, and prepare proposal drawings, along with technical documentation.

• Assist Project Managers with field design changes, engineering change orders on projects, and provide adjustments as necessary.

• Explain drawings to production or construction teams and interact with engineering personnel.

• Create work project binders; create CDs for all projects; file documentation; plot / print drawings sets.

• Organize the electronic file directory structure, clean-up, catalog projects, and archive directories.

• Strong technical skills, including Microsoft Office proficiency and knowledge of data collection and analysis.

• Expertise in the Land Survey industry and problem-solving, with the ability to manage priorities effectively.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in CAD Technology, drafting, or a related field.

• One to three years of experience as a CAD Technician within the engineering or construction industry.

• Experience with CAD drawing systems, such as AutoCAD Civil 3D.

• Valid Driver’s License and ability to drive on behalf of company business.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Trimble Business Center preferred.

• Company will provide additional training, as necessary.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This office-based role requires frequent computer use and effective communication, with occasional travel to project sites as needed. Site visits may involve extended periods of standing or walking and required PPE, with potential exposure to heavy equipment, chemicals, dust, fumes, uneven terrain, and extreme weather.

This job description outlines the general scope of work and is not exhaustive. Employees may be assigned additional duties as needed. Requirements may be adjusted to accommodate disabilities, except where they pose a direct safety risk.

Perks and Benefits

Forgen offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement plans, bonuses, paid time off, and more. We support a flexible work model for most non-craft positions and provide additional perks like education assistance, wellness programs, and employee awards.

Equal Opportunity

Forgen is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any legally protected status.

Privacy Policy

At Forgen, we are committed to protecting your privacy. We collect and use your personal data to manage the recruitment process, including assessing your application, verifying information, and, if applicable, entering into an employment contract. Your information may be shared with authorized third parties who perform services on our behalf, such as background checks, and only where permitted by law. We implement appropriate security measures to safeguard your information and retain it only as long as necessary for recruitment and legal purposes.

You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, and to withdraw your consent at any time where applicable. For questions or to exercise your rights, please contact hr@forgen.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Web, CMS, E-commerce
jobs.description:
Who we are…

Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best-in-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery.

Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2029.

The role...

The Senior Manager - Web, CMS, E-commerce is the senior product owner for CST’s core content and commerce platforms: Contentstack (headless CMS) and commercetools (composable commerce). This role sets the strategic vision and direction for both platforms and is fully accountable for their roadmaps and business outcomes, shaping how CST creates, manages, and delivers scientific content and product information, and how customers discover and buy products online across CST’s global web properties.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned product leader from a catalog-oriented business (large, attribute-rich product catalogs with frequent new product introductions) who can turn business strategy into a clear, prioritized platform roadmap and partner effectively with IT, Research, and Commercial stakeholders. Experience in life sciences or another scientific industry is a plus.

This role owns Contentstack and commercetools within CST’s headless, API-first web architecture and partners with the teams that own connected enterprise systems on integration. The role manages one direct report who owns SEO/GEO/AIO, paid search (PPC), and web analytics; this role is accountable for the results of those programs and integrates them into the overall web strategy. This position reports to the Senior Director of Web and is located onsite at our Danvers, MA headquarters.

You'll have the opportunity to...

Platform Strategy & Roadmap (20%)

• Own the strategic vision, multi-year roadmap, and business case for CST’s CMS (Contentstack) and e-commerce platform (commercetools), aligned to Marketing, Commercial, and company objectives.

• Build and present business cases for major initiatives, including projected ROI, required resources, and defined success metrics. Be the internal expert on CST’s digital customers, competitive landscape, and market trends; synthesize research into insights that inform platform strategy.

• Define how content, product, and commerce capabilities work together across CST’s global web properties (including .com, .cn, and .jp), balancing global consistency with regional requirements.

• Guide the evolution of the Contentstack and commercetools architecture in partnership with Engineering and IT.

• Partner with the teams that own connected enterprise systems (e.g., site search, digital asset management, ERP) to define web integration requirements and keep integrations reliable.

• Contribute platform expertise to system-of-record decisions for commerce data such as pricing, availability, and product content, and implement those decisions on the CMS and e-commerce platforms.

• Evaluate emerging capabilities (e.g., AI-driven product discovery, guided selling, personalization) and recommend where and when to invest.

• Manage platform vendor and implementation partner relationships, including licensing, renewals, SOWs, and roadmap alignment.

CMS Product Ownership – Contentstack (20%)

• Own the Contentstack platform strategy, content models, and authoring experience to enable fast, consistent, and compliant publishing.

• Partner with content, design, and engineering teams to evolve the component library and page templates, prioritizing reuse and scalability.

• Define and enforce content governance, workflows, roles and permissions, and localization processes for multi-language, multi-region sites.

• Drive measurable improvements in time-to-publish, author efficiency, and content quality, including translation and localization tooling.

E-commerce Product Ownership – commercetools (20%)

• Own the commercetools platform strategy and the transactional experience it powers, including cart, checkout, order history, and account features.

• Partner with the owner of site search and product detail pages so that discovery and product pages connect seamlessly to the buying experience.

• Partner with Product Data and Commercial teams to execute their requirements for catalog structure, product data presentation, pricing, promotions, and availability display, translating them into platform capabilities and delivery plans.

• Shape capabilities for B2B and institutional buyers, such as account-based pricing, quotes, punchout/eProcurement, and support for direct and distributor market models.

• Ensure the platform scales to support a high volume of new product introductions each year with accurate, timely product information.

Delivery & Agile Leadership (15%)

• Own and prioritize the CMS and e-commerce product backlogs based on strategic goals, business impact, and technical feasibility.

• Ensure epics and user stories have clear acceptance criteria, and work with engineering leads on capacity planning so the roadmap stays realistic and sprint-ready.

• Oversee user acceptance testing, release readiness, launch documentation and training, and post-launch hypercare.

• Manage platform budgets and track delivery against roadmap commitments.

Digital Performance & Accountability (15%)

• Take full accountability for web and e-commerce KPIs (e.g., conversion rate, online revenue, organic and AI search visibility, time-to-publish, site performance), and clearly explain the reasons for both success and shortfalls.

• Set direction for and oversee the direct report who owns SEO, generative and AI search optimization (GEO/AIO), paid search (PPC), and web analytics, including agency partners, ensuring these programs align with platform priorities.

• Ensure a consistent measurement framework across the web properties so that platform investments, releases, and campaigns can be evaluated against business outcomes.

• Conduct post-launch analysis comparing actual impact to projections, and feed learnings into the next iteration of the roadmap.

• Ensure platform adherence to web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), SEO, performance, privacy, and security standards.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management (10%)

• Lead, coach, and develop a direct report, delegating feature ownership and building capabilities.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for CMS and e-commerce priorities with Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Customer Service, Product Data, R&D, Operations, IT, and regional teams.

• Communicate roadmap, status, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders and senior leadership, and manage expectations against strategic priorities and resource constraints.

Who you are and what you bring to the team...

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 5–7 years of product ownership or product management experience for web, CMS, and/or e-commerce platforms in a catalog-oriented business (e.g., large, attribute-rich product catalogs with frequent new product introductions).

• Hands-on product ownership experience with:A headless CMS platform (Contentstack strongly preferred; Contentful, Sanity, or similar considered) A headless/composable commerce platform (commercetools strongly preferred; similar considered)

• Demonstrated success defining and delivering a multi-year platform roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes, including building business cases with ROI and success metrics.

• Experience managing people and/or leading cross-functional delivery teams.

• Strong understanding of headless/composable, API-first architectures, including how CMS and commerce platforms integrate with other enterprise systems.

• Experience with B2B e-commerce requirements (e.g., account-based pricing, quoting, punchout/eProcurement).

• Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including backlog prioritization and management in Jira or similar tools.

• Experience managing vendor and agency relationships, including SOWs, licensing, and budgets.

• Working knowledge of SEO, generative and AI search optimization (GEO/AIO), paid search, and web analytics, enough to set direction and hold owners accountable for results.

• Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and site performance best practices.

• Strong analytical skills with a data-driven approach to decisions.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical teams and influence without direct authority.

Ideally, you have...

• Experience in life sciences, biotech, pharmaceutical, or another scientific or regulated industry.

• Experience with product information management (PIM) and catalog data models for complex, technical products.

• Experience with online product discovery, including AI-driven discovery or guided selling.

• Experience supporting multi-region, multi-language, or multi-currency websites, including China.

• Experience leading a replatforming or major website redesign.

• Product management certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM, Pragmatic Institute).

Physical Conditions/Physical Requirements...

• Work environment is typically quiet for independent desk work and virtual meetings.

• The ability to perform repetitive motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers.

• The ability to extend hands and arms in any direction to access materials, equipment, or a keyboard.

• The ability to sit for long periods of time (often more than 70% of the workday).

• Ability to view and read information from a computer monitor, reports, and documents.

• Physically able to safely lift and carry 25 pounds to move, install, unpack PC equipment, office supplies, etc. as required

This position has a starting base salary range of $166,000 - $212,000 per year, which the company, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

What we offer...

At Cell Signaling Technology (CST), we recognize that people will always be our most important asset. Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. We recognize that the  development of people is the key to their happiness and thus ensure every employee has impactful discussions with their manager and develops actionable performance and professional development plans. Lastly, we are committed to engaging and supporting our employees in committees and philanthropy that benefit their local communities and environment through community investment programs.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)

About the Team

Our team is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.

About the role

On the Discovery team at Anthropic, we're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.

To achieve these goals, we're seeking exceptional machine learning researchers with deep expertise in training and evaluating frontier models. In this role, you'll work end to end across the model stack, developing training environments, rewards, data, and evaluations that measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks, and carrying what works into production training runs. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and that learn from real-world feedback. A background in engineering or the sciences is a plus but not required.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build, and study reinforcement learning environments, rewards, and training data that improve Claude's capabilities in engineering and the applied sciences

• Create benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that measure model performance on realistic engineering and scientific workflows

• Develop simulation-based training environments and verifiers, working with domain experts to validate them against real-world data

• Develop approaches to long-horizon task completion, multi-agent collaboration, and complex reasoning essential for real engineering and research work

• Research how models can learn efficiently from experiments and real-world feedback.

• Study how environments and rewards behave in large-scale training, including robustness, calibration, and generalization, so that training produces models that are both capable and well aligned

• Scale research ideas from prototype to production training runs

• Collaborate with domain experts and industry partners to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and turn that feedback into training and evaluation signal

• Help chart how Claude’s engineering capabilities reach real-world use: where they matter most, what stands in the way of adoption, and how that should shape research priorities

You may be a good fit if you have:

• Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX

• Hands-on experience training or evaluating machine learning models

• Track record of machine learning research: forming hypotheses, designing and running experiments, and drawing sound conclusions from the results

• Ability to implement your own research ideas and diagnose problems in complex systems

• Ability to learn unfamiliar technical fields quickly and work productively with experts in them

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving problems

• Excitement about improving Claude’s scientific capabilities and the downstream impact on science and technology

• Commitment to developing AI that is safe and beneficial

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience with reinforcement learning and pre-training on large language models, including environment and reward design

• Familiarity with large-scale language model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines

• Published research or practical experience in AI for science or engineering, or in long-horizon reasoning

• A degree or work experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, systems, or manufacturing engineering, applied physics, or computational simulation

• Experience building simulators, surrogate models, or simulation-based environments and verifiers, and calibrating and validating them against real-world data

• Experience with large-scale data pipelines and technical or multimodal datasets

• Demonstrated ability to work across multiple domains, such as language modeling, systems engineering, and scientific computing

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$350,000—$500,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Responsibilities

• Conduct daily facility inspections to identify safety, maintenance, cleanliness, and operational issues and ensure a safe, clean, and productive work environment.

• Coordinate and manage corrective and preventive work orders, including follow-up with internal staff, building management, vendors, and contractors to ensure timely resolution.

• Serve as a point of contact for employees, vendors, contractors, building management, ownership, and senior management regarding facility-related matters.

• Coordinate workplace services including meeting preparation, conference rooms, food services, parking, vending, site access, and other employee amenities.

• Coordinate and support corporate events, including events occurring outside normal business hours or at off-site locations.

• Assist with the development and management of facility operating budgets, review expenses, monitor vendor costs, and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

• Develop and maintain effective working relationships with Administration, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, IT, Security, and other departments.

• Maintain a professional, service-oriented approach when interacting with employees, vendors, contractors, building management, and senior leadership.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in commercial property management, facilities management, building operations, or a related field preferred.

• Working knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life safety, and other MEP systems.

• Strong understanding of commercial office building operations and property management practices.

• Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and customer-service skills.

• Valid, clean driver’s license in Massachusetts is required.

• This position requires exerting up to 40 pounds of force in order to lift, carry, pull or remove objects.

• Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Office (specifically Excel and Word).

• Ability to work flexible hours, and weekends if needed.

InterSystems is providing a current good faith estimate of the anticipated base salary range for this position depending on a variety of factors including experience, education, skills, and performance.

Other compensation may include a discretionary annual variable target incentive.

The company also provides generous employee benefits including:

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance

• Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance

• 401(k) Profit Sharing Contribution

• Paid Time Off and Holidays

• Parental Leave

• Tuition reimbursement

The estimated hourly compensation range for this role is:

$43.59—$66.67 USD

About InterSystems

InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit InterSystems.com.

AI Disclaimer

InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information).  InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.

Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience.  AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.

Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is strictly prohibited during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.  Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department prior to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.

jobs.title: Central Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Medsien is the leading provider of scalable remote care management for a quality patient experience. Hundreds of organizations trust Medsien’s unparalleled technology solutions to implement exceptional remote care management programs, personalize every interaction, and improve the lives of the people who need it most. Based in San Francisco and venture-backed by top-tier investors, Medsien was founded to reimagine remote care management.

More than 60% of all U.S. adults—over 150 million people—live with at least one chronic condition, which requires dedicated, ongoing medical support outside the four walls of their doctor’s office. And yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes, putting their health at significant risk. Together, we can save lives and create a real impact.

Medsien is a venture-backed healthcare SaaS company experiencing rapid growth and looking to expand its team. We are seeking an organized, motivated, and passionate Central Support Specialist to join our team of talented and inspiring colleagues in a fast-paced environment.

As a Central Support Specialist, you will support daily operations and help ensure requests and inquiries are handled promptly and professionally. You will coordinate with teams across the organization, such as sales, product, engineering, and operations, to route requests to the right people and follow up until they are resolved. The ideal candidate is a practical problem-solver who communicates clearly, stays organized, and brings structure and teamwork to cross-functional work.

Key Responsibilities

• Support day-to-day communications and operational needs.

• Provide professional and timely assistance with general inquiries.

• Coordinate requests with appropriate teams and resources.

• Maintain accurate records and support follow-up as needed.

• Assist with administrative tasks and internal coordination.

• Identify concerns or opportunities for improvement and share them with the appropriate team.

• Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.

• Take on additional responsibilities as organizational needs evolve.

Qualifications / Skills

• A friendly, professional, and customer-focused approach.

• Strong communication and listening skills.

• Good judgment and a practical approach to problem-solving.

• Organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

• Flexibility when managing multiple priorities.

• Reliability and a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfort working independently and collaboratively.

• Openness to learning new tools and processes.

• Previous experience in customer service, administrative support, operations, healthcare, or a related field preferred.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Comfortable using computers and learning new systems.

• Ability to manage tasks accurately and efficiently.

• A positive attitude and commitment to providing dependable support.

Benefits we offer

• Competitive salary

• Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Generous tiered PTO policies

• Remote work opportunity

• High level of autonomy

• Training, mentorship, and coaching from leadership

Our Process

We’ll review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short-listed candidate, we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don’t get a call, please don’t be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and must prioritize who we speak to.

Employment at Medsien is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Thank you for taking the time to apply for a position at Medsien!

• Provides educational materials and methods appropriate to the patient’s level of understanding and motivation as evidenced by chart review, observation and team feedback.
• Participates in committees, department processes and special projects in accordance with clinical expertise and individual performance plan.
• Works to develop and maintain professional relationships with members of healthcare teams (ex: physician, nurse, case manager). Participates in internal and external marketing per department expectations.
• Creates a culture of respectful communication by listening, asking for team member input, open and honest conversation, approachability, and timely acknowledgement of individual and team contributions.
• Accepts constructive feedback and can make timely changes as evidenced by written coaching forms/chart audits and team feedback.
• Proactively completes non-patient care responsibilities within established timelines (coverage notes, PTO/schedule change requests, bonus pay (forms and follow up phone calls).
• Contributes to educational efforts of department/clinic (e.g., in-services, journal clubs, new hire orientation, PI) as per department expectations.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer / AI-Native Tech Lead (Backend, iGaming)
jobs.description:
We are toogeza, a Ukrainian recruiting company that is focused on hiring talents and building teams for tech startups worldwide. People make a difference in the big game, and we may help to find the right ones.

We're currently looking for a Founding Engineer / AI-Native Tech Lead (Backend, iGaming) to work on an iGaming project.

Location: Limassol, Cyprus

Type: Full-time

About the client’s company:

iGaming company operating a portfolio of B2C online casino brands across international markets. They’re launching a new initiative focused on developing a sophisticated, multi-layered gamification system designed to enhance player engagement, retention, and the overall gaming experience.



We’re looking for a Founding Engineer / AI-Native Tech Lead to take full technical ownership of this initiative — from architecture and system design to hands-on development and delivery.

This is an opportunity to build a complex technical solution from the ground up, work directly with the CEO, and potentially grow an engineering team as the project evolves.





WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

The core challenge is to build a scalable gamification layer that integrates with existing third-party casino platforms.

The system will introduce advanced gaming mechanics, including PvP, missions, builder-style features, progression systems, and other engagement tools designed to drive player activity and retention.

Rather than developing a new casino platform, you’ll be extending existing products with complex gaming logic and integrations, using AI-assisted development as a core part of the engineering process.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the backend architecture and hands-on development of a complex gamification system.

 - Translate game design documents and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 - Build gaming mechanics, player engagement features, and lifecycle tracking systems.

 - Design integrations with casino platforms, PAM systems, and third-party services through APIs, webhooks, and event-driven processes.

 - Develop reliable, high-load backend systems with a strong focus on performance, security, and data consistency.

 - Leverage AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to code review.

 - Make independent technical decisions and potentially help build the engineering team as the project grows.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7–10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally at Senior, Staff, or hands-on Tech Lead level, with a track record of delivering production-grade systems.

 - Strong backend expertise with TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, or a comparable technology stack.

 - Hands-on experience building gaming or gamification systems, including mechanics such as PvP, missions, progression, rewards, or similar features.

 - Experience with high-load, event-driven, and distributed architectures, complex business logic, state machines, and multi-tenant SaaS systems.

 - Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, asynchronous processing, concurrency, transactions, and data consistency.

 - Experience with third-party integrations, REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, authentication, and secure backend development.

 - Practical experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), monitoring, and observability.

 - Proven experience using AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) for real-world software development, including AI-generated code testing and review.

 - Ability to work independently, own architectural decisions, and deliver complex solutions end-to-end.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in iGaming/casino products, including PAM or casino platform integrations.

 - Understanding of RNG-based gaming mechanics and player retention strategies.

 - Previous experience as a Founding Engineer or hands-on technical lead.

 - Familiarity with React/Next.js and frontend-backend integration.
   
   


HIRING PROCESS

 1. Introductory interview with the recruitment team.

 2. Technical assignment (potentially paid for selected candidates).

 3. Technical interview with the engineering team.

 4. Final interview with company leadership.
    

What’s next?

If this role sounds like a fit — we’d love to hear from you! Just send over your CV and anything else you’d like us to consider.

We’ll review everything within five working days, and if your background matches what we’re looking for, we’ll get in touch to set up a call and get to know each other better.

The Physical Therapist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• A licensed physical therapist who complies with the Code of Ethics/Standards of Practice as outlined by their professional organization and by the State of Illinois.

• Serves as a role model for all therapists and clinical interns in all aspects of professional, clinical, communication, education and leadership activities.

Responsibilities:

• Demonstrates the four NM values of teamwork, patients first, integrity, and excellence in daily work and interactions.
• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions to help patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Maintains primary responsibility over patient plan of care through timely and consistent collaboration with treating PT/ PTA s.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates creative problem solving and diversity when adapting the treatment to special circumstances as evidence by team feedback and documentation.
• Demonstrates essential skill competencies in selecting the appropriate evaluation in the use of treatment modalities, equipment and protocols. Performs re-evaluations according to department guidelines, adjusting the treatment plan accordingly. Evidenced by chart review.

• Participates in committees, department processes and special projects in accordance with clinical expertise and individual performance plan.
