jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager - Telehealth
jobs.description:
About the role:

The Customer Experience Manager is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and performance of Patiently's customer experience function. This role leads the frontline support operation and ensures patients receive timely, accurate, and empathetic support while maintaining the quality and consistency required in a healthcare environment. The Manager is accountable for team performance, staffing, service levels, quality, training, coaching, and escalations, and serves as the primary CX partner across Clinical, Pharmacy, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal/Compliance, and third-party vendors. As Patiently continues to scale, this role will identify where processes are breaking down, understand what is driving customer contacts and escalations, and turn those insights into improvements across the broader patient experience.

Key responsibilities:

• Lead the day-to-day Customer Experience organization and establish clear expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, customer experience, and follow-through.

• Manage, coach, and develop CX team members through regular one-on-ones, performance conversations, feedback, and development planning. Address performance issues directly and partner with HR when additional support or formal action is needed.

• Own the overall health of the support operation across phone, chat, and email, including queue volume, backlog, staffing coverage, service levels, and emerging support trends.

• Forecast staffing and coverage needs using contact volume, service-level performance, seasonality, and business changes. Recommend scheduling adjustments, workflow changes, temporary support, or additional headcount when needed.

• Own significant or recurring customer issues that require coordination beyond the frontline team, including clinical workflow errors, pharmacy fulfillment or shipping delays, vendor failures, checkout or sign-up issues, payment errors, and marketing communication concerns.

• Partner with Clinical, Pharmacy, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal/Compliance, and third-party vendors to determine root cause, establish ownership, and drive issues through resolution.

• Identify patterns across individual tickets and escalations that may signal a broader product, workflow, vendor, training, or operational issue.

• Own the CX escalation framework and determine when sensitive or high-risk issues require involvement from senior leadership, Legal/Compliance, Clinical teams, or outside partners.

• Step directly into complex or emotionally charged patient interactions when necessary, ensuring responses are empathetic, consistent, and appropriate for the level of risk involved.

• Own the quality assurance program, including quality standards, review processes, scoring consistency, coaching expectations, and documentation.

• Use QA findings to identify individual performance opportunities as well as broader gaps in training, workflows, policies, tools, or customer communications.

• Own onboarding and ongoing development for CX employees. Ensure new hires receive consistent training and are prepared to independently manage customer interactions before completing onboarding.

• Ensure internal SOPs, agent macros, training materials, and public-facing Help Center content remain accurate as Patiently's products, vendors, policies, and workflows evolve.

• Track and communicate key CX metrics and trends, including service levels, response times, backlog, quality, contact drivers, escalation trends, and customer pain points.

• Translate frontline feedback and support data into clear insights and recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.

• Identify opportunities to reduce avoidable customer contacts through improvements to the product, patient journey, communications, automation, and internal processes.

• Build repeatable processes that allow the CX organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity, while remaining close enough to frontline work to understand what agents and patients are experiencing.

What you'll need:

• Minimum of 4+ years of experience in customer support, customer experience, or contact center operations, including 2+ years of direct people management experience.

• Experience managing a frontline support team with accountability for performance, quality, coaching, staffing, and service levels.

• Experience in healthcare, telehealth, insurance, pharmacy, or another compliance-sensitive environment strongly preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to investigate ambiguous issues, determine root causes, and drive cross-functional resolution.

• Proven experience managing high-stakes or emotionally sensitive customer escalations with sound judgment and empathy.

• Experience building or managing quality assurance, training, onboarding, and performance management processes.

• Ability to use operational metrics to make staffing, workflow, and performance decisions and communicate recommendations to leadership.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with senior leaders, external vendors, and cross-functional partners.

• Experience with Zendesk or a comparable customer support platform, along with confidence working across reporting, documentation, and communication tools.

• Entrepreneurial and solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to lead through changing processes, tools, priorities, and business needs.

• Ability to manage multiple active priorities without losing track of ownership, follow-through, or deadlines.

Note for Current Employees:

Please use the internal job board in Greenhouse to apply. Applications submitted through this external link will not be tagged as internal.

Compensation, Benefits, & Additional Details:

Health-E Commerce's compensation philosophy is grounded in market data and internal equity to ensure fairness and consistency across the team. Individuals new to the company should generally expect offers to fall between the entry point and midpoint of the salary range.  Our goal is to provide an offer that supports growth potential within the role and allows for future salary progression.

• Compensation: $80,000 - $100,000

• Discretionary Annual Bonus Eligibility: Up to 15%

• Medical, Dental, Vision, and 401K with a company match

• Dependent Care, FSA & HSA accounts

• Paid Parental & Bonding Leave

• Flexible PTO & office closure on all major holidays

• Monthly wellness & internet reimbursements

• Professional development including certification support & leadership coaching

• Mental Health resources

• 100% remote within the United States

• Must be able to work EST hours

Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Pool Technician
jobs.description:
**Position: Pool Technician**

**Location: Mercure Kooddoo, Maldives**

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Pool Technician to join our Engineering team at Mercure Kooddoo, Maldives. In this role, you will be responsible for the efficient operation, maintenance, and repair of our resort's swimming pool facilities. You will play a crucial part in ensuring that our guests enjoy a safe, clean, and well-maintained aquatic environment while upholding the highest standards of water quality and safety compliance. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional service in a tropical resort setting.

• Monitor, clean, and maintain all assigned swimming pools to ensure they meet resort standards and guest expectations
• Conduct daily water quality testing (pH, chlorine levels, alkalinity) and maintain detailed records of all test results and maintenance activities
• Maintain water quality at required standard levels and adjust chemical treatments as needed to ensure safe swimming conditions
• Inspect pool areas regularly to identify and address potential hazards, ensuring a safe environment for all guests and staff
• Perform preventive maintenance on pool equipment, including filters, pumps, dosing systems, and chlorinators to maximize efficiency and longevity
• Execute necessary repairs to pool systems and equipment, troubleshooting issues and implementing solutions in a timely manner
• Monitor water consumption and report any abnormalities or leaks to the Director of Engineering immediately
• Manage inventory of pool maintenance materials and chemicals, tracking stock levels and placing orders as needed
• Maintain proper care and organization of all tools, equipment, and materials used in pool operations
• Communicate effectively with team members, guests, and management to ensure satisfaction and address concerns promptly
• Keep detailed work logs and maintain comprehensive records of all maintenance, repairs, and inspections performed
• Adhere to all company safety guidelines and current health and safety regulations related to pool operations
• Respond promptly to emergency situations, including equipment failures or environmental hazards
• Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free working environment at all times
• Perform additional duties and follow instructions as assigned by management to support operational needs
• Demonstrate flexibility in scheduling and willingness to work extended hours when required

**Required Skills & Experience:**

• Proven experience in pool maintenance, operation, and water treatment
• Sound knowledge of pool treatment chemicals and water quality management
• Proficiency in testing and analyzing pool water chemistry
• Basic knowledge of plumbing and electrical systems related to pool equipment
• Experience with preventive maintenance and equipment repair (filters, pumps, dosing systems, chlorinators)
• Demonstrated ability to maintain detailed records and documentation
• Inventory management and stock control experience
• Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, proactive approach
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members
• Physical capability to perform manual labor and maintenance tasks
• Time management and organizational skills with attention to detail
• Ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently under pressure

**Required Knowledge & Certifications:**

• Comprehensive knowledge of health and safety regulations related to pool operations and maintenance
• Familiarity with tropical climate considerations for pool maintenance (preferred)
• Pool technician certification or equivalent training (preferred)

**Personal Attributes:**

• Self-motivated and proactive with a goal-oriented mindset
• Energetic, dynamic personality with a commitment to excellence
• Resilient and adaptable to changing operational needs
• Customer-focused approach to guest satisfaction
• Strong safety awareness and commitment to compliance
• Collaborative team player who supports colleagues
• Organized and detail-oriented in all aspects of work
• Flexible and willing to embrace new techniques and innovations in pool maintenance

What is in it for you:

• Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor Hotels Worldwide
• Develop your talent through learning programs by Academy Accor
• Opportunity to grow within your property and across the world!
• Ability to contribute to local community and make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.

Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

jobs.title: L2/L3 Technical Support with MailPool
jobs.description:
TITLE: L2/L3 TECHNICAL SUPPORT SPECIALIST

Location: Remote, Latin America 
Schedule: Full-time, aligned with US business hours
Compensation: $1,500–$2,000/month, depending on experience
Engagement: Direct Hire


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Technical Support Specialist to join a growing technology company and provide advanced technical support to partners, resellers, and direct customers.

This role will focus on investigating technical issues, troubleshooting product-related bugs, analyzing system logs, and resolving complex support escalations. The ideal candidate has a strong technical troubleshooting background, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

This is a hands-on technical support position, not a software development role. You will serve as an escalation point for issues that require deeper technical investigation beyond standard customer support.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Handle Level 2 and Level 3 technical support escalations from partners, resellers, and direct customers.

 - Investigate technical issues, reproduce bugs, analyze system logs, and identify potential root causes.

 - Troubleshoot complex product and platform-related issues and coordinate findings with the appropriate internal teams.

 - Manage technical escalations from partner and reseller channels, as well as technical support inquiries escalated by the Customer Support team through Intercom.

 - Communicate technical findings, troubleshooting steps, and resolution updates clearly through Slack, email, and other messaging channels.

 - Document investigations, recurring issues, and troubleshooting procedures to improve internal support processes.

 - Follow up on unresolved issues and ensure escalations are properly tracked through resolution.

 - Occasionally join calls with customers or partners when technical discussions require direct communication.


IDEAL CANDIDATE

 - 3+ years of experience in Technical Support, preferably in L2/L3 support, SaaS, email technology, or a related technical environment.

 - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex technical issues, investigating bugs, and analyzing system logs.

 - Strong understanding of networking and email-related technologies.

 - Familiarity with DNS, SMTP, email infrastructure, and cold email systems is highly preferred.

 - Experience supporting technical products, SaaS platforms, or partner/reseller ecosystems.

 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Comfortable handling escalations independently and communicating primarily through Slack, email, and messaging platforms.

 - Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.

 - Able to work full-time during US business hours.

 - Must be based in Latin America.


TECHNICAL SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

Required:

 - L2/L3 technical troubleshooting and escalation management

 - Bug investigation and root-cause analysis

 - System log analysis

 - Technical documentation and incident reporting

 - Strong written and verbal English communication

Preferred:

 - DNS configuration and troubleshooting

 - SMTP and email delivery protocols

 - Cold email infrastructure and platforms

 - SaaS technical support

 - Intercom or similar customer support platforms

 - Slack and other remote collaboration tools



#LI-NC1

jobs.title: Nursing Academic Advisor
jobs.description:
About Stepful:



Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.


Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.


Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.


Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-55m-series-c-to-scale-its-ai-powered-training-platform-across-the-healthcare-workforce. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025 https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list.



Our values:



We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

 - Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

 - Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.

 - Build together: We win when we rely on each other.

 - Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.



The opportunity:

The Nursing Academic Advisor/Success Coach will play a critical role in supporting LPN students throughout their hybrid nursing program, serving as a consistent source of academic guidance, accountability, and encouragement from enrollment through program completion. This role will build strong relationships with students, proactively identify barriers to success, and partner closely with the Nursing and Student Success teams to help students stay on track academically and progress toward graduation and NCLEX-PN readiness. Success in this role will be measured in large part by student retention and progression, which will be co-owned by the Nursing Academic Advisor and Director of Nursing.



This is a full-time contract role, 100% remote position with availability required during business hours between 9:00 AM–7:00 PM ET.



What you’ll do:

Student Advising & Support

 - Serve as the primary academic support and point of contact for a caseload of LPN students.

 - Conduct regular 1:1 meetings to monitor academic progress, address challenges, reinforce expectations, and create actionable success plans.

 - Proactively identify students at risk of falling behind and provide timely interventions, accountability, and follow-up.

 - Support students with study strategies, test preparation, time management, clinical readiness, and NCLEX-PN preparation.



Student Retention & Collaboration

 - Own student retention outcomes in partnership with the Director of Nursing, using student engagement and performance data to inform interventions.

 - Partner with Nursing, Clinical, Student Success, and Operations teams to address student needs and remove barriers to progression.

 - Maintain accurate documentation of student interactions, progress, interventions, and outcomes.

 - Identify trends in student challenges and share insights that can improve the student experience and program outcomes.



What you’ll bring:

 - Active, unrestricted LPN/LVN or RN license in good standing.

 - Nursing education, advising, student support, mentorship, precepting, or related experience.

 - Excellent communication, organization, time management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to hold students accountable while maintaining a supportive approach.

 - Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and availability to work full-time within 9:00 AM–7:00 PM ET business hours.



Bonus points if:

 - Previous experience as nursing faculty, clinical instructor, academic advisor, student success coach, or nursing program coordinator.

 - Experience supporting students in an online, hybrid, or competency-based nursing program.

 - Experience with NCLEX-PN preparation, remediation, ATI/VATI, or similar nursing education platforms.

 - Experience using student performance or engagement data to identify and intervene with at-risk students.

 - Experience working in EdTech, healthcare education, or a fast-paced environment.



Interview Process:

 - Initial Recruiter Screen – 30-minute conversation focused on background, interest, and role expectations.

 - Hiring Manager Interview – Discussion of nursing experience, student support approach, and alignment with the role.

 - Cross-Functional (Final) Interview – Conversation with Nursing and/or Student Success team members focused on collaboration and student outcomes.
   
   - Student Support Scenario – Practical exercise or role-play focused on responding to a challenging student situation.



The hourly rate range for this opportunity is $35/hour - $38/hour. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, internal pay equity and other relevant business considerations.



Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @stepful.com email address to guide you through our interview process.

The Manager Operations, Oncology Clinical Trial Services reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

In addition, the manager facilitates achievement of Oncology’s goals through coordinating program development efforts in clinical care, research and education. Responsible for coordinating all business services including staff modeling, program budget development, quality reporting and analysis, and financial preparation and analysis as warranted. jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for the person who makes everything — and everyone — at Junior tick. You’ll help make our NYC office a brilliant place to work, bring people together, and keep our CTO’s day running smoothly.

This isn’t a typical Executive Assistant role. Think 80% office, people, events and culture; 20% supporting our CTO.




ABOUT JUNIOR

Junior is building an AI platform for high-stakes investment research. Our customers use it to bring expert interviews, research and AI-powered analysis together in one place — helping them make better-informed investment decisions.

We’ve grown quickly, and we’re just getting started:

 - $30M revenue run rate, with 10× revenue growth in 2025

 - Bootstrapped and profitable, with no outside investors

 - 70+ people across New York, London, Singapore, and Sydney

 - Trusted by 20 of the world’s top 30 private equity funds and 18 of the top 20 strategy consulting firms

 - Saving customers an average of 60 hours per due diligence project




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll own the experience of working in our Flatiron office — from the everyday details that make people feel welcome to the big moments that bring the team together.

You’ll also work directly with Nico, our Co-founder and CTO, helping him stay organised and focused on the work that matters most.

No two days will look the same. You might be welcoming new engineers, planning a company offsite, organising a team dinner, or untangling a calendar puzzle. You’ll spot what needs doing and make it happen.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


MAKE OUR NYC OFFICE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

 - Be the friendly first point of contact for our team, candidates and visitors.

 - Keep the office welcoming, organised and running smoothly.

 - Create thoughtful ways to bring people together and make office life enjoyable.

 - Own relationships with vendors, building management and service providers.


BRING PEOPLE TOGETHER

 - Organise team lunches, socials, celebrations and other events.

 - Plan company events and international off-sites, from venue research to on-the-day details.

 - Make new starters feel at home from day one.

 - Look for opportunities to make the team’s time together more fun and meaningful.


SUPPORT OUR CTO

 - Own Nico’s calendar and help him spend his time on the right priorities.

 - Coordinate meetings, travel and other logistics.

 - Keep track of important communications, follow-ups and commitments.

 - Anticipate scheduling conflicts and other issues before they become problems.

 - Build the trust to take action without needing to be asked twice.


KEEP IMPROVING HOW WE WORK

 - Coordinate office onboarding, equipment, deliveries and workplace logistics.

 - Build simple processes as the company grows.

 - Take ownership of the unexpected challenges that come with startup life — including the occasional coffee machine crisis.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you:

 - Love meeting people and making them feel welcome.

 - Take initiative and follow through without needing much direction.

 - Stay calm and organised when plans change or several things need attention at once.

 - Care about the details, from a new starter’s first day to the flow of an event.

 - Have good judgement, communicate clearly and handle sensitive information with discretion.

 - Bring ideas, a sense of humour and a genuine interest in making work better for the people around you.


EXPERIENCE WE’D LIKE TO SEE

 - 3+ years in executive assistance, office management, workplace experience, people operations or a similar role.

 - Experience organising events, off-sites or team gatherings.

 - Confidence supporting founders or senior leaders and working across teams.

 - Experience in a startup or fast-growing technology company is a plus.

 - Comfort with modern tools and finding practical ways to make work run more smoothly.

Bonus points if you’ve helped scale an office, supported a founder, or worked in AI or another fast-growing technology business. We care more about what you’ve done than the title on your LinkedIn profile.




WHY JUNIOR

You’ll have real ownership and room to shape how our NYC office works as the company grows. You’ll work closely with our founders, get to know people across the business, and have a meaningful hand in the culture we’re building.

We take building a brilliant company seriously. We don’t think that means taking ourselves too seriously.




LOGISTICS

 - Location: Flatiron, New York City

 - Working style: In office, Monday–Friday

 - Salary: $100,000–$150,000 base, depending on experience

 - Benefits: Equity, healthcare and gym benefits, breakfast and lunch in the office, and opportunities to travel for company off-sites

We’re looking for someone who makes new starters feel at home, brings people together and makes the everyday run a little better. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success Technology
jobs.description:
DO YOU GET ENERGIZED BY BUILDING THE SYSTEMS AND AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS THAT HELP A CUSTOMER SUCCESS TEAM DELIVER EXCEPTIONAL SERVICE AT SCALE?






Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a Manager, Customer Success Technology to be part of our Success Operations department.



Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!



Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.



The team:

The Success Operations team is the operational backbone of Jobber's Success organization, spanning three connected pillars: operations, technology, and workforce management. Together, the team equips Customer Success with the people, process, systems, and insights they need to make decisions, scale consistently, and deliver against their goals.



The role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Success Operations, the Manager, Customer Success Technology will own the technology that powers Customer Success teams. This is a hands-on people leader and problem solver who develops technical talent, balances competing priorities, and delivers scalable systems and AI-first solutions.



The Manager, Customer Success Technology will:

 - Manage and develop a team of CS Tech Admins, building their skills and technical effectiveness.

 - Champion automation and process improvement by identifying manual work to streamline and prioritizing changes that balance speed, experience, accuracy, and maintainability.

 - Roll out and maintain AI tools and AI-enabled workflows, monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance and business continuity plans.

 - Set the standard for intake, triage, and issue resolution, assessing requests for scope, priority, and business impact and resolving them quickly and effectively.

 - Establish the KPIs and SLAs for CS Tech and hold the team accountable to clear, measurable outcomes.

 - Guide the team's delivery, from configuration changes to minor builds to large transformations, in partnership with Success Operations, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Support complex technology projects from ideation to launch, surfacing technical risks, balancing business needs against technical constraints, and communicating trade-offs.

 - Establish and maintain best practices for technical delivery that make the team's work repeatable and scalable.

 - Own the health, performance, and roadmap of the Customer Success (CS) tech stack, and establish the frameworks and metrics to evaluate its ROI.

 - Manage vendor relationships and licensing across the CS tech stack, making informed decisions that balance capability and cost.

 - Build trusted partnerships with Success leaders, translating their needs into a coherent technology roadmap.
   
   

To be successful, you should have:

 - Demonstrated people leadership experience, with a track record of developing technical talent and building high-performing teams.

 - Experience working with or in a Customer Success organization, including a solid understanding of how Product Support and Onboarding teams operate and how technology helps them scale and deliver outcomes.

 - Extensive experience with customer success tools such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Amazon Connect, Intercom, Assembled, ChiliPiper, Revenue.IO http://Revenue.IO, or similar.

 - Hands-on experience designing, building, and running AI-enabled workflows and agents, including monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance.

 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams on complex technology programs using Agile and Scrum methodologies, along with project and program best practices, tools, and techniques. Agile training and experience preferred.

 - Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

 - The ability to work on multiple projects at once, including establishing new processes and streamlining existing ones.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're growing fast, and what worked yesterday might not work today.

 - A bias toward action, with the judgment to make informed decisions, move work forward, and adapt as new information emerges.
   
   

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $120,870, a midpoint of $142,200, and a maximum salary of $163,530, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!



Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.



What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

jobs.title: Sonographer-Imaging Full time Nights
jobs.description:
**This is a full-time position at 40 hours per week located at our Grayslake Outpatient and Freestanding ER. The schedule for this is Sunday to Thursday, 10:30p to 7am. On call and holiday rotation required. **

The Multispecialty Sonographer reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Perform diagnostic ultrasound examinations across multiple specialties, including abdominal, OB/GYN, vascular, breast, and MSK, in accordance with established standards of practice.
• Review and evaluate imaging requests and patient history to determine appropriate examination protocols and techniques.
• Operate ultrasound equipment and accessories to produce high-quality diagnostic images while minimizing patient exposure.
• Provide patient education before, during, and after procedures to reduce anxiety and improve comfort and cooperation.
• Assess and care for patients throughout the procedure in accordance with department, hospital, and age-specific patient care standards.
• Observe, evaluate, and communicate pertinent clinical findings to radiologists and ordering providers to support diagnosis and treatment.
• Prepare examination rooms and perform set-up and sterile tray preparation, including procedure-specific supplies, medications, guide wires, catheters, and ancillary equipment.
• Assist with patient positioning, lifting, and transport to and from imaging areas as required.
• Accurately document imaging procedures manually and/or electronically to ensure correct patient records, image tracking, and billing.
• Transmit completed studies to PACS and other imaging systems using correct accession numbers.
• Prepare preliminary findings or reports in designated reporting systems and route to interpreting physicians as required.
• Perform vascular ultrasound studies, including lower extremity venous duplex examinations, in accordance with vascular laboratory protocols.
• Communicate acute or critical findings promptly to the ordering provider and document notifications per policy.
• Manage daily worklists and prioritize examinations according to clinical urgency and accepted practices.
• Maintain supply inventory in imaging areas, ensuring availability, proper rotation, and a clean, organized environment.
• Report equipment malfunctions or performance concerns promptly to leadership.
• Support departmental quality improvement initiatives through data collection and process improvement efforts.
• Facilitate continuity of care through effective collaboration with internal and external departments and provider offices.
• Maintain satisfactory productivity, image quality, and customer service standards.
• Participate in continuing education and maintain required professional certifications.
• Provide clinical instruction and supervision to students enrolled in accredited ultrasound programs, as assigned.
• Perform other duties as assigned in support of departmental and organizational goal

#NNW

Education:

• Graduate of an accredited diagnostic sonography program or current, active ARDMS certification applicable to the clinical area of practice at the time of hire.

Certification:

• Certified in two American Registry for Diagnostic Sonographer (ARDMS) areas and one additional ARDMS certification obtained within one year of hire
• Basic Life Support (BLS)

jobs.title: CEI Inspector
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a highly skilled CEI Inspector to join our team and support ongoing construction engineering and inspection efforts in the Atlanta, GA area. This role will play a critical part in ensuring that major transportation and infrastructure projects are delivered in accordance with GDOT standards, contract requirements, and overall project objectives. This is a Part-Time position averaging 20 hours weekly.

• Support higher-level inspectors and engineers in construction inspection, surveying, scheduling, roadway design, traffic signalization, materials sampling, inspection, and testing.
• Perform independent and complex inspections of roadway and structural construction activities to ensure compliance with contract documents, plans, and specifications
• Conduct moderately complex inspections and provide direction or supervision to other inspectors performing routine inspections
• Inspect asphalt and concrete materials and mixes for compliance with project requirements.
• Monitor pavement placement, spreading, rolling, depth, alignment, and compaction
• Inspect roadways and structures for compliance with approved plans and specifications
• Inspect structural materials and construction activities, including culvert placement, foundation excavation, piling, reinforcing steel, structural steel, concrete placement, and backfill
• Monitor traffic control and erosion control devices for compliance with project requirements
• Perform construction-related calculations and computations, including measurements and quantity tracking
• Complete contract documentation, including field measurements of pay items and other required project records
• Participate in concept meetings, preliminary and final field plan reviews, CPM schedule reviews, project close-out activities, and other assigned duties

Minimum Requirements:

• High School Diploma plus 4 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education
• Valid US Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices. As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review

Preferred Qualifications:

• Knowledge of highway construction materials, methods, equipment, and inspection procedures.
• Strong mathematical skills, including geometry and trigonometry
• Ability to read, interpret, and explain construction plans, contract provisions, specifications, and inspection procedures
• Ability to prepare, review, and maintain accurate field notes, reports, and project documentation.
• Proficiency with calculators, computers, office equipment, and basic drafting tools
• Ability to provide guidance and instruction to other employees on proper work methods
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Valid driver's license and ability to operate motor vehicles in accordance with Georgia law

Occasional overnight work and/or assignments outside of employee’s primary location may be required

Relocation assistance is not available for this position

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Manager of Operations (Nursing)-CTICU
jobs.description:
The Manager, Operations reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards. The Manager, Operations provides autonomous and direct management of a team or teams.

Responsibilities:

• Manage day-to-day operations of designated departments, divisions, programs, services and/or locations. This includes defining and overseeing workflows and staffing in the department, re-directing resources to critical areas as needed, developing operating and capital budgets, monitoring budget performance including explaining variances and defining and applying corrective action to ensure compliance with the budget as needed. 24/7 accountability
• Provide support, guidance, and supervision to team members by ensuring that the team members maintain competencies in addressing behavioral, social, financial, and environmental issues for patients to achieve optimum clinical quality, patient satisfaction, and cost-effective care. Support the team by preparing and delivering annual and mid-year reviews, coaching through the resolution of complex situations that involve practice issues and customer relations, ensuring that they have the tools, including technology, to perform their roles and identifying areas in need of improvement and acting upon them with the appropriate NM system partners.
• Recommend department goals to department leadership; plan and advance progress toward the goals throughout the year. Communicate goal achievement timelines, risks and decisions needed with all appropriate leadership teams on a regular cadence.
• Ensure department policies and processes meet current standards of the Joint Commission and all federal, state, and regulations. Revise and/or create new policies and processes as needed to meet changing regulations and the evolution of patient care delivery. Target quality improvement by reducing process variation, eliminating redundancy or implementing new technology.
• To manage escalations, interpret information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to the patient's age-specific needs using principles of growth and development over the life span. Connect those with the resources required to coordinate each patient’s care.
• Other duties as assigned.

Additional Responsibilities:

Business expertise

• Knowledge of Joint Commission standards and all federal, state, and regulatory requirements.
• Ability to analyze data for decision making purposes and make data-driven recommendations.
• Ability to create budgets in accordance with guidelines and balanced to targets.
• Ability to effectively apply the principles of change management while leading.
• Strong computing skills, including Microsoft Office applications, Outlook and the EMR.
• Attentive to detail and reviews own and others’ work for accuracy.

Problem solving

• Effectively and autonomously handles challenging situations, including identifying stakeholders and defining and communicating required action and roles in a compressed time frame.
• Effectively balances multiple priorities, seeking guidance when in doubt.
• Calmly and easily responds to changes in work environment, delays or unexpected events.
• Provides guidance and supervision to team members by problem solving complex situations that involve practice operations, customer relations, and employee relations issues

Interactions/interpersonal skills

• NMHC Performance Leadership Competencies (from performance management system)

jobs.description:

Stage lopen bij JDE Peet's betekent dat je vier dagen in onze comfortabele kantooromgeving doorbrengt en één dag op afstand werkt, wat de perfecte balans tussen samenwerking en onafhankelijkheid biedt. Onze belofte is om je een unieke leerervaring te bieden als onderdeel van ons Global HR-team, waar je waardevolle inzichten opdoet in het beheren van Talent Acquisition-processen en Talent Management-cycli.

Bij JDE Peet’s krijg je de kans om écht het verschil te maken. Je werkt hands-on en kunt je stempel drukken, terwijl je samenwerkt met een team dat gedreven is door één gemeenschappelijk doel. Wij zijn een energiek en snelgroeiend bedrijf, gericht op wat echt belangrijk is. Hier telt lef: het lef om nieuwe ideeën te proberen, om buiten de gebaande paden te denken en om impact te maken.

Heb je een overvloed aan frisse ideeën en ben je leergierig? Dan willen wij jou!

Dit is wat we zoeken:

• Opleiding: Je bent ingeschreven op een HBO, BSc- of MSc-programma gedurende de gehele stage, bij voorkeur in Organizational Studies, HR, Marketing of Communicatie.
• Vaardigheden: Je hebt sterke vaardigheden in MS Office en spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Engels – enige ervaring met HR-activiteiten is altijd een pluspunt.
• Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Je hebt een echte passie voor mensen, een gedreven en energieke persoonlijkheid, uitstekende communicatie- en sociale vaardigheden, en de mogelijkheid om zowel in teamverband als zelfstandig te werken.
• Beschikbaarheid: Je kunt 4 of 5 dagen per week vrijmaken voor de stage voor een periode van minstens 5 maanden.

We hopen je interesse te hebben gewekt! Zorg ervoor dat je ook voldoet aan de academische vereisten:

Je stage moet in je studiecurriculum zijn opgenomen en direct bijdragen aan je resultaten.

Jouw onderwijsinstelling is bereid een samenwerkingsovereenkomst te tekenen met JDE Peet's.

Je bent gedurende de gehele duur van de stage ingeschreven aan een Nederlandse onderwijsinstelling en woonachtig in Nederland

Werken bij JDE Peet’s betekent impact maken in een dynamische en ambitieuze omgeving. Je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s, viert successen en krijgt volop kansen om je verder te ontwikkelen. Iedereen is erop gericht om te doen wat juist is – overal ter wereld. Wat je hier doet, wordt opgemerkt.

Wat levert het jou op?

• Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €525 (fulltime)
• Reiskostenvergoeding als je geen gratis (studenten) OV hebt
• Betaalde vakantiedagen gedurende je stageperiode

Ben je klaar om jouw mogelijkheden binnen JDE Peet's te ontdekken? We zijn benieuwd of je liever koffie of thee hebt tijdens je sollicitatiegesprek!

Dit is hoe je kunt solliciteren:

• Upload je cv.
• Na je sollicitatie nemen we binnen drie weken contact met je op om je te laten weten wat de volgende stappen zijn.
• Tijdens het sollicitatieproces word je gevraagd om een online assessment te doen en minimaal één interview op ons kantoor in Utrecht of Amsterdam.

Als je vragen hebt, aarzel dan niet om contact op te nemen met onze Talent Acquisition stagiair Dounia Addouti via dounia.addouti@jdecoffee.com - We zijn er om te helpen!

Bij JDE Peet’s streven we naar een betere toekomst, waarin we iedereen op een authentieke manier bedienen, weerspiegelen en omarmen. Wij geloven in het bevorderen van een meer diverse, eerlijke en inclusieve organisatie, waar iedereen zich comfortabel voelt om echt zichzelf te zijn en zijn of haar volledige potentieel kan benutten. Dit betekent dat we geen enkele vorm van discriminatie tolereren op basis van ras, etniciteit, geslacht, genderidentiteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie, nationaliteit, leeftijd, beperking of enig ander door de wet beschermd kenmerk.

Tijdens de hele loopbaan van onze medewerkers staat diversiteit, gelijkheid en inclusie (DE&I) centraal in onze personeelsprocessen. Dit stelt ons in staat objectiviteit te waarborgen en mogelijke vooroordelen te elimineren, zodat iedereen een inclusieve ervaring op de werkvloer heeft. Aarzel niet om contact op te nemen als je aanpassingen nodig hebt tijdens het wervingsproces.

Onze inspanningen op dit gebied hebben ons de prestigieuze Catalyst Award opgeleverd, evenals de Fair Pay Leader-certificering in 2025, dankzij een onverklaarde loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen van slechts 0,52%.

jobs.title: Manager, Funds & Institutional (Real Estate)
jobs.description:
OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.description:
Position Objective:

The Breast Surgeon will provide medical services for the designated clinical area [The Breast Center], providing surgical, consultative, and follow-up care for patients with benign and malignant breast disease.

Essential Job Duties:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

• Provides clinical and surgical skills to provide services to patients with breast cancer and benign breast disease.
• Develop and reinforce positive working relationships with the surgical staff of AAMC and employees of The Breast Center.
• Participate in and expand the breast cancer research projects related to breast imaging, surgery, genome tissue banking research, quality of life studies, and breast cancer prevention (i.e.: PET Mammography, breast MRI study, ECOG, DOD, KOMEN, the SEER trial, sentinel node study, etc.).
• Participate with and assist with the development of and expansion of the Risk Assessment Program (RAPP).
• Participate in community outreach in collaboration with the Womens and Childrens Program, the Oncology Program, Wellness and Community Outreach, and the Surgical Initiative.
• Develop positive working relationships with departments who provide services to the Breast Center, including, but not limited to, the Pathology Department, Anne Arundel Diagnostics (AAD), Laboratory, Marketing and Public Relations, Central Sterile Supply, the Clinical Research Staff, the Tumor Registry, Medical Office, and the Surgical Initiative.
• Participate in efforts to maintain excellent (A grade) in patient satisfaction related to services at The Breast Center.
• Collaborate with Radiology and Radiation Oncology Department to integrate digital mammography and APBI/Breast MammoSite, and any new imaging techniques related to breast diagnostics and breast treatments at The Breast Center.
• Collaborate with the Plastic Surgery Service on breast reconstruction program.
• Participate in quality control programs related to The Breast Center activities. This will require coordination with Anne Arundel Medical Centers Cancer Committee. The quality control program will include screening and diagnostic testing by the Department of Radiology, and the Radiation Oncology Department of the DeCesaris Cancer Institute.

Educational/Experience Requirements:

• Active Medical Staff at AAMC in good standing. Trained in a breast Fellowship program. Demonstrates significant skill and success in managing breast disease. Demonstrates significant interest in clinical research in breast cancer prevention, diagnostics, surgery, and treatment.

jobs.title: Fraud Operations Intern
jobs.description:
About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

As a Fraud Operations Intern, you'll join our Shopper Risk Operations team, the people who keep Sezzle safe for shoppers and merchants. You'll review activity flagged by our fraud detection systems and Customer Support, decide what's fraud and what isn't, and help us spot new fraud patterns before they spread. You'll work alongside analysts, data scientists, and engineers, and see how fraud prevention works inside a fast-growing, publicly traded fintech.

We are seeking a talented and motivated intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. No prior fraud experience is required; we'll train you. Curiosity, attention to detail, and good judgment matter more.

This is a paid, full-time, remote internship: Monday to Friday, 12:00 pm to 21:00 pm local time.

What You'll Do

• Review transactions and accounts flagged for possible fraud or abuse

• Investigate cases using our internal tools and policies, and decide whether to block or clear them

• Look for patterns in account and transaction data

• Share what you find to help improve our fraud rules and detection models

• Work through your case queue on time and keep clear notes

• Help resolve escalations from internal teams

What You'll Learn

• How fintech companies detect and prevent fraud, from manual review to machine learning models

• How to investigate cases and make decisions with data

• How risk, operations, data, and engineering teams work together

What We Look For

• Current university student or recent graduate. Industrial or Systems Engineering, Economics, Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Law, and related fields are a great fit

• Strong attention to detail and good judgment

• Comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)

• English at B2 level or higher (written and spoken)

• Clear written communication

• Able to work independently once trained

• Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to boost productivity, research, and communication

Nice to Have

• Coursework or projects involving data analysis (Excel, SQL, or similar)

• Interest in fintech, payments, or cybersecurity

About You

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Fraud Operations Intern is $800 USD gross monthly.

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make:

You'll report to the Product Security Manager and work closely with our Cloud Security and Engineering teams to scale secure software delivery across Upside. This role owns our application security program, reducing real risk across mobile, web, and cloud systems by driving remediation, building engineering guardrails, and creating security guidance that developers actually use.

You'll also work both sides of AI: we use it to do security work, and we secure the AI systems Upside is shipping.

 - Own Upside's application security program, the standards, the vulnerability management pipeline, and the guardrails that stop entire classes of defects from coming back

 - Drive vulnerability management outcomes by triaging and tuning findings from scanning, code review, and our annual penetration test, then partnering with engineering teams to get fixes shipped and verified

 - Lead application security reviews and threat models for high-impact work across mobile, web, backend, and AI systems, and document risk decisions with clear mitigation plans

 - Extend the AI automation that handles our finding volume: triage, prioritization with service context, and remediation guidance engineers can act on

 - Build guardrails that scale beyond our team; repository baselines, required checks in GitHub, secure-by-default patterns for AWS workloads, reusable templates, and a security champions program

What You'll Bring:

 - 6+ years in application or product security, or equivalent depth in secure software engineering with meaningful application security ownership

 - Strong Python code review skills. You can open a Lambda, understand what it does, and explain the defect to the engineer who wrote it

 - A track record of shipping security improvements that reduced real risk, including fixes you drove to completion with teams you did not own

 - Experience with threat modeling and secure design review, engaging with designs before they ship

 - Practical, everyday use of AI in your security work

 - Working knowledge of our stack: AWS security (Lambda, API Gateway, IAM least privilege, secrets handling) and CI/CD security in GitHub Actions

Tools We Use:

 - GitHub: Actions, Advanced Security, Copilot

 - Python, Terraform

 - AWS: Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, SNS, SQS, VPCs

 - Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Dagster

 - Claude, Claude Code, Amazon Bedrock

Location:

Remote-first and US-based: you can work from anywhere in the country. One exception — if your home is within 50 miles of our DC, NYC, Austin, or Chicago offices, we'll ask you to join your team in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Outside that radius you're fully remote, and still welcome in any office whenever you're nearby.

 - Transparent culture

O cliente é o motivo pelo qual existimos e só temos sucesso se ele tiver sucesso.

⚡ Cabeça de dono
Fazemos o que é certo, do jeito certo, com responsabilidade e tecnologia para decidir melhor.

🎯 Direto ao ponto
Profundidade para entender e simplicidade para resolver.

🤝 Excelência é um jogo de equipe
Construímos um negócio de longo prazo, em time e com colaboração.

✨ Paixão em cada detalhe
Fazemos com paixão, atenção aos detalhes e vontade de surpreender para ajudar o cliente a vencer.

Como será seu dia a dia:

• Atuará em rotina externa para prospectar novos clientes na rota do polo.

• Gerenciar a carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda.

• Participar das matinais diárias do time para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.

• Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

Conheça um pouco mais a rotina do Agente Stone no nosso manifesto.

Requisitos e Qualificações

• Ensino médio completo

• Desejável experiência prévia em vendas externas no setor de adquirência ou serviços financeiros.

• Habilidade em negociação e abordagem comercial

• Trabalhar de forma orientada a resultados e metas

jobs.title: Working Capital & Trade Solutions Manager
jobs.description:
To grow and retain client relationships as per allocated segment/sector portfolio (e.g., Commercial Banking, Agribusiness, Public Sector; and Africa China Banking). To execute on the segment/sector offering, related toolbox(es), initiatives and activities aimed at optimising both client experience and profitability for the bank.

• Bachelor of Commerce in Management Accounting, Finance or related
• A Chartered Accountant, CIMA qualification will be an added advantage

Experience

5-7 years:

• Proven experience in trade finance and working capital solutions, with strong financial acumen and the ability to conduct financial, documentary, and credit analysis.
• Sound understanding of credit risk assessment, client working capital cycles, and the structuring of trade finance solutions; technical expertise in trade finance structuring and working capital products will be advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth through business development, identify market opportunities, and build sustainable client relationships that contribute to business profitability.

Behavioural Competencies:

• Developing Strategies
• Establishing Rapport
• Providing Insights
• Pursuing Goals
• Understanding People

Technical Competencies:

• Economic Capital Management
• Financial Acumen
• Process Governance
• Risk Reporting
• Risk Response Strategy

Key Impact Areas:

• Continuously source relevant market information and key trends in which clients operate, to enable proactive information sharing with the client and the rest of the team. Ensure a deep understanding of the client requirements through regular value-adding interactions with clients.
• Formulate solutions on how to respond to a client’s needs and requirements accordingly (e.g. a client is experiencing a cash flow problem and the jobholder need to perform a full review on available current financial statements, potential payments which are due to the client, etc. and make suggestions on how to accommodate the client over a certain period, until the cash flow problem has been resolved. Determine affordability, refer to Credit if outside of the client’s estimated risk limit).
• Identify new business opportunities and expands opportunities across existing client base, in order to achieve defined financial budgets for the allocated portfolio, through optimal growth of assets and liabilities, transactional, margin management and revenue streams in line with agreed targets.
• Prepare and submit quality credit applications for evaluation and/or approval by Credit, where required or oversees the preparation of credit applications by the RMA. Conducts credit reviews as and when required. Proactively plans and effectively manages timelines for annual credit reviews for the portfolio within the set timelines.
• Structure and customise credit loan facility options to suit client requirements whilst effectively communicating the parameters and qualifying criteria of said facilities. Notify clients timeously of the approval / decline of credit loan facilities.
