jobs.title: Service Bureau Op C
Product Specialist
jobs.description:
Product Specialist – Italy

Milan, Italy

Type of Work: Hybrid Working Model

About the Team

Our TrakCare Product team is responsible for the ongoing development, localization and enhancement of InterSystems' healthcare information system, ensuring that the product meets the evolving needs of healthcare organizations.

Working closely with international product teams, developers, implementation specialists and customers, the team combines healthcare domain expertise with technology to deliver solutions that support clinical and administrative workflows.

We are looking for a Product Specialist to join our experienced team in Italy, contributing to the evolution of TrakCare and ensuring that the product continues to meet the specific requirements of the Italian healthcare market.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare and technology, influence product development and collaborate with international teams on solutions that make a difference in healthcare.

Key Responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Develop a deep understanding of TrakCare functionality, identifying opportunities to enhance the product and adapt global functionality to the Italian market.

• Requirements Gathering: Collect, analyse and prioritize customer feedback, business needs and regulatory requirements, translating them into clear product requirements and use cases.

• Product Roadmap: Contribute to the planning and prioritization of the Italian product roadmap, collaborating with global teams to support future releases.

• Product Localization: Ensure TrakCare meets Italian healthcare requirements, taking into consideration national and regional regulations, tender specifications and customer needs.

• Product Configuration: Support the configuration and localization of product functionality, preparing relevant documentation, release notes, checklists and training materials.

• Product Enhancement: Develop functional requirements and use cases for new features and improvements, working closely with developers and other stakeholders throughout the development process.

• Customer Collaboration: Work with healthcare professionals and end users to understand their workflows, gather feedback and ensure that product enhancements address their operational needs.

• Implementation Support: Collaborate with the Implementation team during project scoping, requirements analysis, product presentations and Go-Live activities.

• Product Presentations: Prepare and deliver product demonstrations, presentations and training sessions for customers and internal teams.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a subject matter expert for the Italian market, facilitating communication between customers, developers, implementation teams and international product stakeholders.

Experience & Qualifications

• At least 3 years of practical experience in the healthcare sector, preferably in healthcare IT, hospital operations or healthcare software.

• Good understanding of Italian healthcare processes, clinical and administrative workflows and the interdependencies between hospital departments.

• Experience in business analysis, requirements gathering and writing functional specifications or use cases.

• Previous experience working with healthcare information systems (HIS), Electronic Health Records (EHR) or other healthcare applications.

• Knowledge of the Italian healthcare landscape, including relevant national and regional regulations.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluency in Italian and good command of English (both written and spoken).

• University degree in Healthcare, Medicine, Health Informatics, Computer Science or a related discipline. (Preferred)

• Previous experience working for a healthcare IT vendor or consultancy in a product-related or business analysis role. (Preferred)

• Experience with product development methodologies, software release processes or Agile environments. (Preferred)

AI Competencies

• Ability to use AI-powered tools to support research, information analysis and documentation activities.

• Understanding of the importance of data accuracy, confidentiality and responsible AI usage, particularly in the healthcare domain.

• Experience using AI tools to support requirements gathering, use case development and process documentation.

• Awareness of AI applications and emerging technologies in healthcare IT.

Key Regional Benefits

• Hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements.

• Meal vouchers.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.

• International working environment and collaboration with global teams.

• Opportunities to work on innovative healthcare technology solutions.

About InterSystems

InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit InterSystems.com.

AI Disclaimer

InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information).  InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.

Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience.  AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.

Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is strictly prohibited during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.  Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department prior to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.


ABOUT THE TEAM

👋 Hey, I'm James Tiltman https://www.linkedin.com/in/james-tiltman-211065118/, and I lead the Customer Escalations team here at Motorway. We're the team that tackles the trickiest customer journeys, keeps sales on track, and makes sure customers still love Motorway. We're key to spotting areas where we can improve, and we work closely with other teams to make the customer experience even better. If you're passionate about solving problems and making a real difference for our customers, you'll fit right in.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a brilliant Customer Escalations Specialist to join our growing team. You'll be right there on the front line, resolving complex customer issues, giving amazing support, and helping us improve what we do. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

 - Dealing with complex escalations and working with stakeholders to find customer-focused solutions.

 - Handling internal escalations, formal complaints, and customer welfare concerns.

 - Responding to reviews on platforms like Trustpilot, Google Reviews, and the app store.

 - Resolving business-critical issues, including those escalated to the C-suite.

 - Using compensation to help with service recovery.

 - Managing GDPR requests and keeping an eye on compliance across operational teams.

 - Supporting the generation of Voice of the Customer insights, which help improve operations and processes across Motorway.

 - Helping different departments spot and prevent fraud, security breaches, and legal claims.


ABOUT YOU

 - You've got experience in a customer-facing role, including handling tough conversations.

 - You're investigative, detail-oriented, and analytical.

 - You're passionate about customer care and turning bad experiences into good ones.

 - You're great at risk assessment, prioritisation, and managing your workload.

 - You're adaptable and happy to contribute to a fast-paced environment.

 - You're a whiz at verbal and written communication.


YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You love taking ownership of complex issues and finding creative solutions.

 - You're resilient and can stay calm under pressure.

 - You're a strong communicator and can build rapport with customers and stakeholders.

 - You're passionate about continuous improvement and making a positive impact.


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 8:45am to 5:30pm

 - Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going

 - Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week

 - Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

 - Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

 - Strong commitment to your personal development

 - Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts

 - Cycle to work scheme

 - Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave

 - ... and much more!


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Qualifying Screen - 30 minutes

 - Onsite Interview - 60 minutes

We'll get back to you within a week of each interview stage. You can chat with a talent partner throughout the process if you have any questions or need anything at all.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Head of Engineering, you will lead the teams building the technology and workflows that enable us to solve the prior authorization bottleneck challenging prescribers, pharmacies, and pharma - and most importantly, the patients who need medication. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will run day-to-day engineering execution, grow and develop engineers and tech leads, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard architectural calls. You’ll also be regularly involved, alongside our tech leads, in sales calls with customers, wearing a product and solutions-engineering hat that keeps the voice of the customer close to our build.

Our platform and agents work in healthcare delivery, meaning our workflows must be accurate and highly reliable, and with documentation digestible to our non-technical customers: pharmaceutical companies, pharmacists, and doctors prescribing medication. In this field we must ship fast without compromising the accuracy, security, and reliability that healthcare delivery demands. You will report to the co-founder and CTO, and sit on and partner closely with our extended leadership team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own delivery: Run engineering execution across multiple pods, with weekly ship cycles, clear ownership, and a culture where velocity and high reliability go hand-in-hand.

 - Build and lead the team: Hire, onboard, and develop senior engineers to recent grads, growing your tech lead and engineering manager layer as we scale. (Current team is 2 leads and 7 engineers) You will be highly involved in growing the team your first six months, and as we scale, we expect you’ll interview each person at onsite to keep the bar high.

 - Ship enterprise-grade technology: Our customers are used to and expect enterprise-grade quality that seamlessly works with existing systems and EHRs, within their existing workflows. You’ll guide the architecture of our platform and systems so they are accurate, explainable, and extensible as we scale and move into new workflows, integrations, and verticals.

 - Raise quality and reliability: Establish practical standards for code review, testing, agent and AI evaluations, observability, on-call, and incident response.

 - Compliance and Security: Partner with our infrastructure lead and fractional CISO to meet the security, privacy, and deployment requirements of our customers.

 - Connect engineering to the customer: Work with product and our GTM leaders to turn customer feedback and requirements into roadmaps and built features.




ABOUT YOU

 - You are a hands-on leader: You are a strong engineer who can read a PR, spot an architectural mistake, and fix it yourself when that’s expedient. You also know the team scale with the company, and know how to coach and teach earlier-in-career engineers how to develop their craft as engineers, including their instincts, judgement and taste that can’t be developed by AI, and often are eroded by it.

 - You have become AI-native: You have shipped LLM, agentic, or ML systems to production and understand evaluation, context management, and the difference between a demo and a production system. You manage AI with judgement and taste, and hold a high technical bar for elegance, quality, and extensibility.

 - You bring scaling experience: You have grown engineering teams as a company scales, and developed engineers into tech leads and managers over time.

 - You operate with velocity, and discernment: References say you move fast, but you know when to slow down 10% to check your thinking, the requirements, and what problem we’re trying to solve. You reduce work-about-work, but insert good-friction when needed to maintain quality and reliability.

 - You value reliability and compliance: You have built in a domain where getting it right matters, such as security, compliance, fintech, or health.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years managing engineers and 2+ years growing managers or tech leads.

 - Hands-on experience shipping enterprise-grade systems in an AI-native way.

 - Demonstrated experience hiring and scaling engineering teams at a high-growth company.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent engineering with customers and fellow leaders alike.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.

 - A direct line to the CEO and real ownership of a business outcome.

 - Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients, with room to grow as the function scales.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse (Part-time)
jobs.description:
WHAT IS ANSIBLE HEALTH?

Ansible Health is a virtual multi-speciality medical group that unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients, with a focus on heart and lung disease. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale.  Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.

 


THE JOB AT A GLANCE

We are seeking a superstar registered nurse (RN)  with a passion for caring for patients with complex chronic medical conditions, focusing on cardiac and respiratory disorders such as congestive heart failure and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). We are searching for a compassionate, smart, and slightly rebellious individual who has found their true calling in patient care, and who is pulled towards using their heart, soul, and mind in new and creative ways.

If you are a self-driven and intellectually curious learner with a growth mindset, we would love to hear about this in your cover letter. If you make flashcards for self-study when you encounter an unfamiliar medical term or drug name; if you ask a lot of questions (particularly, “why”); if you enjoy brainstorming about patient care with your colleagues; if you have a secret mental list of ideas for care improvement, and are looking for the opportunity to try them out; if you sometimes brush your teeth for too long because you are lost in thought about a patient case;  we would love to interview you.

We believe in the raw potential of an individual to become the best clinician possible when immersed in a supportive environment with high-quality mentorship.




WHAT IS THE ROLE?

You will be part of a team led by a nurse practitioner with a mix of respiratory therapists and registered nurses to provide direct care via telemedicine to patients suffering from advanced chronic lung and heart disease. We treat an elderly patient population that is medically complex, very ill at baseline, frequently hospitalized, and often burdened by psychosocial challenges. You will collaborate closely with your medical team members, often speaking multiple times per day with the supervising nurse practitioners, physicians, and medical directors.

Examples of patient care tasks include:

 - Performing telemedicine visits with our patients to provide education specific to their conditions

 - Assessing/triaging adult outpatients with multiple chronic medical conditions, with an emphasis on lung disease/heart failure.

 - Coordinating care with primary care providers, specialists, and external care agencies

 - Advocating for patients who are experiencing major social stressors by activating community resources to improve access to medications, transportation, healthy nutrition, and safe housing

 - Working with your NP led team to serve as the continuous point of contact for patients and families across the entire care spectrum, ranging from transitional post-acute care, to medical stabilization, to rehabilitation, to advanced care planning and dying with dignity

 - Engaging with our interdisciplinary team of physicians, engineers, designers, and other care team members to continuously optimize the care we deliver to our patients

Intimately related to patient care, you will also play a role in promoting our program and answering questions from referring providers and practices as we become more established in your local community.

This versatile role requires you to wear many different hats throughout the week, blending aspects of medical care, education, case management/social work, marketing, and advocacy. We believe in nurturing these transferable skills within one individual, rather than creating silos of expertise across rigid professional categories. This is an unorthodox approach that challenges the current trend in healthcare, which has moved towards more and more specialization, leading to further care fragmentation. We believe that the future of healthcare rests in the hands of a new kind of cross-functional clinician.

Here a few examples of our recent success stories:

 - A socially isolated 50-year-old woman with COPD and several overlapping anxiety disorders was frequently seen in the ED with dyspnea related to panic attacks and psychological distress. Multiple psychotropic medications were added over time, leading her to feel like a “zombie” and drink 10 caffeinated soft drinks per day to compensate, which fueled a vicious cycle of anxiety. The patient’s Ansible clinician connected her to a psychotherapist, convinced her to adopt a dog, and collaborated with her providers to discontinue and taper off several medications. The patient is now doing well at home, no longer going to the ED, and on a much safer medication regimen.

 - A 67-year-old man with very severe COPD and pulmonary cachexia (BMI 17.3 kg/m2) was declined for lung transplantation due to being severely underweight and unable to access a pulmonary rehabilitation facility. The patient lived in a rural Appalachian town with no cellular or internet service. The patient’s Ansible clinician found a public library 3 miles from the patient that housed a WiFI-enabled conference room for telemedicine. The clinician coordinated transportation with his church, provided guidance on nutritional supplementation, and supervised the patient through pulmonary telerehabilitation. The patient’s functional status improved, his BMI increased to 21.5  kg/m2, and he was listed for transplantation.

 - A 59-year-old woman with very severe COPD, HFpEF, and ischemic cardiomyopathy was admitted to the hospital 13 times within the last year for various acute issues including COPD exacerbations, pulmonary edema, and unstable atrial fibrillation. Our clinical team pursued multiple avenues of medical optimization and rehabilitation but the patient continued to deteriorate. Throughout the patient’s journey in the medical system, her Ansible clinician was the most stable contact point, and was able to use the therapeutic rapport to initiate a discussion about end-of-life care. The patient entered into a home hospice program and her symptoms were effectively managed.

Supervision: The RN reports to the team lead NP to provide patient care that is integrated and compatible with the patient-centered medical goals and objectives.




RESPONSIBILITIES

You will join a diverse, talented, and meritocratic team of clinicians from all walks of life who are excited about working at the frontier of healthcare. This is a challenging role that will involve a very steep learning curve, feeling more like a training program for the first year. As with any innovation, a degree of organized chaos is expected. Changing the culture of healthcare is hard. It will often feel like it is “us against the world”, but you will be in good company. You bring your energy, wisdom, and passion for learning. We will bring intensive mentorship to grow your skills and help you to become the best clinician possible.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an entrepreneurial and self-directed registered nurse who is excited to be at the absolutely leading edge of the future of healthcare.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & CERTIFICATIONS

 - The qualified candidate will possess any combination of Education and Experience that will provide the required knowledge, skills, licenses, and certifications to practice as a competent registered nurse

 - Education: Completion of an accredited program for nursing with a minimum of an Associate's Degree.

 - License /Certification:
   
   - Current or compact unrestricted Nursing license in the state of Virginia, or Pennsylvania.

 - 5+ years of experience caring for adult patients with medical illness across the acute and chronic spectrum, substantiated by a strong foundation in Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Geriatric, and Urgent Care practice environments. Strong triage skills are a must!

 - 1+ years of experience caring for adult outpatients with chronic cardiopulmonary conditions such as COPD, congestive heart failure, and coronary artery disease

 - Maintenance of license and continuing nursing education

 - Technical: reliable high-speed internet connection (at least 25 Mbps)


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & CERTIFICATIONS

 - The preferred candidate will possess a unique combination of Education and Experience that will likely provide superior knowledge, skills and licenses to practice as a Registered Nurse in the fields of telemedicine, cardiac and pulmonary disease, and polychronic disease management.

 - Education: Must hold an Associate’s Degree or higher in nursing..

 - Licensed in good standing in Virginia or Pennsylvania

 - 5+ years of experience working with  patients with chronic cardiopulmonary diseases such as COPD, interstitial lung disease, lung cancer, pulmonary hypertension, congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease, and post-cardiothoracic surgery and general internal medicine.

 - Proficiency with telemedicine and/or remote care extension preferred.

 - Prior experience assisting with the coordination of designated health services such as home health, outpatient respiratory care, and DME.

 - Prior experience operating within Cardiac or Pulmonary Rehabilitation programs is a plus but not required.

 - Prior experience/education in exercise science is preferred but not required. This position does include leading patients in home bound exercises over telehealth visits.

 - Strong interest to learn, caring deeply about improving the lives of our patients, ability to work as a strong team player while being self-directed are a must for this position.


JOB DETAILS

 - Part time: Monday–Friday, 3:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m., with opportunities for additional shifts on weekends and holidays.

 - Benefits:  Flexible PTO

 - Location: Remote

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Central & Eastern Europe
jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. jobs.title: Applied Aquaculture Researcher
jobs.description:
Drive Innovation in Sustainable Aquaculture at The Kingfish Company
About The Kingfish Company
The Kingfish Company is a leading producer of high-quality, sustainably farmed Yellowtail Kingfish (Seriola lalandi) using advanced Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) technology. Operating from our state-of-the-art land-based facility in Kats, the Netherlands, we produce premium seafood with a strong focus on fish welfare, environmental responsibility, and continuous innovation.
As we continue to expand our operations and research capabilities, we are looking for an experienced and driven Applied Aquaculture Researcher to join our team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute directly to the future of sustainable aquaculture through applied research, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement initiatives. This is a hands-on industrial R&D role where research findings are rapidly translated into commercial production improvements.
You will join a small R&D team consisting of the Innovation Manager, R&D Coordinator, and research interns. You will take ownership of assigned projects while contributing directly to trial execution, data collection, fish assessments, and reporting.
The Role
As an Applied Aquaculture Researcher, you will contribute to a wide range of research and innovation activities across The Kingfish Company’s production cycle. You will independently coordinate assigned projects while also carrying out experimental work. You will work closely with Operations, Quality, Fish Health, Hatchery, and Management teams to translate scientific insights into practical improvements within commercial production.
A key aspect of the role is investigating skeletal deformities and fish quality issues throughout the production cycleand developing strategies to minimize their occurrence. The successful candidate will also contribute to feed trials, breeding programme activities, production optimisation initiatives, and collaborative research projects with external partners.
Key Responsibilities
Design, manage, and execute applied research projects .
Develop experimental protocols, sampling plans, and data collection methodologies.
Analyse biological and production data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Prepare technical reports, scientific summaries, and management presentations.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external research partners, universities, and suppliers.
Evaluate new technologies, feeds, additives, and production processes that can improve performance and sustainability.
Monitor fish growth, health, welfare, and production KPIs to identify opportunities for improvement.
Investigate production challenges through structured root cause analysis.
Investigate the causes of skeletal deformities and fish quality issues, including potential nutritional, genetic, environmental, husbandry, and developmental factors.Develop, test, and validate mitigation strategies aimed at reducing deformity rates and improving fish quality and production performance.Support continuous improvement initiatives across the production cycle, from hatchery to harvest.
Ensure research activities comply with animal welfare, biosecurity, and company standards.
Coordinate and conduct practical trial work, sampling activities, fish assessments, and data collection throughout the production cycle.
Support nutrition and feed trials, breeding programme activities, and production optimisation projects.
Contribute to the day-to-day execution of experimental work, including fish handling, measurements, sampling, and data recording.
Support supervision and guidance of interns and students involved in research activities.
Support collaborative projects with universities, research institutes, suppliers, and industry partners.
Working Environment
Due to the nature of working with live animals and ongoing research trials, occasional weekend work or flexible working hours may be required to support experimental activities and ensure animal welfare.

jobs.title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
jobs.description:
OPENING

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP



DETAILS

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands



ABOUT THE COMPANY

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.



YOUR ROLE

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

 - wiring sensors

 - mounting compute boards

 - setting up flight controllers

 - testing drones outdoors

 - fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

 - Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

 - Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

 - Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

 - 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

 - Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

 - Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

You’ll see your work fly,  literally!



WHO YOU ARE

 - You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts).

 - You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics.

 - You enjoy making physical things work.

 - You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty.

 - Linux doesn’t scare you.

 - You are independent, curious, and resourceful.

We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made.

Please include photos/links of:

 - your drone builds

 - FPV rigs

 - electronics projects

 - CAD/3D-printed parts

 - GitHub repos

 - anything that shows you build things

If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in.



REQUIREMENTS

 - Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.).

 - Linux basics.

 - Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy.

 - English proficiency.

 - Organized and proactive.

Bonus:

driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience.

What we offer

 - 1000 euro monthly compensation.

 - 10 vacation days during internship period.

 - (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

 - Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

 - The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

 - Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

 - If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

 - We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

 - If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

 - Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Internal Auditor
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are SkillOnNet, leading the igaming entertainment by providing our customers with the most entertaining and trustworthy experience possible, while also reinventing the gambling industry. We are home to more than 30 well-known brands, including PlayOJO, DruckGluck, BacanaPlay, Genting, and many more. We are committed to long-term development and sustainability, and we are trying to revolutionise our industry for the benefit of our players, ourselves, and the entertainment industry as a whole.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Internal Auditor to join our Company. You will play a key role in evaluating and strengthening the organisation's internal control environment, risk management practices, governance processes and regulatory compliance.

As an Internal Auditor, you will go beyond identifying control deficiencies by providing meaningful insights and practical recommendations that support business objectives. Combining strong technical auditing skills with sound regulatory awareness and business understanding, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of the organisation’s governance framework, internal controls, operational effectiveness, and overall compliance posture.

Experience within the iGaming industry will be considered a significant advantage.

Responsibilities include:

• Plan, coordinate, and execute risk-based internal audits across various business functions, processes, and departments.
• Assess the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls, identifying control weaknesses, compliance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
• Evaluate compliance with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, procedures, and industry standards.
• Conduct financial, operational, regulatory, and compliance-related audits.
• Review the effectiveness of risk management and corporate governance processes.
• Prepare comprehensive internal audit reports, clearly communicating findings, associated risks, business impacts, and practical recommendations.
• Collaborate with department heads and key stakeholders to agree on corrective actions and remediation timelines.
• Monitor and follow up on audit findings to ensure timely and effective implementation of agreed actions.
• Support the development and continuous improvement of the organisation's internal audit methodology, annual audit plan, and risk assessment processes.
• Assist with regulatory inspections, external audits, and compliance assessments, where required.
• Identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, accountability, and the overall internal control environment.
• Maintain accurate and comprehensive audit documentation in accordance with professional auditing standards.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in internal auditing, external auditing, or risk assurance with demonstrable hands-on audit experience.
• Previous experience within the iGaming, online gambling, or betting industry.
• ACCA or ACA qualification or equivalent is highly preferred.
• Relevant professional qualifications, such as CIA or CISA, will be considered an advantage.
• Experience performing compliance-focused internal audits and assessing regulatory requirements.
• Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management principles, corporate governance, and audit methodologies.
• Solid understanding of financial, operational, and regulatory controls.
• Familiarity with recognised frameworks and standards, such as COSO and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.
• Proven ability to independently plan and execute audits, evaluate findings, and prepare professional audit reports.
• Experience in auditing regulatory compliance requirements within highly regulated environments, with knowledge of iGaming regulatory frameworks and licensing requirements (including MGA, UKGC, and other relevant jurisdictions), as well as reviewing AML/CFT controls, KYC processes, responsible gaming practices, and regulatory reporting will be considered as an advantage.
• Knowledge of information security, data protection, and technology-related controls, including GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS.
• Experience working with external auditors, regulators, and compliance teams.
• Familiarity with audit management tools, data analytics, and continuous auditing techniques.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at different organisational levels.
• High level of integrity, professional judgement, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English.

What's in it for YOU?

• Excellent work environment
• Monetary vouchers on Birthdays and other special occasions
• Fully equipped kitchen and in-house entertaining space
• Eligibility to enrol in Company's medical insurance plan
• Eligibility to enrol in Company's pension plan
• Exciting company activities including monthly lunches, corporate gatherings, an intercompany football team, competitions, and many other activities
• Casual dress code
• A chance to advance professionally inside one of the world's largest iGaming organisations

What Life at SkillOnNet is like!

SkillOnNet is a firm believer in putting people first and our “family oriented” multinational culture is what drives us. We care and focus on our staff and ensure that you are provided with the most relevant and valuable tools, privileges and amenities.

jobs.description:
Als Accountmanager ben jij het gezicht van Eurofins in de markt. Je rol is uitgesproken naar buiten gericht: je bent dagelijks bij (potentiële) klanten aan tafel, opent nieuwe deuren en zet actief in op het binnenhalen en binden van nieuwe klanten. Je opereert in een prijs gedreven milieumarkt, waarin onderscheidend vermogen niet alleen uit tarief komt, maar juist uit de relatie, het vertrouwen en de toegevoegde waarde die jij weet op te bouwen. Het duurzaam ontwikkelen van klantrelaties is dan ook de kern van jouw succes.

Wij hebben recentelijk een gloednieuw, hypermodern laboratorium in Amersfoort geopend, het grootste milieulab van Nederland. Dankzij verregaande innovatie en automatisering zijn we in staat een groter deel van de markt te bedienen dan ooit tevoren. Om die groeiambities waar te maken, zoeken we een gedreven Accountmanager die zich volledig richt op het actief aantrekken van nieuwe klanten. Dit is een rol met veel vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid: jij bepaalt je aanpak, jij zit aan het stuur.

Dit doe je niet alleen, maar samen met een team van Accountmanagers, een Business Development Manager, Customer Support, R&D en Operations. Je werkt voornamelijk vanuit de locaties Amsterdam en Amersfoort, maar bent bovenal veel onderweg richting de klant.

Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden omvatten onder andere:

• Actief benaderen, overtuigen en binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten (new business / hunting)

• Opbouwen van langdurige, waardevolle klantrelaties in een competitieve, prijs gedreven markt

• Ontwikkelen van nieuwe klantsegmenten en het vergroten van marktaandeel

• Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar passende analytische oplossingen, in samenwerking met het lab

• Vormen van een scherp marktbeeld (wetgeving, marktvraag, trends en ontwikkelingen, concurrentieanalyse) en veel klantcontact.

• Bedenken en ontwikkelen van nieuwe, onderscheidende proposities

Je rapporteert aan de Sales Director NL.

Overige stakeholders: management, Sales & Marketing, R&D, Quality, Finance en zusterlaboratoria binnen de Eurofins Group.

Standplaats: diverse locaties van Eurofins Environment Testing Benelux, o.a. Amsterdam en Amersfoort.

Wat wij vragen

Je hebt passie voor het binnenhalen van nieuwe business in een B2B-omgeving en voelt je thuis in een technische, laboratoriumgedreven context. Je beschikt bij voorkeur over een afgeronde technische opleiding (HBO/WO) in de richting Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Analytische Chemie of een vergelijkbare studie, óf je hebt een aantoonbare affiniteit met analytische laboratoria en laboratoriumonderzoek.

• Bij voorkeur minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in Sales, Business Development, Account Management of Consultancy, bij voorkeur in een technische of laboratoriumomgeving

• Aantoonbare ervaring met het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten in een competitieve, prijs gedreven markt

• Iemand die gemakkelijk deuren opent; een netwerker bij uitstek

• Vaardig met het MS Office-pakket (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift; Frans is een pre

• Betrokken, resultaatgericht en klantgericht

• Proactief, pragmatisch, energiek en positief ingesteld

• Echte hunter met een can-do-mentaliteit

• Teamplayer, hands-on en flexibel

• Sterk analytisch onderlegd en numeriek gedreven

wongdoody xdm

CONTENTPRODUCTIE & CONCEPTONTWIKKELING

Als Producer ontwikkel je onderscheidende content die past bij de merkwaarden en kwaliteitsstandaarden van Red Bull. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige contentflow: van idee en concept tot productie, publicatie en evaluatie.

Met YouTube als belangrijkste creatieve vertrekpunt ontwikkel je platformgerichte content en schaalbare formats die aansluiten bij de doelgroep en bijdragen aan bereik, engagement en kanaalgroei. Daarbij combineer je sterke storytelling en creatieve kwaliteit met relevantie binnen het digitale en culturele landschap.

PRODUCTION & EDITORIAL OWNERSHIP

Van briefing tot publicatie neem jij eigenaarschap over de productie. Je vertaalt ideeën naar sterke verhalen en zorgt ervoor dat deze inhoudelijk, visueel en productioneel goed worden uitgevoerd.

Je werkt samen met creatieve partners, talenten en interne teams. Je geeft richting aan het creatieve proces en bewaakt de redactionele kwaliteit. Bij complexe, grootschalige, live- of multicameraproducties werk je nauw samen met de Production Expert. Samen zorgen jullie voor een sterke planning, technische uitvoering en operationele oplevering.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor zowel longform- als shortformcontent. Ook vertaal je producties naar effectieve edits, cutdowns, formats en posts voor andere relevante social media platforms.

YOUTUBE & SOCIAL PUBLISHING

Je brengt actuele kennis van YouTube en social media platforms mee in iedere fase van het creatieve en productionele proces. Je begrijpt hoe je content moet verpakken om de juiste doelgroep te bereiken en te activeren.

Je zorgt ervoor dat de juiste content op het juiste platform en op het juiste moment verschijnt, als onderdeel van een overkoepelend activatieplan voor een evenement of project.

Daarbij neem je beslissingen over onder andere titels, thumbnails en captions. Je zorgt ervoor dat content niet alleen goed is, maar ook vindbaar, aantrekkelijk en relevant voor de doelgroep. Je schrijft of ontwikkelt social copy die past bij het platform en de community.

Je gebruikt performance data, doelgroepinzichten, online trends en ontwikkelingen binnen de platforms om content continu te verbeteren. Je analyseert hoe formats, verhalen en publicaties presteren en vertaalt deze inzichten naar concrete acties.

Je kijkt daarbij verder dan alleen bereik en views. Je begrijpt welke rol kijktijd, engagement, interactie, publieksgroei en merkbetrokkenheid spelen in het succes van content.

ACTIVATION & COLLABORATION

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Dubai, UAE

About the role

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation

What you'll do

• Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach

• Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.

• Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.

jobs.title: SVP, General Counsel & Company Secretary
jobs.description:
Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.

Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.

Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to be curious, have courage, and commit fully.

Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.

About the role

As SVP, General Counsel and Company Secretary at Everway, you will lead the company's legal and corporate governance activities, providing strategic legal advice to senior leadership and supporting the business in managing legal risk, commercial opportunities and regulatory obligations.

You will oversee commercial contracting, intellectual property, data privacy, corporate legal matters and company secretarial responsibilities across our global operations. Working closely with the executive leadership team, Board and external legal advisers, you will help ensure Everway operates within effective legal and governance frameworks while enabling business growth.

Main responsibilities

In this role, you will:

Legal strategy and commercial advisory

• Lead Everway's legal strategy, providing practical, commercially focused advice to executive leadership and stakeholders across the business.

• Advise on legal risks associated with business operations, commercial arrangements and strategic initiatives.

• Oversee the drafting, negotiation and management of commercial contracts, including customer, supplier, vendor and partnership agreements.

• Establish and maintain legal contracting standards, templates and approval processes to support efficient and consistent commercial decision-making.

• Coordinate external legal advisers on specialist legal matters, ensuring effective management of legal risk and costs.

Intellectual property, privacy and regulatory compliance

• Oversee the protection and management of Everway's intellectual property, including contractual IP rights, licensing and related legal matters.

• Provide legal oversight of data protection and privacy obligations across relevant jurisdictions, working with internal stakeholders to manage compliance and associated risks.

• Advise on applicable regulatory requirements and emerging legal developments affecting the business.

• Support the identification, assessment and management of legal and regulatory risks, including contractual disputes and potential litigation.

Corporate governance and company secretarial

• Oversee Board and committee governance processes, including agendas, meeting materials, minutes, resolutions and action tracking.

• Maintain Board and committee charters, governance records and relevant statutory documentation.

• Support Audit Committee and Remuneration/Compensation Committee governance requirements.

• Oversee global legal entity management, including incorporations, registrations, director and officer changes, statutory filings and corporate records.

• Maintain delegated authority and signatory frameworks, ensuring appropriate corporate approval processes.

• Monitor shareholder agreement obligations, including reserved matters, consent thresholds and related approvals.

Legal function leadership

• Set the direction and priorities for Everway's legal function, aligning legal support with business strategy and organisational objectives.

• Partner with senior leadership to embed effective legal risk management into commercial and operational decision-making.

• Oversee the delivery of legal services through internal resources and external advisers, ensuring appropriate expertise and efficient use of resources.

• Identify opportunities to improve legal processes, contract management and governance practices through standardisation, technology and automation.

Essential criteria

• 5+ years of senior functional leadership experience, with responsibility for complex legal matters and organisational outcomes.

• Significant experience in a senior in-house legal role, advising executive leadership on commercial, corporate and regulatory matters.

• Experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, including customer, supplier and vendor contracts.

• Knowledge of intellectual property, licensing and commercial legal frameworks relevant to a technology or software business.

• Experience advising on data protection, privacy and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience supporting corporate governance, Board processes and company secretarial requirements.

• Ability to assess complex legal risks and provide clear, commercially practical advice to senior stakeholders.

• Experience overseeing external legal counsel and coordinating legal support across business functions and jurisdictions.

Desirable criteria

• Experience working within a global SaaS or technology business.

• Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or corporate restructuring.

• Familiarity with global legal entity management and shareholder governance requirements.

• Experience implementing or improving contract lifecycle management and legal operations processes.

• Experience applying technology, automation or AI-enabled tools to improve legal workflows and risk management.

jobs.title: Sales Director, Demand
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The industry is at an inflection point. Third-party data is disappearing from the open web and agencies need a new way to reach audiences at scale. Permutive is that answer: publisher first-party signals, the most scaled and durable audience data on the open internet. We’re a rising organization, our Demand offering has grown, and our biggest opportunity is growth across US agencies.

We’re looking for Sales Directors who have sold in both platform and programmatic. You’ll win agencies onto the Permutive platform, then grow the media spend that runs through it. You’ll also help build our sales motion and narrative from the ground up.

About the Team

The Demand team is a lean team of industry experts. We launched our Demand solution and reached impressive growth and market validation within six months. That growth is built on our unique advantage: 100% addressability from publisher first-party signals, which has already led to significant partnerships with leading brands and agencies.

As a Sales Director, you’ll own a portfolio of agencies with a direct path to exceeding significant media spend targets on the platform.

What You’ll Be Doing

 - Win new agency logos. Bring US media agencies onto the Permutive platform.

 - Grow media spend. Work with agency trading and account teams to embed Permutive campaign by campaign, from first test to always-on.

 - Expand across the agency. Once an account is live, keep bringing in new brands and departments while Account Management runs delivery.

 - Own your pipeline and revenue. Qualify, build, and manage an accurate pipeline across agencies and brand advertisers.

 - Sell proactively. Keep up a high level of activity across outbound calls, emails, in-person sales and education sessions, and social selling.

 - Be the expert in the room. Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to agencies and their end clients.

 - Shape the sales narrative. Help define how we position Permutive, and represent us at conferences, events, and networking sessions.

What You’ll Need

 - Platform and programmatic sales experience. You’ve sold a platform and you’ve sold programmatic, ideally both.

 - Agency sales experience. You’ve sold to US media agencies, and size doesn’t matter. You’re as effective with traders and account teams as with tech leads.

 - A hunter’s mindset. You’ve won new logos and delivered in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment.

 - Experience growing media spend through a platform. You know how to turn a platform win into everyday usage and growing spend.

 - Programmatic depth. You have deep expertise across ad exchanges, DSPs, SSPs, and data providers.

 - A builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable building from scratch and adapting as the market shifts.

 - A collaborative approach. You work in lockstep with Account Management to make every account a success.

 - Exceptional communication. You can make complex audience and platform strategies clear, concise, and compelling.

What We Are Offering...

We set salaries in a structured, objective way, based on market data, our compensation strategy, and the experience and capability we see through our interview process. For a typical candidate who meets our requirements, we pay a base salary of $160,000 – $180,000.

How We Compensate for Success...

If you join Permutive as an Sales Director with a base salary of $180,000 and hit 100% of your target in a year, your OTE for that year will be around $360,000. Your earning potential is uncapped, and 100% target attainment is the minimum expectation for our Sales Directors.

Permutive Benefits

 - In this together: As a full-time employee, you’ll become a shareholder with stock options, sharing in our collective success.

 - Family Comes First: Primary caregivers receive up to 6 months of fully paid leave and secondary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid leave to bond with their little ones.

 - Your Time, Your Way: Flexible hours let you fit work around your life, whether it’s hitting the gym, meditating, or handling family needs.

 - Upgraded Workspace: A $450 budget helps you create the perfect home office setup.

 - Recharge & Refocus: Unlimited paid time off (with a minimum of 25 days + public holidays) ensures you get the rest you need.

 - Grow with Us: Ongoing training and development opportunities fuel your career aspirations.

 - Mental Health Matters: We prioritize your well-being with free access to TalkSpace, our mental health partner.

 - Healthy & Happy: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage keeps you and your family feeling your best. Choose a plan with 100% coverage for yourself, with options to cover your dependents at 75%.



Work Your Way

Permutive trusts you to manage your time and deliver results. Our hybrid model allows you to choose where you work best, whether in your own productive space or our London (Farringdon) or New York (Union Square) offices. That said, none of us work alone; we are part of a team. 

To foster collaboration and connection, teams in these locations come together in person at least once a week and are encouraged to benefit from being in our offices to meet with teams more often. Commercial and customer-facing teams are encouraged to embrace in-person interactions to build lasting relationships with clients and colleagues. 

Every Permutive employee gets together in person at the company’s Annual Kick Off for a week in February.  Each year’s event promises to be an exciting opportunity for us to come together, reconnect with colleagues, and align on our shared vision for the year ahead.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Permutive, we’re taking a thoughtful, intersectional, long-term approach to diversity, equity & inclusion. We care deeply about creating an inclusive work environment that allows everyone to flourish, and we are taking continual action to progress in that direction. 

We’re committed to hiring people regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity status, disability status, or otherwise.

jobs.title: Mobile Growth Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Mobile Growth Manager to take full ownership of monetization and retention for our AI LLM chat mobile app on iOS and Android. You will be accountable for how much revenue each mobile user generates and for how long they stay.

This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end ownership. You own the funnel from store listing to first session, trial, paid conversion, renewal and win-back. You decide what to test, what to scale and what to cut, and you are accountable for the results. We need someone who has grown ARPU and retention on subscription apps, who can run experiments quickly and independently, and who knows how to work within Apple and Google subscription rules.

You will manage performance against real revenue data (ARPU, trial-to-paid conversion, ROI D7, retention and cohorts), not vanity metrics. We also work AI-first, and we expect you to use Claude and automation to move faster.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own mobile growth end to end: from store page to paid conversion and renewal, across strategy, experimentation, launch, reporting and documentation.

 - Deliver a quarterly ARPU target on mobile (set against a measured baseline), through conversion, retention and perceived product value.

 - Own the paywall and pricing: offerings, packaging, trial and intro-offer structure, price tests by geo, and placement. Run them through RevenueCat or an equivalent.

 - Own onboarding and activation: shorten the path to the first moment of value and fix drop-offs in the first session and first week.

 - Build retention and win-back loops: push, in-app messaging, cancellation-save flows and involuntary-churn recovery (billing retries, grace periods).

 - Own store conversion: ASO, listing and screenshot tests, ratings and review prompts on the App Store and Google Play.

 - Keep web and app aligned: manage the web-to-app handoff and make sure subscribers get a consistent experience and entitlement across both.

 - Manage signal quality: subscription and in-app events, attribution and MMP data, and measurement under iOS privacy rules (ATT / SKAdNetwork).

 - Run a structured experiment process: own the mobile backlog, with a clear hypothesis, target metric and kill/scale rule for every test. Run the A/B tests end to end.

 - Review sessions daily: find friction, drop-offs and behavioural patterns, and turn them into backlog items.

 - Build the reporting: Mixpanel dashboards and a weekly report on mobile ARPU, trial conversion, ROI D7 on matured cohorts, 1-hour cancellation and retention.

 - Own policy compliance: keep paywalls, subscription disclosure, refunds and store listings within Apple and Google rules, with prevention-first checks before launch.

 - Prototype with AI: use Claude and automation for prototypes, analysis, QA and reporting, and ship the ones that work.

 - Diagnose drops and spikes quickly and act on them.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years in mobile growth, product growth or lifecycle roles on subscription apps.

 - Proven, measured ARPU, conversion or retention gains on a live subscription app, on both iOS and Android.

 - Strong understanding of subscription economics: trials, intro offers, renewals, LTV, payback windows and cohorts.

 - Hands-on paywall and pricing experimentation (RevenueCat, Superwall or similar).

 - Hands-on with Mixpanel or an equivalent: funnels, cohorts, custom boards.

 - Experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing mechanics: grace periods, billing retries, refunds, cancellation flows.

 - Experience with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular or similar) and with ATT / SKAdNetwork-era measurement.

 - Experience with push and in-app messaging tools and with building retention mechanics.

 - Working knowledge of ASO and store listing conversion.

 - Strong experiment discipline: hypotheses, sample sizing, readouts and clean decisions.

 - Daily use of Claude or other AI tools for prototyping, analysis and writing.

 - Ownership mentality: you run the funnel with minimal supervision and take responsibility for outcomes.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AI or consumer-subscription products.

 - Experience with web-to-app subscription funnels.

 - Experience coordinating paid acquisition with product conversion, as a partner to a UA lead.

 - Experience working under strict platform policy (subscription disclosure, ROSCA-type rules).




LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement
   
   https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt
