jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

 - Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

 - Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

 - Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

 - Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

 - Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

 - MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

 - Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

 - Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

 - Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

 - Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

 - Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

 - Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.
   

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Principal Maritime Engineer – Ireland (Dublin or Cork)
jobs.description:
Technical Excellence. Project Leadership. Engineering the Future of Maritime Infrastructure.

We are seeking an experienced and technically capable Principal Maritime Engineer to join our growing Ports and Maritime team. This is an opportunity for an established maritime engineering professional to take a leading role in the delivery of complex port and marine infrastructure projects, provide technical direction to multidisciplinary teams and contribute to the continued development of our maritime business.

You will work across a diverse portfolio of projects in Ireland and the UK and internationally, supporting public and private sector clients in the development, refurbishment and expansion of maritime infrastructure. Projects will span the full engineering lifecycle, from feasibility studies, optioneering and masterplanning through to detailed design, procurement, construction support and asset management.

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering judgement with the ability to lead technical delivery, develop innovative and practical solutions, build client relationships and support the development of less experienced engineers.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to broaden their technical influence, take greater responsibility for project delivery and contribute to the growth and reputation of an ambitious maritime engineering business.

The Role

As Principal Maritime Engineer, you will provide technical leadership and take responsibility for the successful delivery of maritime engineering projects and work packages. Working closely with project directors, clients and colleagues across our multidisciplinary business, you will ensure that engineering solutions are technically robust, commercially appropriate and deliverable.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the technical delivery of maritime engineering projects from early feasibility and concept development through to detailed design and construction.
• Developing and reviewing engineering solutions for ports, harbours, marine terminals and associated infrastructure.
• Taking responsibility for the design and assessment of marine structures, including quays, jetties, piers, dolphins, linkspans, slipways, breakwaters and seawalls.
• Preparing, reviewing and checking engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications, drawings and construction documentation.
• Providing technical direction and quality assurance, ensuring that designs meet relevant standards, client requirements and project objectives.
• Coordinating multidisciplinary engineering inputs, including civil, structural, geotechnical, coastal, environmental and infrastructure specialists.
• Leading technical discussions with clients, contractors and other stakeholders, providing clear and practical engineering advice.
• Developing safe, buildable, maintainable and cost-effective solutions that respond to operational and construction constraints.
• Supporting the preparation of bids, technical proposals, scopes of work and fee submissions.
• Identifying opportunities to develop existing client relationships and contribute to winning new maritime work.
• Mentoring and supporting engineers and technicians, sharing knowledge and helping to develop technical capability within the team.
• Promoting innovation, digital engineering and sustainable design approaches throughout project delivery.

About You

You will be an experienced maritime engineer with a strong technical background and the confidence to take ownership of complex engineering challenges. You will be comfortable working independently, providing technical direction to others and engaging directly with clients and project stakeholders.

You are likely to demonstrate:

• A degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Maritime Engineering or a related discipline.
• Chartered Engineer status with ICE, IStructE or an equivalent professional institution.
• Significant experience in the design, assessment and delivery of maritime infrastructure projects.
• Strong technical understanding of marine structures, including piled structures, reinforced concrete, steelwork, quay walls, jetties, piers, dolphins, linkspans, slipways and marine terminals.
• Experience in the assessment, refurbishment and rehabilitation of existing port and maritime infrastructure.
• Knowledge of relevant design standards, Eurocodes, British Standards, PIANC guidance and industry best practice.
• Experience undertaking structural analysis and design calculations, with familiarity with relevant engineering analysis and modelling software.
• A proven ability to lead technical work packages and coordinate multidisciplinary design inputs.
• Experience preparing and reviewing technical reports, calculations, specifications, drawings and construction documentation.
• An understanding of construction methodologies, buildability, temporary works considerations and the practical challenges of delivering projects in marine environments.
• Strong project management and commercial awareness, including an understanding of scope, programme, budgets and quality requirements.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present technical solutions and provide advice to clients.
• Experience mentoring and supporting the professional development of engineers and technicians.
• Experience in port masterplanning, feasibility studies, marine asset inspections, condition assessments, dredging, shipyard infrastructure or offshore energy terminals would also be advantageous.

What We Offer

This is an opportunity to join a growing maritime engineering business and play an important role in delivering technically challenging and nationally significant infrastructure projects.

We offer:

• Technical influence: The opportunity to take a leading role in shaping engineering solutions and maintaining high technical standards across our maritime projects.
• Project variety: Exposure to a diverse portfolio of port, harbour, marine terminal and coastal infrastructure projects in the UK and internationally.
• Career development: Opportunities to develop your technical expertise and progress towards more senior technical or project leadership responsibilities.
• Professional development: Support for continued professional development, chartership and technical specialisation.
• Knowledge sharing: Work alongside experienced specialists across maritime, coastal, civil, structural and environmental disciplines.
• Client engagement: Opportunities to develop client relationships and become a trusted technical advisor.
• Innovation: The opportunity to contribute to digital engineering, sustainable design and innovative approaches to maritime infrastructure.
• Flexible working: Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
• Competitive package: A competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.

Join Us

If you are an experienced maritime engineer looking for the opportunity to take greater technical responsibility, work on challenging infrastructure projects and contribute to the development of a growing maritime engineering business, we would welcome the opportunity to hear from you.

Join us and help deliver the next generation of maritime infrastructure, bringing together sound engineering judgement, technical innovation and practical solutions to meet the evolving needs of ports and coastal communities.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager - United States
jobs.description:
US MARKETING MANAGER




RETIRE THE ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.




FINANCE DESERVES BETTER

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on legacy ERPs and a roster of point solutions taped together.

Light gives them a way out.

Why run ten tools when one robust system can do the job? We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

 - Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

 - Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

 - Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Light started life in Copenhagen, made London its HQ and has global ambition. We believe we have the product and the team to transform the finance function the world over. Today we run it for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a US Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across the United States. This is one of our first US roles, and you'll join alongside our US Sales Lead. The two of you will work side by side to build Light's brand and presence in the market, with the team in Europe a Slack message away.

The good news is you won't start from scratch. Many of our customers already run on Light in the US, from US-headquartered companies to European businesses with American operations. A network of accounting partners extends our reach, and our hackathons earlier this year, hosted with the likes of McKinsey and J.P. Morgan across the country, gave us a pulse in the market. Now, come on in and harness the the opportunity.




THE TEAM YOU'LL JOIN

You'll join a small, ambitious marketing team of field marketers across Europe, product marketers, a designer, a videographer and a central growth team running demand generation in every market.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Building and running the US marketing plan with our US Sales Lead, with pipeline targets you share.

 - Running a field and events programme across the cities that matter to US finance leaders, from intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

 - Growing our network of accounting partners, along with the advisors, investors and communities that US finance leaders trust.

 - Localising our story, content and campaigns for American finance teams, and turning US customer stories into content people want to share.

 - Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the US.

 - Building relationships with US press and the people who shape the tech and finance conversation.




WHAT WE THINK* YOU'LL NEED

 - Enough years in the seat to know what works at a fast-growing company, ideally because you've built the ground game for a scaling B2B SaaS business in the US before.

 - A track record across field, events, partnerships and content, and the judgment to know which lever to pull and when.

 - Comfort working as one team with sales, implementation and customer success, and with colleagues on the other side of the Atlantic.

 - Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

 - A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

 - A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

 - A passport. Expect regular trips across the US and to our teams in London and Copenhagen.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.




THE GOOD STUFF

 - A base salary of $88,000–$162,000 DOE (depending on experience).

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance, with your premiums fully covered by Light.

 - A 401(k) with a company match of up to 4% of your salary.

 - Life insurance at twice your salary, plus short- and long-term disability cover.

 - Potential stock options.

 - Unlimited paid time off, plus US public holidays.

 - Regular socials and two company offsites a year.

 - The chance to build Light’s US presence from the ground up as one of our first hires in the market.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.




THE FAMOUS LAST WORDS

If you love building from the ground up and want to plant the flag in the US for a company set on retiring the ERP the world over, let's talk.

jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Senior Product Counsel

The role

OPSWAT is seeking a Senior Product Counsel to serve as a trusted legal partner to our global Product organization. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will guide a broad cybersecurity portfolio through the product lifecycle, helping teams turn complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical product decisions.

With more than 20 years of innovation, OPSWAT combines established expertise with the pace and ambition of a high-growth technology company. This role offers the opportunity to shape how we develop and bring products to market as technology, AI, and regulation evolve.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Supply Chain, and other business and legal stakeholders globally to identify issues early, recommend workable solutions, and build processes that support responsible innovation.

What you will do

• Partner with product managers from early design through development, launch, commercialization, updates, and end of life.

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting the portfolio, assess their business impact, and translate relevant requirements into clear product guidance and actions.

• Advise on product terms and licensing models, intellectual property, AI, open source, third-party technology, product claims, safety and liability, and market access, coordinating with subject-matter experts as needed.

• Support product export and trade compliance, including classification, encryption, technology transfers, restricted uses and destinations, and licensing requirements, partnering with relevant teams and escalating product or transaction issues as needed.

• Advise on product supply-chain and market-access requirements, including third-party components, suppliers, certifications, conformity assessments, and supporting evidence, working with teams responsible for technical testing, certification submissions, and supplier processes.

• Develop practical review processes, playbooks, training, and escalation paths that make product legal support consistent and scalable.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve the speed and quality of legal support while protecting confidential information and applying independent legal judgment.

What you bring

• A law degree and an active license to practice law in a relevant jurisdiction.

• At least 7 years of legal experience, with substantial experience advising on software, cybersecurity, AI, or other technology products, in-house or in a product-focused law firm practice.

• Experience advising on AI-enabled products and the ability to assess emerging technology and regulatory requirements.

• A strong understanding of how technology products are developed, launched, licensed, and supported globally, and the ability to engage effectively with technical teams.

• Practical business judgment, including the ability to distinguish material risks, recommend proportionate solutions, and help teams make informed decisions.

• Excellent communication, drafting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to technical teams and senior business stakeholders.

• A collaborative, proactive approach and the ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment across global teams.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise GTM
jobs.description:
ABOUT AFTERQUERY

AfterQuery https://www.afterquery.com/ is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it. 

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.




WHY APPLY

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

Strong Team: Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.




OVERVIEW

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise GTM to own and build AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market function from the ground up. This person will be responsible for driving enterprise customer acquisition, developing strategic commercial partnerships, structuring complex deals, and ensuring successful delivery of the engagements we sell.

This is a senior, highly autonomous leadership role for someone who can operate as both a strategic leader and a hands-on individual contributor. You will personally identify and pursue high-value enterprise opportunities, build relationships with senior decision-makers, lead complex sales cycles, and translate customer needs into commercially sound engagements that our research and technical teams can execute.

Our core research and technical capabilities are already in place. The primary challenge is bringing those capabilities to the right customers, creating compelling commercial opportunities, and converting them into successful, long-term partnerships. You'll work closely with our researchers and technical leadership to understand what we can deliver, while taking full ownership of how we position, sell, structure, and bring those solutions to market.

You'll own the entire customer lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development through commercial negotiation, engagement launch, delivery, and account expansion. This includes building the operating processes and commercial infrastructure needed to scale the function, as well as establishing and leading a high-performing GTM team as the business grows.

We're looking for someone who can independently drive results from day one, create structure where little exists, and build a repeatable enterprise GTM engine without relying on an existing sales organization or extensive support.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own and Build the Enterprise GTM Function

 - Take full ownership of AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market strategy, commercial execution, and overall customer acquisition efforts.

 - Define and execute the strategy for identifying, pursuing, and closing high-value enterprise opportunities across AI, technology, and other relevant industries.

 - Personally drive outbound prospecting, relationship development, pipeline generation, and strategic account acquisition while building the foundation for a scalable sales organization.

 - Establish our enterprise sales motion, including target account strategy, qualification, positioning, pricing, deal structures, and commercial negotiations.

 - Identify the highest-value customer use cases for custom evaluations, data generation, model training, and post-training engagements.

 - Build the processes, playbooks, metrics, and operating cadence needed to create a repeatable and scalable GTM function.

 - Establish, hire, and lead a high-performing enterprise GTM team as the business scales, setting clear expectations for performance, accountability, and execution.

Drive Enterprise Sales and Commercial Strategy

 - Build and own relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and technical decision-makers across large enterprise organizations.

 - Lead consultative discovery to understand customer workflows, business objectives, technical requirements, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement.

 - Translate customer problems into compelling commercial opportunities, developing proposals that connect AfterQuery's capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

 - Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery through solution scoping, pricing, contracting, and deal closure.

 - Structure sophisticated enterprise agreements, balancing customer needs, commercial economics, delivery requirements, and long-term business value.

 - Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing models, engagement structures, contract terms, and expansion opportunities.

 - Develop strategic account relationships that generate repeat business, long-term partnerships, and broader enterprise adoption.

Translate Customer Needs into Executable Engagements

 - Partner closely with AfterQuery's research and technical leadership to understand our capabilities and translate them into differentiated enterprise solutions.

 - Identify and scope technical engagements involving model evaluations, failure analysis, training data, and post-training approaches such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

 - Work with research and technical teams to determine feasibility, resource requirements, timelines, and delivery expectations before committing to customer engagements.

 - Translate customer requirements into clearly defined scopes of work, deliverables, success metrics, and commercially viable engagement structures.

 - Ensure alignment between what is sold commercially and what can be successfully executed by our research and delivery teams.

 - Bring customer feedback, market intelligence, and emerging enterprise needs back to research leadership to inform future capabilities and opportunities.

Own Customer Delivery and Account Expansion

 - Maintain ownership of customer engagements beyond the initial contract, ensuring successful execution and delivery against commercial commitments.

 - Lead the transition from signed agreement to active engagement, coordinating researchers, technical teams, and operational resources.

 - Establish clear accountability for project scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and customer communication.

 - Proactively manage delivery risks, resolve escalations, and ensure customer expectations remain aligned with execution.

 - Monitor engagement performance and commercial outcomes, identifying opportunities to improve delivery models, engagement economics, and customer satisfaction.

 - Turn successful engagements into long-term strategic partnerships, repeat business, case studies, and opportunities for account expansion.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7–10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, commercial leadership, or enterprise GTM at a high-growth technology company.

 - A proven track record of independently building enterprise pipelines, acquiring major customers, and closing complex, high-value commercial agreements.

 - Experience leading enterprise GTM or sales functions, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the commercial motion from the ground up.

 - Strong commercial judgment and experience structuring sophisticated enterprise deals, including pricing, contracts, resource requirements, and engagement economics.

 - Experience selling complex software, AI solutions, technical services, or research-driven solutions to large enterprise customers.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while providing strategic leadership and direction from day one.

 - Experience owning customer engagements beyond the sale, including implementation, delivery, stakeholder management, and ensuring contractual commitments are met.

 - Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex AI capabilities, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and translate customer problems into executable solutions.

 - Ability to work closely with research, engineering, and operations teams to scope engagements, align resources, and deliver against customer expectations.

 - A builder's mindset: you take full ownership, operate independently, move quickly, and create structure where little exists.

 - Exceptional executive presence, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

 - Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where individual ownership, commercial judgment, and results are essential.


PARTICULARLY RELEVANT BACKGROUNDS

We're particularly interested in candidates who have built and scaled enterprise GTM functions within AI, enterprise software, AI infrastructure, or technical services businesses, as well as commercial leaders who have helped large organizations adopt and implement AI at scale.

Relevant experience may include:

 - Head of Enterprise Sales, VP of GTM, Chief Commercial Officer, or similar leadership roles at high-growth technology companies.

 - Enterprise AI companies selling complex, high-value solutions to frontier AI labs, Fortune 500 companies, or sophisticated enterprise customers.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial, surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

As Coupang continues to scale rapidly and expand into new global markets and business lines, we are seeking a highly capable Senior Manager of Transfer Pricing to lead our US-based transfer pricing operations and transactional planning. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring you to identify risks and opportunities, operationalize transfer pricing changes, and seamlessly partner with business leaders to translate complex operating models into defensible tax positions. Uniquely, this position requires a generalist mindset: while your primary focus is transfer pricing, approximately 20% of your time will be dedicated to supporting broader international tax planning and compliance efforts.

What You Will Do

• Operational & Transactional Transfer Pricing: Lead transactional planning initiatives and implement operational transfer pricing for a broad range of intercompany transactions. Translate transfer pricing policies into recurring intercompany calculations, true-ups, journal-entry inputs, and period-end close schedules. Embed transfer pricing policies into high-volume, systems-driven commerce environments.

• Cross-Functional & Global Leadership: Partner directly with business operations and collaborate closely with global transfer pricing team members outside the US to scale transfer pricing frameworks as Coupang expands into different businesses and markets, ensuring audit readiness and systemic consistency. Lead operational studies focused on optimizing adjustment processes to eliminate resource bottlenecks, while actively mitigating customs revaluation and Permanent Establishment (PE) risks.

• Intercompany Transactions & Intellectual Property: Lead the transfer pricing strategies surrounding tangible asset transfers, intercompany services, and royalty models. Advise on global intangible alignment and perform DEMPE (Development, Enhancement, Maintenance, Protection, and Exploitation) analyses to support cross-border tax strategies and IP integrations. Assist with implementing financial transactions, including debt capacity analyses for intercompany financing arrangements.

• Controversy & APA/MAP Representation: Support and represent Coupang in tax authority audits, Advance Pricing Agreements (APA), and Mutual Agreement Procedure (MAP) matters by preparing technical analyses, economic exposure assessments, and negotiation support.

• External Partner Management & Global Compliance: Serve as the primary liaison to external advisers and Big 4 partners. Direct and oversee external Big 4 advisors in the execution of global documentation projects, comparable company searches, and benchmarking studies, as well as the preparation of Master Files and Local Files. Strengthen global compliance and risk management by monitoring OECD requirements, BEPS, Pillar Two, and Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR).

• International Tax Planning (20%): Apply a generalist mindset to support international tax planning, restructuring, and compliance deliverables outside of the standard transfer pricing scope. Support quarterly and annual close and financial reporting workflows, including ASC 740 and FIN 48 analyses, provision memoranda, and transfer pricing reserve calculations.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field (Master’s degree, CPA, or JD preferred).

• 12+ years of transfer pricing experience in a Big 4 public accounting firm, law firm, or a large multinational technology company. In-house experience at a large US multinational enterprise (MNE) in the tech sector is strongly preferred.

• Deep technical expertise and applied knowledge of US transfer pricing regulations (IRC Section 482) and OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, with a proven ability to translate these frameworks into practical, business-aligned solutions.

• Proven operational and transactional planning transfer pricing experience, including maintaining and updating calculation models and intercompany agreements.

• Demonstrated experience structuring complex intercompany transactions, assessing transfer pricing risk, and integrating newly acquired companies or intangibles into global supply chains.

• Hands-on experience supporting APA matters and defending transfer pricing positions during tax authority audits.

• Strong ability to translate complex, evolving global tax disclosure requirements into compliant operational reporting frameworks.

• Advanced financial modeling skills and proficiency with managing large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

• A naturally curious mindset with a drive to dig deep into evolving business models, ask critical questions, and understand the "why" behind the data.

• Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating with ambiguity; able to work autonomously, take end-to-end ownership of projects, and thrive without direct supervision in an entrepreneurial environment.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to distill complex transfer pricing and international tax concepts into clear, actionable business advice for non-tax leaders in Finance, Legal, and Operations.

• A track record of driving process improvements, leveraging technology and automation to streamline workflows, scale operations, and eliminate manual inefficiencies.

• High adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment, capable of pivoting quickly and maintaining a strategic outlook as Coupang enters new global markets or launches new business lines.

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a proven ability to mentor and coach team members, guide cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority, and act as a trusted strategic thought partner to executive leadership.

Pay & Benefits

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $155,000/year in our lowest geographic market to $267,000/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

General Description of All Benefits

• Annual bonus is 0-20% of the base salary

• Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD&D insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) & Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Long-term/Short-term Disability

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program

• 401K Plan with Company Match

• 18-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure

• 12 Public Holidays

• Paid Parental leave

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

General Description of Other Compensation

“Other Compensation” includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale.

jobs.title: Associate, Medical Data Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Associate, MDS to support healthcare data initiatives through data analysis, validation, and quality assurance.

The role works closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and other stakeholders to support data requirements, investigate data-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in healthcare data processes.

Responsibilities

• Perform data analysis, validation, and reconciliation of healthcare datasets using SQL and Excel.

• Support data standardization, mapping, and development of business and medical data rules and logic.

• Investigate data-related issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with relevant teams towards resolution.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to clarify data needs and communicate findings.

• Maintain documentation and contribute to improvements in data quality and data management practices.

Requirements

Education

Degree or equivalent qualification in Data Science, Data Analytics, Health or Medical Informatics, Biomedical Science, Public Health, Statistics, Information Systems, Medicine, Health Sciences, or related fields.

Experience

1–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, healthcare data, data quality, business intelligence, or health informatics. Experience with healthcare or medical data is an advantage.

Technical Skills

• Proficient in SQL, including joins, aggregations, filters, CTEs, and window functions, for data querying and analysis.

• Proficient in Excel (lookups, pivots, conditional logic) to validate and compare datasets.

• Strong understanding of data quality principles such as completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication, and the ability to reconcile source against output.

• Practical experience in using AI to support data analysis, coding, and documentation while verifying outputs and protecting data confidentiality.

• Proficient in English; Mandarin and/or Malay is an advantage.

Good to Have

• Experience with visualisation or BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Superset.

• Exposure to data science or statistical modelling (e.g. Python, R).

• Familiarity with medical terminology or clinical coding standards such as ICD or SNOMED CT.

• Prior experience with healthcare systems, or with clinical or research datasets.

Preferred Traits

We are looking for someone who is:

• Analytical, with strong attention to detail and able to get to the root cause of discrepancies without prompting.

• Proactive and accountable, asking the right questions, flagging risks early, and driving assigned tasks to closure.

• Curious and eager to learn, building new technical and healthcare knowledge over time.

• Comfortable working independently, researching, and testing solutions before escalating.

• A clear communicator and team player, able to explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and to work effectively across Data Engineering, Data Science and other stakeholder teams.

• Meticulous with documentation, keeping logic, assumptions, and findings clear and reproducible.

• Insight-oriented, with the ability to translate data findings into meaningful implications for decision-makers.

• Mindful of data privacy and confidentiality when handling patient-level data.

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team:

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity:

As an NYC-based Strategic Account Manager, Marketing Programs, you will play a critical role in driving the growth and performance of Agoda and Priceline's North American hotel partner network. This is a highly cross-functional role that combines commercial account management, regional operations, analytics, and strategic project execution.

What You’ll Do:

You will work closely with Market Managers, Regional Directors, and commercial leadership to identify growth opportunities, improve partner performance, and support key regional initiatives. Leveraging data, market insights, and partner feedback, you will help shape supply strategies, optimize marketing program adoption, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive business results.

The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, comfortable working with data, and passionate about solving business problems in a fast-paced environment.

• Drive adoption and growth of Agoda and Priceline marketing and visibility programs across North America.

• Support hotel partners and internal teams in identifying opportunities to increase production, conversion, and overall partner performance.

• Maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities through proactive outreach and relationship management.

• Develop and deliver customized business reviews, presentations, and recommendations for internal and external stakeholders.

• Gather partner feedback and translate insights into scalable solutions and process improvements.

Regional Performance & Strategy

• Monitor regional performance trends and identify opportunities for growth, optimization, and risk mitigation.

• Partner with regional leadership to execute strategic initiatives and commercial priorities.

• Analyze supply, revenue, and performance metrics to provide actionable recommendations for leadership teams.

• Support quarterly planning, forecasting, and business reviews through data-driven insights.

• Escalate and help resolve operational or product issues that impact partner experience or regional performance.

Analytics & Operational Excellence

• Translate complex data into clear, concise recommendations for leadership

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting processes, and operational efficiency through technology and automation.

• Leverage AI and emerging technologies responsibly to improve productivity, insights generation, and decision-making.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 3-5+ years of experience in account management, business operations, strategy, analytics, consulting, project management, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

• Working knowledge of SQL (or similar query language) and experience with BI / data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Superset, etc.) or willingness to learn quickly

• Comfortable working with AI-powered tools and adopting new technologies.

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal); able to explain complex topics clearly and tailor the message to different audiences.

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

• Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision making.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization.

• Curiosity, ownership mindset, and a passion for driving measurable business impact.

At Orchard, we’re securing America’s food supply by building the AI Farmer that automates our nation’s farms. We are the industry leader, growing rapidly, and backed by more than $25 million from leading investors, including Quiet Capital, Shine Capital, and General Catalyst.



Every year, hundreds of billions of dollars in crop value are lost because critical farming decisions are made using incomplete and imprecise data. We’re building the technology to change that.



Our AI-powered camera systems mount to tractors and scan millions of trees, vines, and plants, capturing precise data on yield estimates, fruit size, crop health, disease, and more. We train edge vision AI models that analyze every plant and determine exactly what interventions and treatments it needs. That intelligence flows into FruitScope OS, our farm-management platform, where growers can understand their crops, make better decisions, and direct operations in the field.



Today, Orchard’s technology is trusted by some of our nation’s largest farms. They use our products to grow higher-quality crops while reducing chemical use and operating costs, helping them farm more profitably and sustainably than ever before.




OUR CULTURE:

 - Unshakeable Resilience – Our customers feed millions of people, and our customers depend on us. We are ultra-hardworking, never give up, and we do whatever it takes.

 - Always Keep Moving – We move fast, waste no time, and have an extreme bias towards action. Progress compounds every day, and our impact is measured in decades.

 - Improve Everything – At 1% success, we save millions of pounds of food from going to waste. If we are 100% successful we will impact the lives of billions of people across the world.

 - Farmers First – Every team member spends at least a few days in the fields with our farmers each month.

 - No Job Beneath Us – We’re low ego, own every outcome, and are all working towards the same goal.




THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Hardware Assembly Technician to build and test the AI-powered camera systems that enable our product on the farm. You’ll take cameras from individual mechanical and electrical components to fully assembled, configured, and tested systems ready for deployment.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes pride in precise, consistent work. You’ll follow detailed build procedures, install software on onboard computers, inspect and test finished hardware, and document what you find. 

Working with Manufacturing Operations and Hardware Engineering, you’ll also help keep parts available and improve the instructions and processes behind every build, helping us scale our production as we grow and deploy more systems than ever before. 




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Build complete camera systems from start to finish

 - Configure onboard NVIDIA Jetson computers

 - Inspect, test, and QA assembled hardware

 - Maintain build records and document completed work

 - Follow procedures consistently and provide feedback to improve our processes

 - Keep builds supplied, tracking and inventorying parts used in assembly

 - Keep builds on schedule, maintaining an organized work area and follow-through 




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Hands-on experience assembling electronics or electromechanical products, with a track record of careful, reliable work.

 - Practical mechanical and electrical knowledge and familiarity with common assembly tools and safe working practices.

 - Ability to read mechanical drawings and follow detailed work instructions accurately.

 - Experience with basic hardware inspection, functional testing, and troubleshooting.

 - Comfort using computers to follow software installation steps, enter information accurately, and maintain build and test records.

 - Strong attention to detail: you spot problems, document them clearly, and ask questions when something does not match the instructions.

 - Organization and follow-through across builds, parts tracking, and supplier follow-ups.

 - Experience following and improving standard operating procedures.

Helpful experience: Linux, NVIDIA Jetson setup, component purchasing, and inventory tracking.




ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Full-time role, five days a week at our San Francisco office

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of employee premiums covered.

 - Our team is close-knit and highly driven. You’ll take ownership of the quality and readiness of camera systems used by our farmers, with close collaboration across Manufacturing Operations and Hardware Engineering. You'll also have the opportunity to help improve assembly processes as Orchard’s hardware production scales.

 - We move fast, and sometimes this means staying late or working weekends.

 - We’re deeply motivated by the impact we’re making – every system we build and deploy means less food that goes to waste, and more people who are fed.

Agoda’s Brand team brings together, brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers, and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners, and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and brand trust. Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels, events, presentations, and other brand touchpoints.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Design Lead who combines exceptional design craft with experience managing and developing designers. This role carries both individual contributor and people management responsibilities. You will personally develop concepts and design key work, while guiding the team and raising the quality of its output.

A central focus will be making Agoda’s distinctive brand assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective through repeated use. You will shape how these assets appear across campaigns, channels, and markets, building familiarity while finding fresh, purposeful ways to express the brand.

You bring a refined eye for impactful design and a strong understanding of visual and message hierarchy. You can demonstrate your thinking through your own work, coach others to strengthen theirs, and use AI confidently in visual design and campaign development.

In this role you’ll get to

• Personally concept and design. Own design projects from brief through final execution, producing original work and contributing actively to the team’s everyday creative output.

• Strengthen Agoda’s distinctive brand assets. Develop consistent, inventive applications that make our assets more recognizable, versatile, and effective across touchpoints and over time.

• Lead and develop designers. Manage and coach the team, set clear expectations, and run constructive creative reviews. Give actionable feedback and demonstrate solutions through your own design work.

• Shape visual and message architecture. Work with copy, creative, and marketing partners to establish what audiences should notice first, understand next, and act on.

• Evolve our design guidelines. Develop practical principles, examples, and reusable resources that help teams and external partners use our brand assets consistently and imaginatively.

• Connect creative quality to business objectives. Present a clear rationale for design decisions, use audience insights and performance feedback to improve work, and balance priorities and deadlines. Collaborate with production specialists to carry the creative vision through delivery.

• Use AI to elevate design and brand campaigns. Apply AI tools confidently to develop campaign concepts, explore visual directions, and create and refine layouts and brand imagery. Guide the team in integrating AI into everyday design work while maintaining strong craft, clear message hierarchy, and consistent use of Agoda’s distinctive assets.

• 10+ years of design experience within creative, branding, or advertising agencies, with a strong record of personally delivering high-quality brand and marketing communications.

• Proven experience managing and developing a team of designers, alongside an active individual contribution to concept development and execution.

• An outstanding portfolio that clearly distinguishes your own design work from projects you directed, demonstrating exceptional craft and your ability to elevate the work of others.

• A refined eye for typography, composition, imagery, color, and spacing, with the ability to create elegant, distinctive work suited to the brand and audience.

• Strong command of visual hierarchy and message architecture, including the ability to simplify complex information and create a clear relationship between headlines, supporting content, and calls to action.

• Experience developing brand guidelines and distinctive assets, with an understanding of how consistent, repeated use builds recognition across campaigns and formats.

• The ability to explain why a design works and translate your judgment into specific feedback that helps designers improve their craft and confidence.

• Excellent collaboration and presentation skills, with experience aligning stakeholders and balancing creative ambition with business objectives and delivery requirements.

• Strong practical proficiency in core design tools such as Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop.

• Proficiency in using AI tools for visual design and brand campaign development, with practical experience creating and refining layouts, imagery, and campaign concepts. A strong eye for evaluating and improving AI outputs, ensuring they meet the brief and reflect the brand’s identity.

It’s great if you have

• Experience working with global brands and adapting creative across markets, languages, and cultural contexts.

• Experience using brand research or creative testing to strengthen the recognition and effectiveness of distinctive brand assets.

• Experience collaborating with motion, film, and automation specialists, providing clear creative direction throughout production.

• Experience bringing agency standards of craft and creative development into an internal brand team.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape Agoda’s visual expression and strengthen the impact of its distinctive brand assets.

• A role combining personal design ownership with the opportunity to develop a team and influence creative quality across the business.

• A collaborative environment with colleagues and specialist creative partners across disciplines.

• Opportunities to advance the use of AI and emerging creative tools while building on strong design foundations.

 - Troubleshoot hardware

 - Develop assembly and subassembly QA

 - Design for real-world use

 - Strong mechanical design and 3D CAD skills, including complex assemblies, production drawings, tolerancing, materials, fasteners, and DFM.

 - Clear documentation and communication, careful follow-through, and willingness to move between CAD, the workbench, and production troubleshooting.

jobs.title: Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you want to work on commercializing autonomy and robotics in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator to own how our DoorDash Labs sites run day to day and to follow every issue through to done. As the tier 2 layer between our front desk and procurement/inventory teams, you’ll triage the request queue, run equipment transport, manage vendor and facilities follow-up, host visitors and events, and coordinate onboarding as the team grows.

You’ll work closely with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, Workplace, Facilities, Finance, and engineering teams to keep our sites safe, organized, and ready as the team roughly doubles next year.

The Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator will report to the Supply Chain Lead.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own the equipment transport queue (EOS / drones): set priorities, schedule pickups, track every request in Jira, and manage no-shows across sites

• Triage the daily request queue, making small calls independently and escalating larger decisions (e.g., security, construction, AV)

• Own tickets and follow-up with Workplace, landlords, and service vendors (cleaning, pest, dumpster, repairs, ServiceChannel), and maintain a weekly open-issues list

• Walk each site regularly (gate, dumpster, kitchen, restrooms, common areas), log issues, and track corrective work through completion

• Plan and run hosting: catering orders, demo-day logistics, visitor and event prep, rooms, and shuttles

• Own the new hire onboarding checklist (desk, badge, access, equipment, orientation) and track desk counts as the team grows

• Initiate site-level requests (e.g., furniture, desks, cabinets) and hand off to Procurement & Inventory for purchase

• Take over contractor contract renewals, contractor onboarding, and Coupa processes, including a backlog of contractors expiring at year end

• Partner with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, and Facilities to build repeatable playbooks that can be reused across sites

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities coordination, workplace operations, or operations coordination across one or more sites

• You are highly organized and own follow-through — nothing falls through the cracks until it is closed

• You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, and are comfortable managing vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders

• You can juggle multiple priorities — transport requests, vendor follow-ups, events, and onboarding — in a fast-paced environment, including same-day requests

• You’re comfortable with everyday operations and procurement systems (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Coupa, Brex, ServiceChannel, or similar)

• You bring sound judgment: you can make small calls independently and know when to escalate larger decisions

• You bring discretion and a customer-focused mindset to everything you do

Nice to Have...

• Experience in a tech startup or fast-paced corporate environment

• Experience with Coupa, contractor onboarding, or contract renewals

• Experience supporting multi-site operations or new site openings

• Experience planning and running hosted events, demos, or catering

• Experience supporting hardware, robotics, or R&D teams with inventory or parts handling

We expect this position to be filled by 01-09-2027

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$76,900—$113,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Hardware Fleet Operations Specialist

Location: Aliso Viejo, CA - Hybrid

Contract role: 12 months

As a part of Sony Interactive Entertainment, GDFT is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

The Hardware Fleet Operations team is a critical component of our support structure that enables GDFT to successfully operate a global footprint at scale. This role focuses on Linux terminal-based troubleshooting beyond documented workflows, investigating recurring issues, managing the hardware lifecycle, and improving documentation and runbooks. You will partner with various engineering groups to transition operational support work to the Hardware Fleet Operations team. The role also includes building lightweight scripts or basic automation to reduce manual effort and enable other support teams to handle repeatable tasks more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to operational support requests in a 24/5 environment, meeting SLAs and prioritizing work across internal customers and cross-functional teams.

• Troubleshoot and support Linux-based hardware systems using terminal-based tools, addressing issues that require investigation beyond existing documentation.

• Identify recurring operational issues and work with engineering teams to stabilize and operationalize support workflows.

• Create, update, and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal documentation based on real-world support findings.

• Develop and maintain lightweight scripts or simple automation to reduce manual tasks and improve operational consistency.

• Support the transition of operational workloads from engineering teams into the Hardware Fleet Operations team.

Who We Are Looking For

• 2-3 years of hands-on experience supporting or troubleshooting Linux-based systems.

• Prior experience in a technical support, operations, or IT service delivery role.

• Comfortable in working primarily in Linux terminal environments.

• Experience following and improving runbooks, documentation, and operational processes.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Jira or ServiceNow in an operations context.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and solutions for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Linux terminal-based troubleshooting

• Basic scripting or automation (e.g., Bash, Python, or similar)

• IT support fundamentals, including systems and basic networking concepts (Network+ level or equivalent)

Compensation: $40-45/Hour

Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
Who we are
We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive meaningful behavior change.
From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Phishing clicks trigger bite-sized, targeted follow-up courses that drive behavior change without taking up a ton of training time. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.
More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to the trading desk. Our learning paths drop seat time by 60%, learners give our training a 93% approval rating, and 96% of customers renew.
Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.
 
How we work
We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
 
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.


Who we're looking for
Ethena is growing fast, and we need a finance leader who’s excited to build what comes next. As our Head of Finance, you’ll own the full finance function, from accounting and close to forecasting, planning, and board reporting. You’ll report to our COO and work closely with her to give our leadership team the data and insight behind our biggest decisions. You’ll also give every department head a clear line of sight into their budget. We’re looking for someone with a real point of view. You’ll spot the risks and opportunities in the numbers before anyone asks and turn complex data into clear and actionable takeaways. You’ll be hands-on in the details one day and zoomed out on strategy the next. Along the way, you’ll build a high-performing finance team that holds itself to a high bar.
What you’ll do
Partner with the COO to drive smart decisions. You’ll keep leadership equipped with a clear, current view of financials, forecasts, and runway. You’ll also pull together and synthesize the data behind our biggest calls. You’ll flag risks and opportunities early, lay out the levers we can pull, and bring a recommendation on things like a smarter way to deploy spend or a cost that’s growing faster than its value. Then you’ll turn it into takeaways the exec team can act on.
Partner with RevOps on revenue and comp plans. You’ll work with our Head of RevOps to turn pipeline and attainment data into financial insight on unit economics, retention, and sales efficiency. You’ll oversee commission and comp plans.
Give every department head line of sight. You’ll work with each leader so they always know where their budget stands, what’s changed, and what tradeoffs they’re facing.
Own planning and forecasting. That covers the annual plan, quarterly reforecasts, the operating model, the cash forecast, and scenario planning for pricing, hiring, and growth.
Oversee accounting end to end. You’ll oversee month-end and year-end close, AR/AP, revenue recognition, and tax, and build a faster, cleaner close as we scale.
Lead the audit and keep us compliant. You’ll own the annual audit and keep us current on tax and regulatory requirements everywhere we operate.
Manage investor and lender relationships. You’ll own board and investor reporting, manage our banking and lending partners, and lead fundraising work from model to data room.
Level up the finance function. You’ll grow and lead the team, decide what to bring in-house versus outsource, and use AI and automation to keep a lean team operating well above its size.
What makes a great candidate
You cut your teeth in FP&A and have since overseen every part of finance, including accounting, at early stage and fast-growing SaaS companies.
You’ve built and led a finance team, and you’ve been the person accountable for the numbers, not just a contributor to them.
You’ve run an audit, supported a fundraise, and presented directly to a board.
You’re as comfortable reconciling an account as you are presenting a growth plan to the board.
You have a strong point of view and share it. You come with a recommendation and the math behind it, and you change your mind when the data says you should.
You can make finance make sense to anyone, from a first-time manager to a board member.
You’re highly autonomous and do your best work when you’re trusted to run your function.
You care about building a team with a culture of excellence, and you know how to hire, coach, and raise the bar.
You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to automate work, build models, and get to insights faster, and you’d rather build a tool than hire for a task.
You thrive on a fully distributed team, and move fast without losing rigor.
