jobs.title: Staff Systems Test Engineer, Scenario Quality and Maintenance Systems
jobs.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo's Systems Engineering team works together to blend software and hardware systems in groundbreaking new ways. We set the high performance standards that ensure our vehicles run smoothly and keep passengers safe, then design and perform the tests that validate that performance. We're looking for talented teammates who’ll help us maintain strong teamwork and are passionate about driving results.

Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success:

Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026) and launching new vehicle platforms. Scenario Ops plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. The team owns the scaled delivery and maintenance of simulation-based directed testing coverage used to evaluate the Safety and performance of the driver as Waymo continues to scale.

In this hyrbid role, you will be reporting to a Staff Program Manager

You will:

• Design Scalable Quality Architecture: Move the organization towards scalable QC (Quality Control) methodologies for test creation (e.g., statistical sampling, risk-based auditing, and automated validation). Be the primary architect of how we verify work at increased scale

• Manage meta-quality assurance: Develop and manage our meta-quality framework to drive overall test quality assurance. Build dashboards and identify opportunities to improve first-time accuracy and reduce rework rates

• Maintain test health: Drive increased automation in detection and resolution of test health issues identified in our vast scenario test database to keep quality / test uptime high

• Create the playbook: Develop the playbook for making maintenance adjustments at scale by leveraging tooling automation strategically while also partnering w/ SMEs to develop standards and guidelines that enable our vendor workforce to drive efficient resolution

You have:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or other relevant technical field

• 8+ years of experience in Test Engineering, QA Engineering, Software Development in Test, Site Reliability Engineering, Technical Operations or other equivalent experience

• Excellent debugging and Python/C++ coding skills

• Proficiency in SQL or other data analysis tools

• Experience architecting testing programs at scale

• Experience leading / driving test automation strategies

• Ability to thrive in a high ambiguity, dynamic environment

We prefer:

• Experience with software development for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or similar

• Familiarity with AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) sampling or other statistical process control methodologies

• Experience with Lean / Six Sigma process improvement methodologies

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$230,000—$284,000 USD

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Internal Platforms
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER, INTERNAL PLATFORMS

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX

• Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates

• Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints

• Own all aspects of software engineering and product development

• Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions

• Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree

• Experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language

• 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications

• Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts

• Expertise in designing software systems

• Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring

• Expertise in profiling and improving application performance

• Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)

• Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them

• Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies

• Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework

• Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Deployments
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Every Base battery that ends up on a home runs through Deployments Software. We use it to evaluate sites, file permits, schedule installs, dispatch technicians, and maintain batteries once they're live.

We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to build the systems driving these workflows.

The problems we work on are varied. You might be building systems for 3D spatial analysis, developing automation platforms, designing scheduling algorithms for technician matching and route optimization, building real-time, multiplayer, offline-capable APIs, or designing infrastructure for monitoring and alerting.

Our software is used by teams across Base, subcontractor electricians, and utility partners. You'll work closely with engineers across Deployments, Inventory, Onboarding, Markets, and Embedded Software to design the services, APIs, and data models that support these products.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build backend systems that support Base’s deployment operations, from site evaluation and scheduling to field execution and ongoing maintenance.

 - Solve a wide range of technical problems, including automation, scheduling and optimization, real-time systems, spatial analysis, and monitoring infrastructure.

 - Build reliable services, APIs, and data models that other engineers and teams depend on.

 - Work closely with engineers and operational teams to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and develop practical solutions.

 - Own your systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Strong backend engineering experience in Go, Java, TypeScript, or similar languages.

 - Experience designing and operating production services, APIs, and data models.

 - A solid understanding of distributed systems, including reliability, concurrency, consistency, and failure handling.

 - Good engineering judgment, with an ability to balance simplicity, extensibility, and technical rigor.

 - High ownership, clear communication, and a willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems and domains.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Deployments Software Team builds the software that runs Base’s deployment operations, from evaluating homes for installs to managing a growing fleet of batteries in the field. Our work directly impacts how quickly Base scales and how reliably we operate.

Base is vertically integrated, which means our engineers work directly with the teams that depend on our software, from field operations and inventory to hardware and embedded software. Within Deployments Software, you'll work alongside engineers who own different products and systems across the deployment lifecycle.

We are an in-person team that moves quickly, values simplicity, and gives engineers a lot of ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to make technical decisions, the responsibility to own your systems in production, and the opportunity to see the impact of your work in the real world.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Director of Facilities
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Director, Facilities and Maintenance leads facilities strategy and operations across Eataly North America Restaurants & Markets and Caffès. The Director is responsible for multi-site maintenance, building infrastructure, asset lifecycle and capital planning, cleaning and sanitation, security, utilities, compliance, emergency response, and vendor performance. This role establishes consistent standards, systems and performance measures across locations; manages facilities operating and capital expenditures; and partners with Operations, Food Safety, Health & Safety, Finance, Procurement, Legal, landlords, and Design and Construction. The Director ensures work is completed safely, efficiently, within regulatory requirements, approved budgets and established timelines, and supports facilities readiness for new openings. Reports to the VP, Operations.

• Provides leadership, management guidance and technical direction to Facilities Managers and store maintenance teams across Eataly North America, including hiring, training, performance management, standard operating procedures and allocation of technical resources.
• Manages building infrastructure and critical systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, building management systems, commercial kitchen equipment, hoods and fire suppression, refrigeration and walk-ins, elevators and escalators, fire protection and other mechanical systems.
• Establishes common work-order and asset management standards across locations, including preventive maintenance, asset and service records, repair prioritization, escalation and timely work-order completion.
• Assesses equipment condition and owns multi-year asset lifecycle and replacement planning, including repair-versus-replace decisions based on total cost of ownership, CAPEX requests, business cases and appropriate OPEX versus CAPEX treatment.
• Develops short- and long-range maintenance plans and directs site repair, construction and preventive maintenance projects to ensure effective resource use and completion within approved scope, schedule and budget.
• Defines and monitors facilities KPIs, including preventive maintenance completion, response and resolution time, equipment downtime, repeat repairs, vendor SLA performance and cost per store or square foot; drives corrective actions and continuous improvement.
• Builds, forecasts and manages facilities OPEX budgets by store in partnership with Finance; monitors variances, controls expenditures and identifies savings opportunities while maintaining safety, compliance and service quality.
• Runs competitive RFP and tender processes as needed, including scopes of work, vendor prequalification, bid comparisons, scorecards and award recommendations; negotiates MSAs, rate cards and SLAs with Procurement, Health & Safety, Legal and Finance.
• Manages vendor relationships, contracts and performance for maintenance, cleaning, security, pest control, waste and grease disposal, utilities and other facilities services; validates invoices against contracted terms, approved work and supplies received.
• Clarifies and manages landlord and tenant maintenance responsibilities under applicable leases, coordinates maintenance requests with landlord representatives and follows through to resolution.
• Ensures facilities comply with applicable federal, state and local building, fire, environmental, workplace safety and life-safety requirements, including OSHA requirements and relevant codes.
• Establishes systems to ensure locations complete required inspections, testing, recordkeeping and permit renewals, including fire suppression, sprinklers, alarms, backflow and elevators; implements escalation and corrective-action protocols for code violations or failed inspections.
• Leads facilities emergency response and business continuity for critical equipment failures and utility interruptions, including on-call coverage, emergency vendor agreements, escalation protocols and contingency plans for refrigeration, power and HVAC.
• Oversees health and safety practices within facilities operations, including hazard identification, contractor safety and timely corrective actions, in partnership with Operations and Health & Safety leadership.
• Oversees purchasing, inventory, storage and safe use of cleaning supplies and manages cleaning and sanitation programs, service schedules and quality standards across locations.
• Partners with Operations and Food Safety teams to ensure facilities, equipment, cleaning practices and sanitation programs support food safety requirements and coordinates corrective actions following inspections and audits.
• Oversees security services, coverage and vendor performance and coordinates with location leadership on security concerns and incident follow-up.
• Manages utility providers, usage and costs and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce expenditure.
• Collaborates with Design and Construction on new openings and capital projects, providing input on maintainability, equipment, cleaning, security and utilities and coordinating facilities readiness, handover documentation, warranties and service contracts.
• Participates in meetings, workshops and seminars to communicate and gather information required to perform the role.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Facilities Engineering, Engineering, Construction Management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• 7+ years of progressive facilities or engineering management experience in a large-scale, multi-site operation; supermarket, restaurant, hospitality or other food-service environment experience preferred.
• Demonstrated experience leading distributed facilities and maintenance teams and establishing consistent processes, standards and accountability across locations.
• Hands-on technical knowledge of commercial kitchen equipment, refrigeration and walk-ins, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building management systems, hoods and fire suppression, elevators and escalators, and other building mechanical systems.
• Working knowledge of federal, state and local building, fire, environmental, workplace safety and life-safety codes, regulations, permitting and inspection requirements, including OSHA requirements.
• Experience with capital planning, asset lifecycle management, total-cost-of-ownership analysis and repair-versus-replace decisions.
• Experience building and managing facilities OPEX and CAPEX budgets, forecasts, business cases and variance reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Build Engineer, Turbomachinery
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running.  Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Radiant is seeking a highly motivated Senior Build Engineer to lead the assembly, integration, and build execution of high-performance turbomachinery systems for our portable nuclear microreactor. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong mechanical fundamentals, precision assembly experience, and the ability to independently solve complex hardware challenges.

You will take ownership of prototype and first-article turbomachinery builds, working closely with design, manufacturing, and test teams to translate engineering designs into functional, test-ready hardware. This role will be instrumental in developing assembly processes, resolving integration challenges, and improving hardware reliability and build repeatability as we advance toward production.



RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:


TURBOMACHINERY BUILD & INTEGRATION

 - Lead hands-on assembly, integration, and troubleshooting of complex turbomachinery hardware, including compressors, turbines, rotors, electric motors, bearings, seals, and housings.

 - Own precision assembly operations, including rotor stacking, bearing installation, balancing, alignment, and mechanical fit-up.

 - Interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, and mechanical specifications to ensure proper assembly and hardware functionality.

 - Identify and resolve assembly challenges involving tight tolerances, component interfaces, alignment, and mechanical interference.

 - Drive first-article build execution, ensuring hardware meets engineering requirements and is ready for testing and validation.


BUILD PROCESS DEVELOPMENT & TOOLING

 - Develop, implement, and refine assembly processes, work instructions, alignment procedures, and torque specifications for complex rotating machinery.

 - Design and develop custom assembly tooling, fixtures, and work-holding solutions to improve build efficiency, precision, and repeatability.

 - Evaluate assembly methods, identify process improvements, and establish best practices for transitioning prototype builds toward repeatable production processes.

 - Maintain detailed build documentation, including as-built configurations, inspection results, nonconformances, and lessons learned.


TECHNICAL PROBLEM-SOLVING & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Partner closely with design, manufacturing, and test engineers to resolve hardware integration challenges and improve design for manufacturability and assembly.

 - Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for assembly defects, mechanical failures, and hardware nonconformances.

 - Provide technical feedback on component design, tolerances, material selection, and assembly interfaces to improve hardware performance and reliability.

 - Support hardware testing, including pre-test inspections, post-test teardown, failure investigations, and implementation of design or process improvements.

 - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians, establishing high standards for precision assembly, workmanship, and build quality.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

 - 5+ years of relevant experience in mechanical assembly, hardware integration, manufacturing, or build engineering involving complex mechanical systems.

 - Demonstrated hands-on experience assembling, integrating, and troubleshooting precision mechanical hardware.

 - Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, mechanical fits, fasteners, torque requirements, and alignment principles.

 - Proficiency in reading and interpreting complex engineering drawings, assembly documentation, and 3D CAD models.

 - Experience developing assembly procedures, troubleshooting hardware issues, and improving build processes.

 - Strong mechanical aptitude and first-principles problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently resolve complex technical challenges.

 - Ability to work effectively across design, manufacturing, and test engineering teams in a fast-paced hardware development environment.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - Direct experience with turbomachinery, gas turbines, compressors, high-speed rotating equipment, or power generation systems.

 - Experience with precision rotor assembly, dynamic balancing, bearing installation, shaft alignment, and high-speed rotating machinery.

 - Familiarity with precision measurement and inspection techniques, including dial indicators, micrometers, bore gauges, and other metrology equipment.

 - Experience designing or developing custom assembly fixtures, tooling, and mechanical ground support equipment.

 - Familiarity with rotor dynamics, thermal growth, bearing preload, interference fits, and mechanical clearances.

 - Experience supporting first-article builds, prototype development, hardware testing, and design iteration.

 - Experience transitioning complex hardware from engineering development to repeatable production processes.

 - Prior nuclear industry experience is not required.


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and occasional weekends to support critical build and test schedules.

 - Must work 100% onsite at Radiant's El Segundo headquarters.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.



Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s full-time new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.




THE ROLE 

This is an opportunity to own multiple components of our growth function in one of Encord's fastest-growing markets: from our billboards or campaigns on X, to our exec dinners, founder PR or flagship annual summit. You'll have a founder-mentality, move with relentless urgency, and own outcomes rather than tasks.

If you want to start a company one day, or already have, this is a chance to help build a hyper-growth GTM function from 0 to 1. You'll own important growth outcomes for the company, work directly with leadership and our founders, and get as much scope as you can handle (as fast as you can earn it). Our team is small and we all roll up our sleeves, from packing hundreds of swag boxes, to cold outbounding a famous podcast to book our founders an interview. 



Some of what you could own in your first months:

 - Growth hacks: come up with scrappy, creative ways to get in front of the AI leaders at the companies we most want to work with

 - A bold IRL launch: take an out-of-home campaign or stunt in New York or SF from idea to street, owning the concept, budget, locations and distribution

 - Executive dinners: own multiple exec dinners with the AI teams at the companies we most want to work with; own pipeline goals and oversee the logistics

 - Content and PR: own the ideation, budget, schedule and distribution of high-value content that reflects our leadership in the space




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Encord's growth end-to-end, helping pick the bets, own the execution and achieve ambitious growth goals for the company

 - Become the Encord product and customer expert - you'll know our customers by name, deeply understand why leading AI teams choose Encord and how to accelerate our growth

 - Take full ownership of projects as you prove yourself, coming up with your own ideas for how Encord can grow and executing on them

 - Help build an exceptional growth team that delivers on larger and larger outcomes, as we rapidly scale

 - Own the outcome: examine the performance of what we're delivering, track results and proactively identify what's working/not working (and quickly adapt)




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in a high-velocity environment: starting a company as a founder, top-tier banking or investing, early hire at a hyper-growth startup, or similar. 

 - High-agency and founder-mentality: you have a strong sense of self-initiative and always find a creative solution around obstacles where others get stuck

 - Eager for a non-linear growth path (and driven to put in the work needed to achieve it)

 - Customer-centric and sales-focused: you want to deeply understand how our business works, why our customers choose Encord and what makes a 'great' Encord customer; you want to learn to speak the language of our market and be respected by customers/prospects, have them on speed-dial

 - Ruthlessly focused on results: you set and internalize our north start metrics and goals, and refuse to spend time on 'vanity' tasks or initiatives that don't help us make progress

 - You want to roll up your sleeves: you know most of the work required to grow a company is not glamorous, and you deeply care to do a great job on every sub-component required to get to the result

 - You're curious, and always hunting for, new avenues for growth: you want to find new S curves for the company and can juggle 'always on' with bold new bets

 - Evidence that you make important outcomes happen & can pull others along with you: events, projects, campaigns, or businesses you drove yourself




WHY ENCORD

 - Generational opportunity to shape how AI will develop in the real-world

 - Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a hyper-growth startup

 - Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

 - Strong in-person culture in our East Village (NY - just launched), Jackson Square (SF), and Soho (London) offices: +4 days/week

 - Daily team lunches & dinners

 - Annual learning & development budget

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

 - US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

 - UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus bank holidays

 - Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

 - Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials




OPERATING PRINCIPLES

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

Demonstrated experience with open-source foundation models, including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or equivalent.

Strong experience with LoRA, QLoRA, supervised fine-tuning, model evaluation, and optimization.

Deep knowledge of GPU computing, model quantization, batching, memory management, and inference performance.

Production experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or comparable inference technologies.

Strong distributed-systems architecture and cloud infrastructure expertise.

Proven ability to independently build and deploy complex AI systems rather than exclusively managing engineering teams.

Experience leading engineering initiatives and establishing technical standards across multiple AI projects.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building consumer AI platforms operating at significant scale.

Multilingual and multimodal AI engineering experience.

Recommendation systems, ranking algorithms, and personalization.

Real-time AI inference and streaming architectures.

Contributions to open-source AI projects or published AI research.

US Salary Range

$124,000—$164,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager (NYC)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US



At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.









ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Professional Services team is the bridge between LangChain's technology and the enterprise customers building on top of it. We partner with some of the world's most ambitious companies to help them move from pilot to production — designing solutions, accelerating time-to-value, and ensuring teams get the most out of LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. We work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer partnership, and we take pride in the outcomes our customers achieve. As LangChain grows, PS plays a direct role in shaping how enterprise AI gets built in the real world.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for an Engagement Manager to join our Professional Services team. You'll manage multiple concurrent technical engagements, ensuring successful delivery of Professional Services projects for enterprise customers. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape processes and methodologies, and the chance to work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Location: This role can be based in our San Francisco or New York office. Employees within commuting distance work from the office five days per week. Candidates who live outside commuting distance (e.g. >1hr each way) may be eligible for hybrid arrangements depending on location and role requirements. Open to remote candidates within the US.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Engagement Lifecycle Management: Manage the full engagement lifecycle from SOW review through closeout, including planning, execution, risk management, scope management, and handoff

 - Customer Communication & Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers — deliver status updates, manage expectations, handle escalations, and negotiate scope changes

 - Multi-Engagement Management: Manage 5–8 concurrent technical engagements simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Solution Architects, AI Engineers, Sales, Support, Enablement, and Product/Engineering teams; manage resource allocation and capacity planning

 - Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, track resolution, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - You have 5+ years of engagement or project management experience, preferably with technical or software engagements

 - You've managed multiple concurrent engagements and know how to keep quality high across all of them

 - You have strong experience working with enterprise customers and leading customer-facing communication

 - You've coordinated cross-functional technical teams — engineers, architects, product — and managed resource allocation

 - You're experienced with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana, or similar

 - You've handled scope change management and complex stakeholder dynamics

 - You have start-up DNA: you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and don't wait to be told what to do

 - You're a natural communicator — clear, direct, and effective with both technical teams and executive stakeholders

You exemplify our operating principles

 - You are motivated to build something great: you hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact

 - You embrace hot takes: you share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate

 - You operate with maximum agency: you take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock

 - You run to the roar: you lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges


NICE TO HAVE:

 - PMP or similar project management certification

 - Experience in Professional Services or consulting

 - Experience with AI/ML or infrastructure engagements

 - Experience with time tracking and billing coordination

 - Knowledge of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies
   
   


COMPENSATION 

$150,000-$190,000 base salary + equity 

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Job Purpose and Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work.  We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Pharmacy Technicians (Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise.

As a Technician, you will support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Technicians are often the first point of contact to assist our patients and customers to deliver an exceptional experience. Technicians assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Technicians operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

Once in role, Technicians are required to complete a rigorous company training program and satisfy all registration, licensing, and certification requirements according to their State’s Board of Pharmacy guidelines. Until the Pharmacy Technician has completed all necessary requirements, duties may be restricted by the Pharmacy Manager.

A Technician is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

• Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists manage and improve patient health
• Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
• Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
• Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
• Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
• Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
• Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the Pharmacy Technician may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

• Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
• Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
• Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
• Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient
• Monitoring and managing vaccine supplies

jobs.description:

Title: Medical Scribe

Company: Oak Street Health

Role Description:

The purpose of a Clinical Informatics Specialist (CIS or Medical Scribe) at Oak Street Health is to support our primary care providers with clinical documentation so that they can focus on providing exceptional care to our patients. Scribes assist providers throughout the patient care journey - huddling each morning to plan for the day's visits, joining them in the exam room to observe and document, and touching base after the visit to assist with next steps.

Beyond the typical Scribe role, these important care team members serve as clinical documentation assistants to their paired provider. Internally, we call them CISs (Clinic Informatics Specialists) in recognition of their important role in supporting accurate, specific, and timely clinical documentation. In addition to observing and documenting all patient encounters in real time, our Scribes become experts in our value-based care model and the documentation and care of chronic conditions, including ICD-10 and CPT coding. Scribes use this expertise to help providers identify and help close care gaps. Scribes receive extensive on-the-job training in clinical workflows, value-based medicine, preventative care for chronic conditions, accurate and specific documentation, population health data streams, and team based care.

Because our patients and providers rely on our Scribes, the ideal candidate should commit at least 1-2 years to this role. This is an excellent opportunity for pre-med track individuals looking to gain practical, paid experience in a clinical setting before applying to an MD/DO/PA/NP program, as well as those pursuing careers in Health Informatics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Medical Coding, and other related fields.

Responsibilities:

• Documenting Patient Encounters ~ 80%Joining the provider in the exam room to observe patient visitsDocumenting patient encounters in a structured note, including the history of the present illness, assessment, plan, and physical examAssigning appropriate CPT and ICD-10 codesPreparing After Visit SummariesConsulting with provider to ensure accurate and specific documentation
• Clinical Documentation Improvement ~ 10%Requesting and reviewing medical recordsLeveraging Oak Street's population health tools to support clinical documentation improvementPreparing for and supporting Daily Huddles and Clinical Documentation ReviewsConsulting with provider on clinical documentation opportunities
• Administrative support for your provider and care team ~ 10%Placing orders and referralsAddressing tasksSupporting the care team with additional responsibilities related to clinical documentation
• Other duties as assigned

What we're looking for

Knowledge

• Knowledge of medical terminology and common medications, either from a pre-medical degree or prior clinical experience [required]
• Prior clinical experience, including shadowing and/or volunteering [strongly preferred]
• Prior scribe or transcription experience [preferred but not required]

Skills

• Advanced listening and communication skills [required]
• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new technical workflows [required]
• Fluency in Spanish, Polish, Russian, or other languages spoken by people in the communities we serve [required where indicated]

Abilities

• Ability to adapt to new workflows and to quickly learn new concepts and skills [required]
• Ability to type 70+ words per minute [strongly preferred]

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work.  We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Graduate Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a Graduate Pharmacy Intern, you will apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school and pharmacy practice into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor and District Leader, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap within 120 days of graduation designed to further your knowledge of store, district, and regional operations. Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, and time spent with leaders in your district you will deepen your understanding of patient safety and error prevention, quality assurance drug utilization review (DUR), pharmacy professional standards such as corresponding responsibility and red flag detection. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

• Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health

• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
• Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
• Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
• Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
• Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
• Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
• Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
• Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security

jobs.title: Café Coach - Georgetown
jobs.description:
Café Coach - Georgetown

Do you find your purpose in empowering others and leading high-performing teams? As a Café Coach, you are the driving force behind Capital One’s mission to change banking for good. We’ve broken the mold of traditional banking - you won’t find your team behind teller lines, and you won’t be managing from a back office. Instead, you’ll lead from the front, right on the floor, cultivating an inclusive culture centered on every customer, every time.

In this role, you will act as a trusted mentor and strategist for a team of Café Ambassadors - high-end service specialists who bridge the gap between digital banking and human connection. You aren't just managing a location; you’re building a community by bringing Capital One’s mission to life within a vibrant, welcoming hub.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a management job - it’s leadership with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus entirely on investing in your team’s growth and elevating the guest experience. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest heavily in your leadership journey, ensuring you have the tools to empower your people, inspire your community, and show up highly effective in your role every single day.

The Perks

We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you - within Capital One or into the wider world - you leave the Cafe stronger than when you started.

• Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Education Assistance
• Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
• Paid Parental Leave
• Mental Health support
• Back-up Child or Elder Care
• Fit check? Covered. We’ll hook you up with our signature Threads line - our treat
• Custom beverage while working
• And much more!

What You’ll Actually Do

• Cultivate "Every Customer, Every Time": You are obsessed with the guest experience. Because our Cafés are free from traditional sales goals and high-pressure tactics, you will coach your team to measure success by the depth and quality of human connection, ensuring every single interaction is impactful.
• Lead through Behavioral Coaching: You lead through active presence, creating a supportive, high-energy environment where your leadership style is defined by your ability to include, empower, and inspire your team. Grounded in real-time observation and continuous behavioral feedback, you focus on how your team shows up for our guests rather than traditional numeric quotas. You measure your own success by the confidence, professional growth, and collective excellence of your team.
• Bring the Capital One Brand to Life: You take pride in our brand and our physical space. You will coach your team to maintain a pristine environment and serve as an authentic advocate for Capital One’s values. Your role does not involve making coffee or leading baristas. We have Food & Beverage partners for that. You will work together to co-steward the space. Our operations are independent of each other, but you ensure the collective vibe and customer experience are flawlessly aligned to our high standards.
• Lead with an Owner’s Mindset & Drive Continuous Improvement: You approach the Café with a franchise ownership attitude and a forward-thinking mindset that never settles for the status quo. You drive operational excellence, listen to customer feedback with patience, and uncover insights to constantly iterate and elevate the space - ensuring your team meets customer-centric goals and the Café experience is always evolving.
• Anchor a Well-Managed Operation: You know that a truly exceptional guest experience requires a rock-solid operational foundation. While we’ve replaced the traditional bank feel with a relaxed, welcoming vibe, we never compromise on security, risk management, or compliance. You will flawlessly oversee daily operational routines, safeguard customer privacy, and ensure strict adherence to Capital One’s policies—creating a safe, sound, and seamlessly managed environment so your team can stay focused on building meaningful human connections.
• Empower De-escalation & Resourceful Problem-Solving: No two days in the Café look the same, and you build a team with the critical thinking skills to handle the unexpected. You will coach and empower Café Ambassadors to be strong, independent problem solvers who can confidently navigate scenarios they may have never encountered before - whether that’s guiding a customer through a unique situation or smoothing out an unexpected operational wrinkle. Your focus is on building their problem-solving confidence and teaching them how to diffuse tension, while remaining the ultimate safety net, ready to step in for leader interventions when highly complex situations arise.
• Embrace Digital Innovation & Simplify the Complex: You are digitally savvy and forward-thinking. On the floor, you will coach your team on how to help guests easily navigate our mobile and online banking experiences. Behind the scenes, you bring a sense of curiosity to leveraging emerging technology like AI and GEMS to streamline processes, solve problems, and remove administrative burdens - ensuring your team’s energy remains focused entirely where it matters most: on deeply human-centered activities.
• Drive Purposeful Community Impact: You understand your local market and know how to bring people together. You will guide your team as they host events and build relationships, ensuring all local engagement aligns seamlessly with Capital One’s established programs and strategic community partnerships for maximum, professional impact.

Basic Qualifications

• High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
• At least 2 years of Customer, Retail, or Financial Services experience
• At least 1 year of People Management experience or 2 years Retail Bank Experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree
• 3+ years of Customer, Retail, or Financial Services experience
• 2+ years of People Management experience

Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

jobs.title: Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Relationship Manager

Are you a natural born people person who thrives on cultivating relationships with others? Does being a strategic thinker strike a chord with you? Look no further; a Relationship Manager Associate at Capital One is the opportunity for both! This role will facilitate strong partnerships with dealers and sales managers while providing high level customer service to our internal Auto Finance business. You will be influencing 60-80 dealerships, building positive relationships with them while supporting the outside sales managers.

A Relationship Manager will also be the first line of contact for Capital One Auto Finance (COAF) involving issues in underwriting and funding. Furthermore, the Relationship Manager makes outbound phone calls to dealers to capture their business for COAF, while also taking inbound calls from the dealers to strategically analyze their potential territories resulting in a game plan to achieve a target goal. A Relationship Manager will monitor and make adjustments to the plan as the month progresses to achieve the desired goals.

A collaborative, highly empathetic team member who actively listens to stakeholder needs, applies emotional intelligence to build trust and drive business decisions grounded in customer impact.

General Responsibilities:

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.

As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.

What You’ll Actually Do

The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.

The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.

The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.

The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. Company Description

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose - to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.

You're an Individual. We're the team for you. Together, let's transform the way the world pays.

Job Description

Visa is seeking a Senior Manager of Sponsorship Commercial Strategy & Asset Management to strengthen the commercial foundation for Visa's sponsorship portfolio within Global Marketing Services, with an initial emphasis on sports and gaming properties.

This role will develop scalable pricing and valuation frameworks, commercial models, performance reporting, and decision-support tools that help Marketing Services evaluate opportunities, strengthen client offerings, and drive sustainable revenue.

Working across Sports, Gaming, Music, and other sponsorship priorities, the Senior Manager will bring greater consistency and visibility to how commercial opportunities are modeled, priced, monitored, and evaluated. The role will partner closely with Sponsorship Commercialization leads, Global Sponsorships, Finance, Regional Marketing Services, and other cross-functional teams.

About Marketing Services

Marketing Services is Visa's global B2B marketing solutions practice, focused on driving incremental client engagement by commercializing Visa's marketing expertise, developing scalable, client-facing offerings, and activating Visa's sponsorships to deliver best-in-class solutions for our clients.

Essential Functions

• Develop commercial strategy and frameworks

• Create and maintain consistent pricing, valuation, and packaging frameworks across sponsorship properties.

• Develop scenario models to evaluate revenue potential, costs, client value, and key investment trade-offs.

Drive asset management and utilization

• Partner with Sponsorships and portfolio leads to maintain visibility into available inventory and ensure Marketing Services assets are effectively deployed across clients and regions.

• Track allocated sponsorship assets across availability, holds, commitments, utilization, and commercial outcomes.

• Identify underused inventory, demand patterns, and opportunities to improve packaging, allocation, and monetization.

Drive performance management and insights

• Establish consistent reporting across revenue, pipeline, asset utilization, and other key commercial performance indicators.

• Develop dashboards and executive-ready materials that highlight performance, risks, gaps, and recommended actions.

• Develop case studies that capture commercial outcomes, client impact, and key learnings, creating proof points that can be leveraged by Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement.

• Identify portfolio trends and opportunities to improve commercial performance.

Build scalable commercial capabilities

• Partner with Finance and portfolio leads on forecasts, business cases, and commercial models for priority opportunities.

jobs.description:
About Us

Job Description

Role Summary:
The Cybersecurity Analyst – IAM supports the operation of identity and access management controls across the Pismo platform,

helping ensure compliance with the Visa Corporate Identity & Access Technical Security Requirements.

Working with senior IAM engineers, the analyst operates and continuously improves access controls for human and non-human identities

across AWS and hybrid environments: running access reviews, analysing permissions, monitoring privileged access, maintaining identity

inventories and automating recurring tasks.

The role partners with Cloud Security, Platform Engineering, API, DevSecOps and GRC teams to apply least-privilege and zero-trust

practices in a regulated, multi-tenant payments environment.

The role also supports the governance of AI-enabled identity use cases. It keeps track of the identities, credentials and permissions

used by AI systems, agents and automation, and checks them against Internal AI Governance standards and Corporate IAM requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Access governance

• Run periodic user access reviews and recertifications for Pismo applications and components, and collect, reconcile and keep the evidence.

• Monitor joiner, mover and leaver events and confirm that access is granted, changed and removed on time across the identity provider,

cloud accounts, source control and Kubernetes clusters.

• Review access requests and permission changes, including group, role and permission-set changes submitted as code, for least privilege

and separation of duties.

Permissions and privileged access

• Analyse cloud and platform permissions to find excessive, unused or orphaned access, and track remediation with the owning teams.

• Monitor privileged, just-in-time and break-glass access, investigate deviations and report exceptions.

• Keep the role and entitlement catalogue and the access matrix of each application up to date.

Non-human identities

• Maintain the inventory of service accounts, workload roles, API credentials and AI agent identities, with owner, purpose, permissions

and application mapping.

• Check that non-human identities meet the standards for ownership, scope, credential rotation and expiry.

Automation

• Write and maintain scripts and automations that use identity and cloud APIs and SDKs to extract access data, produce reports and automate recurring checks.

• Make changes to existing Terraform-based/ AWS automation IAM definitions through the standard review process.

Compliance and reporting

• Support internal and external audits and Visa security assessments (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2) with access-control evidence and control testing.

• Track IAM findings and exceptions through to closure, and report status and metrics to IAM leadership.

• Write and maintain runbooks, procedures and documentation for IAM processes.

This is a hybrid position. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

• 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience. Master's graduates must have 2+ years of relevant work experience to qualify at the Analyst (I5) level.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD).
• 2+ years of hands-on experience in identity and access management, cloud security or security operations.
• Experience administering or operating an enterprise identity provider (Okta preferred, or Microsoft Entra ID), including SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA, groups and group rules, and lifecycle provisioning (SCIM).
• Working knowledge of AWS IAM: roles, policies and trust policies, IAM Identity Center permission sets, and the ability to read and evaluate policy documents. Exposure to Azure or GCP IAM is a plus.
• Understanding of RBAC and ABAC, least privilege, separation of duties, and just-in-time and break-glass access.
• Experience running access reviews or certifications and supporting joiner/mover/leaver processes.
• Scripting in Python or an equivalent language, including calls to REST APIs and SDKs (e.g. Okta API, AWS SDK).
• Ability to read and change Terraform, and to work with Git and pull requests.
• Familiarity with Kubernetes RBAC and service accounts.
• Knowledge of the access-control requirements in PCI DSS (Requirements 7 and 8), ISO 27001 and NIST SP 800-53 (AC family).
• Clear written communication, including documentation and audit evidence.
• Relevant certifications are a plus but not mandatory, such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft SC-300, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Security – Specialty, or CompTIA Security+.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

You will be covering programs in all development phases starting with the early concept phase, throughout the development and certification of our product lines, up to the in-service support of the flying fleet.

jobs.description:
Airbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations as an Equal Opportunity Employer to applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation to complete your application, please contact us at USCareers@airbus.com
