Job Description:

Are you ready to take command of the operational heartbeat behind a $50M+ aerospace MRO facility? We are seeking an experienced MRO Forecast & Production Control Leader to serve as the strategic bridge between executive commitments and shop-floor execution at Airbus Helicopters. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of MRO, you will own the Master Production Schedule (MPS), steer the full S&OP cadence, and translate complex commercial (PBH, T&M) and military demand into precision elementary part models across five specialized repair shops—including Dynamic Components, Blades, Tailbooms, Composites, and Avionics. If you excel at eliminating bottlenecks, leading specialized planning teams, and presenting operational models directly to executive leadership, this high-visibility role offers the platform to drive bottom-line impact across world-class rotary-wing platforms.

Your working environment:

A suburb just outside the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area is home to Airbus Helicopters U.S. regional headquarters, where we have more than 1,000 employees. Check out one of the seven professional sports teams that also call Dallas home - you may even see a special, custom Airbus helicopter dedicated to the Dallas Cowboys flying during home games.

How we care for you:

• Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
• Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
• Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
• Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

Your Challenges:

• Establish and maintain the Master Production Schedule (MPS) across all specialized MRO shops (Dynamic Components, Blades, Tailbooms, Composites, and Avionics), ensuring strict adherence to turnaround time (TAT) targets.
• Act as the core operational owner for the MRO Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence, presenting consolidated volume expectations ($50M+ annual portfolio) to executive leadership.
• Consolidate complex, multi-stream demand inputs—including commercial PBH programs, military obligations, commercial Time & Material (T&M) orders, and internal rotable pool replenishment needs—into unified unit event forecasts (overhauls and repairs).
• Translate unit-level forecasts into detailed elementary part demand models, establishing and continuously refining K-factor accuracy (piece-part replacement factors per overhaul/repair event) to improve material availability and reduce excess inventory holding costs.
• Directly lead and mentor the Production Planning Manager and Data Analyst, providing leadership across a team of 4–5 specialists spanning production planning, shop floor control, and MRO logistics coordination.
• Oversee daily shop floor execution priorities, managing work-in-process (WIP) burndown strategies, stabilizing nominal WIP levels, and removing operational bottlenecks to maximize total shop throughput.
• Convert consolidated unit and part-level MRO forecasts into dynamic capacity and manpower models, determining direct labor headcount, shift coverage, and skill-mix requirements across all shop lines.
• Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement to build accurate elementary part forecasts driven by K-factor analytics, ensuring long-lead materials and piece-parts are ordered to support planned shop inductions.
• Ensure full material and service order readiness (kitting, bill-of-materials integrity, and technical work packages) prior to releasing work orders to the shop floor.
• Executive & Operational Reporting: Provide periodic performance reporting, S&OP metrics, and resource availability models to ExCom and senior leadership to measure operational efficiency and capacity for future demand.

Your Boarding Pass:

• Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Business related field (Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration), or an equivalent combination of education and MRO/aerospace industry experience.
• Must have twelve (12) years of experience in production planning, master scheduling, or capacity management within an aerospace/defense MRO, aircraft maintenance, or production environment.
• Five (5) years in a leadership/supervisory role.
• Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and motivate cross-functional planning and logistics teams.
• Strong financial acumen, critical thinking, and decisive judgment under fast-paced operational constraints.
• Excellent customer-centric communication and negotiation skills across commercial and military customer reps.
• Excellent understanding of contractual obligations. Must have a solid background / understanding of finance and financial reporting
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
• ERP/MRP Systems: SAP (or similar enterprise systems like Oracle/Pentagon 2000) for MRO production control, work order management, and bill-of-materials.
• Scheduling & Analytics Tools such as MS Excel (complex financial/capacity modeling), Smartsheet, MS Project, and business intelligence software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Preferred Education/Skills:

• Master’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or Business Administration; or technical specialization in Industrial Engineering, Production Management, or Advanced Data Analytics.
• 10+ years of progressive operations management experience within a multi-shop MRO facility ($50M+ annual volume).
• Proven experience managing complex multi-stream demand (PBH, Commercial T&M, Military contracts) and rotable pool allocations.
• APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP), Project Management Professional (PMP)
• Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.

Travel Required:

• Up to 10% Domestic and International

Citizenship:

• Authorized to work in the US

Physical Requirements:

• 100% onsite in Grand Prairie, TX when not on travel
• Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Involves 100% direct involvement and interactions]
• Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily
• Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily
• Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools such as hydraulic lifts. Daily
• Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
• Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
• Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools. Daily
• Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Daily
• Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Daily
• Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily
• Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. Estimate 10% travel
• Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Requires daily walkthrough of departments and buildings
• Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain?
AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover I 2027/2028 - Starting date March 2027 until February 2028.

We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.

The selection process will be during October 2026 until January 2027.

What does this internship consists in?
Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.
The start of the internship will be in early March 2027, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.

Internship Job Description

Airbus DS Maintenance Programs Department main mission is to ensure the Airworthiness Authorities approval of the different aircraft/products Scheduled Maintenance Requirements.

Related aircraft/products are:

- A400M aircraft,

- C-295 aircraft (transport, humanitarian and maritime patrol versions).

One of the activities related to the above is the direct and permanent contact with Operators and Airworthiness Authorities responsibles through Maintenance Working Groups and Industry Steering Comitees where the team is responsible for the presentation of the different analyses , and any related or necessary documentation, that supports the Scheduled Maintenance Requirements development/revision approval.

The MSG-3 logic is the means for developing the scheduled maintenance tasks and intervals which will be acceptable to the regulatory authorities, the operators, and the manufacturers.

TASSE4 also develops optimized maintenance programs to customers and maintenance programs for prototypes.

In the Systems area of Maintenance Programs Department, the different Aircraft systems are analyzed using the MSG-3 methodology in order to identify the scheduled maintenance requirements. The starting point is the design office documentation related with systems/structure/wiring descriptions, drawings (catia) and digital mock-ups, safety analyses, certification plans, etc). These analyses contain a high level of systems description and a thorough analysis of its functions, functional failures, failure effects and failure causes. Examples of the analyzed systems are:  Engines, Propeller and Auxiliary Power Unit.

Main tasks:

- Analyze the aircraft systems using the MSG3 logic in order to identify/optimize Scheduled Maintenance Requirements.

- Check in-service documentation to perform its analysis and optimize maintenance based on A/C experience.

- Collect the major suppliers inputs for scheduled maintenance for Engines, Propellers and APU.

- Collaborate and support to other department areas (Systems, Zonal, Structure and Program management)

Required skills #AirbusDiversity

As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- Degree in Aeronautical Engineering. Specialization in engines will be an asset.

- Knowledge on Excel/Data Bases Tools or similar.

- English: Advance level.

- Spanish: Advance level.

- Analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Team spirit and great collaboration skills.
- Ability to work in complex and international environments.

Why should you apply?

- Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.

- Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.

- Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.

- Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary on the ground, in the sky and in space.

Are you interested? Apply and make it fly!

Job Description:

At the Airbus Helicopters site in Donauwörth, we are looking for reinforcement for current and future projects at the earliest possible start date for an

Additive Layer Manufacturing Design & Stress Specialist (m/w/d)

Your Location

At the Donauwörth site on the banks of the Danube near Augsburg, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the flight-ready product. Experience with us how they take off and land at our own flight test center.

Our Benefits for You

• Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive compensation and individual supplementary benefits, e.g., corporate pension models, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing) or employee discounts at partner companies in accordance with our applicable guidelines.
• Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave according to collective agreement; work-life balance (flexitime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical).
• Easy Career Advancement: Excellent training opportunities and international, group-wide development perspectives.
• Well-being at the Workplace: Company doctor; comprehensive health services (sports courses, prevention programs, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, partially local daycare near the site.
• Diversity Unites: Working in a diverse environment with over 140 nationalities, where exchange, support, and diversity are actively lived.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

• Component Identification and Screening: Active identification of suitable components and integrated systems for additive manufacturing application.
• Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM): Execution of DfAM activities, topology optimization, and functional integration to optimize weight and performance.
• Structural Analysis and Strength Verification (Stress): Performing calculations and FEM analyses for dynamically loaded and fatigue-critical AM components taking into account specific material properties.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Close alignment as technical interface between Design, Stress, the Reference Manufacturing Shop (RMS), Material & Processes (M&P), and external partners.
• Certification and Quality Standards: Support in complying with and developing aviation-specific regulations (EASA/FAA).
• Knowledge Transfer and Standardization: Participation in the Community of Practice for Additive Manufacturing, supporting upskilling measures, and contributing to the development of engineering standards.
• Knowledge Sharing and Consulting: Active sharing of expertise as well as technical consulting and support for engineering colleagues on complex additive manufacturing topics.
• Cooperation with Science and Research: Close exchange and collaboration with universities, colleges, and research institutes to evaluate new technologies and methods.
• Benchmarking and Market Observation: Conducting benchmarks and technology comparisons to identify best practices and future innovation trends.

Required Knowledge and Qualifications

• Completed Master's degree (M.Sc.) in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable qualification.
• Several years of relevant engineering experience in the aerospace industry.
• Several years of experience in Design / Structural / Stress analysis.
• Results-oriented mindset characterized by a high degree of personal responsibility, motivation, and commitment.
• Design for AM (DfAM): Specific knowledge and methodical know-how in structural design for additive manufacturing processes.
• Materials and Fatigue Understanding: Sound knowledge of AM materials and their mechanical behavior in dynamically loaded components.
• Digital Tools (3DX / DDMS): Familiarity with modern PLM and CAD systems in the context of digital definition.
• Certification and Quality Standards: Understanding of aviation-specific regulations (EASA/FAA) for additive components.
• Strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to inspire people.
• A pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges.
• Structured working method and clear presentation of complex topics.
• Business fluent in German and English.
• Willingness to travel internationally.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 280 personnes au sein du département  Qualité, et plus précisément de l’équipe en charge du management de la performance opérationnelle et financière.

Piloter c’est savoir prévoir, mesurer et réagir en cas d’écart. Pour se faire, il est important d’avoir des outils efficaces et adaptés aux utilisateurs.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

Diagnostic terrain et audit des écarts

• Réaliser une immersion auprès des équipes opérationnelles Qualité pour comprendre les processus métier, les flux de travail et les inducteurs de charge.
• Prendre en main l'outil de modélisation prévisionnelle de la charge et cartographier les paramètres d'entrée.
• Analyser les écarts entre les données théoriques de l'outil et la réalité terrain, en collaboration étroite avec les managers Qualité et le Contrôle de Gestion Finance.

Analyse des causes et résolution de problèmes

• Réaliser une analyse des causes racines sur les dérives constatées (écarts de temps de traitement, volumes de livrables, arbitrages de ressources).
• Évaluer la cohérence globale entre la planification de la charge et les indicateurs de performance opérationnelle.
• Définir et formaliser un plan d'actions correctives avec les parties prenantes.

Évolution de l'outil et intégration de nouvelles technologies

• Concevoir, tester et déployer des évolutions ergonomiques et fonctionnelles sur l'outil de pilotage pour en faciliter l'appropriation au quotidien.
• Explorer et expérimenter l'intégration de briques d'Intelligence Artificielle ou d'automatisation pour optimiser le traitement des données de charge.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation

• Ingénierie du Pilotage de Performance & Contrôle de Gestion Opérationnel : Capacité à auditer un système de planification de charge, à identifier les écarts entre théorique et réel, et à modéliser des indicateurs de performance fiables (KPI).
• Data Analytics & Digitalisation des Procédés : Traitement, structuration et analyse de jeux de données complexes, optimisation d'outils d'aide à la décision et expérimentation de solutions basées sur l'Intelligence Artificielle.
• Conduite de Projet de Transformation & Resolution de Problèmes : Utilisation de méthodes d'analyse de causes (Ishikawa, 5 Pourquoi), élaboration de plans d'actions correctives et déploiement de solutions d'amélioration continue.
• Conduite du Changement & Posture Conseil en Milieu Industrialisé : Démarche d'immersion terrain, recueil du besoin auprès d'interlocuteurs pluridisciplinaires (Qualité, Finance, Managers) et accompagnement des utilisateurs lors des évolutions d'outils.

• Concepts généraux d'organisation industrielle et de gestion des ressources.
• Maîtrise avancée du traitement de données (Excel avancé, Power BI ou équivalent) et appétence pour l'expérimentation d'outils IA / Data.Capacités de modélisation de données, de synthèses d'écarts et de calcul de ratios de performance.

jobs.description:

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo

Présentation du site de Méaulte

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, vous permettant de valider votre année et pour une durée de 6 mois à compter de début 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité).

Tâches et responsabilités :

Au sein de l'équipe R&T Emerging Industrial Systems (8 personnes), votre mission sera de modéliser le comportement de nos usines et de tester la résilience de notre système industriel face à des perturbations significatives à caractériser.

L’objectif  de cette mission sera le suivant :

Comment modéliser la dynamique de notre système industriel et évaluer sa robustesse face aux aléas pour concevoir les modes d'organisation les plus stables ?

Pour y répondre, vous interviendrez avec votre tuteur sur les étapes suivantes :

• Modélisation : appropriation d’un modèle existant sous AnyLogic, cartographie des flux et simulation du processus en fonctionnement nominal.
• Simulation des aléas & stress-testing : scénarisation et injection de perturbations (pannes, ruptures de flux,défaillance de fournisseurs, rupture de chaîne de transport,…) pour analyser les comportements critiques et limites du système.
• Aide à la décision et préconisations : analyse comparative de KPI de performance, restitution des résultats et propositions d’orientations stratégiques.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Modélisation & simulation dynamique de flux : utilisation du logiciel AnyLogic (évènements discrets, agent-based) et numérisation de processus industriels complexes.
• Analyse de résilience & gestion des aléas : qualification des risques, stress-testing de chaînes de valeur et analyse de sensibilité.
• Génie industriel & optimisation d'organisation : définition de scénarios de régulation et aide à la décision stratégique pour le système de production.
• Gestion de projet R&T & valorisation : pilotage d'étude prospective, synthèse de données complexes et restitution auprès d'experts métiers.

jobs.title: Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
jobs.description:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!

#everydaybetter

Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can demonstrate proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)

Preferred qualifications:
- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

jobs.title: Sr. Sports Research Manager, Prime Video Sports — Live Sports Strategy & Research
jobs.description:
Prime Video is redefining how the world watches live sports, delivering NFL Thursday Night Football, NBA, NASCAR, MLB, and global soccer to tens of millions of fans. We seek a Sr. Sports Research Manager to own sports audience measurement for Prime Video Sports, serving as the definitive internal authority on how our live events perform in Nielsen and across the broader measurement landscape.
You will own the Nielsen relationship and end-to-end measurement of every Prime Video Live Sports telecast, authoring audience summaries, reconciling first-party streaming signals against third-party currency, and translating a fast-moving measurement environment into clear business guidance. The ideal candidate pairs deep Nielsen expertise with the judgment to explain why audiences move and the communication skill to make complex concepts land with senior leaders, league partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
-Own authoritative audience summaries for all Prime Video Sports properties, reporting P2+ AMA on Nielsen Big Data+Panel and Panel-Only bases, including demographics, reach, and minute-by-minute trends. Produce weekly, event-level, and season-to-date reporting on deadline.
-Benchmark Prime Video against the competitive set on a like-for-like basis and manage Nielsen schedule inputs so every telecast is measured accurately and on time.
Reconcile Prime Video first-party device/AMA signals against Nielsen projections and final actuals; build a holistic cross-platform view of linear plus streaming performance.
-Serve as the internal authority on Nielsen methodology; write POVs on currency changes, separate methodology shifts from real audience movement, and represent Prime Video
-Translate measurement into decisions for programming, marketing, PR, finance, and ad sales. Field league and partner data requests, owning accuracy and turnaround.
-Automate recurring reporting and apply AI tools to speed analysis, drafting, and quality-checking, building validation into every workflow so numbers reaching leadership are right the first time.

Basic Qualifications
•	7+ years of media research experience at a network, agency, streamer, league, or research supplier, with end-to-end ownership of measurement deliverables.
•	Deep, hands-on expertise with Nielsen national TV measurement (Big Data+Panel, Panel-Only, NNTV, National TV Toolbox, NPOWER-family, NCL schedule input).
•	Command of core media math: AMA, rating, share, reach, GRPs, and time-shift windows (live, same-day, VOSDAL, delayed).
•	Experience with cross-platform measurement spanning linear TV and streaming, including first-party/impression-based signal integration with third-party currency.
•	Advanced Excel and clear, persuasive data storytelling in PowerPoint for senior audiences. Excellent written and verbal communication.
•	Bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, communications, marketing, a quantitative social science, or a related discipline. Avid sports fan.

Preferred Qualifications
•	10+ years in sports media research or audience measurement, with direct ownership of a measurement discipline and a Nielsen vendor relationship.
•	Working knowledge of 2025-2026 Nielsen methodology changes (out-of-home expansion, Big Data+Panel transition, co-viewing) and ability to recalibrate benchmarks across breaks.
•	Experience with secondary measurement platforms (comScore, VideoAmp, iSpot, Adobe Analytics, Antenna, Nielsen ONE) and audience forecasting supporting finance or revenue planning.
•	Experience using AI tools and automation (e.g., Python, generative AI, scheduled reporting) to scale recurring research workflows.
•	Deep familiarity with the live sports media landscape, its broadcasters, Amazon's position in live sports, and MRC accreditation standards.

A day in the life

About the team
Our team is focused on building programming strategies that connect customers with the content they love. We work collaboratively across creative, product, marketing, and finance teams to make informed decisions that shape the viewing experience for audiences worldwide. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, and a willingness to challenge assumptions. As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we evolve our approach and help define what comes next for our customers.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience leading large-scale programs/projects
- Experience in modeling (Excel) and data analyses
- 7+ Years of Content Strategy, Programming Strategy, and/or Marketing Strategy experience

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location, in the Electrophysiology division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

The Clinical Research Scientist will participate in scientific and operational activities supporting the design, conduct, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of clinical studies within Abbott's Electrophysiology portfolio. This role contributes to the generation of clinical evidence supporting product development, regulatory approvals, reimbursement initiatives, post-market surveillance activities, and scientific communication efforts.

The Clinical Research Scientist will work collaboratively across multiple functions to support clinical research programs from study planning through publication and reporting while developing expertise in clinical research methodology, medical device development, scientific communication, and evidence generation.

What You'll Work On

This position will work closely with the clinical study team including clinical scientists, project management, clinical operations, biostatistics, data management, regulatory affairs, quality affairs, medical affairs, reimbursement, and research and development personnel. This position will execute limited scoped responsibilities in accordance with applicable regulations, company procedures, and quality system requirements. Additionally:

• Contribute to the development, review, and maintenance of study-related documents including clinical study protocols, protocol amendments, case report forms, investigator brochures, informed consent forms, study manuals, clinical study reports, and associated scientific documentation.
• Support the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of prospective clinical studies, registries, observational studies, post-market studies, and other evidence-generation activities.

• Collaborate with clinical operations and CRO partners to support study execution activities, enrollment monitoring, site communications, protocol compliance activities, issue identification, and study-risk mitigation efforts.
• Review clinical data listings, summary tables, statistical outputs, and study reports and contribute to interpretation of study outcomes, safety findings, and clinical evidence.
• Participate in scientific data reviews and contribute to analyses supporting study conclusions, publication activities, clinical evaluation activities, and evidence-generation initiatives.
• Contribute to development of scientific manuscripts, abstracts, posters, white papers, podium presentations, and other scientific communications intended for internal and external audiences.
• Support publication activities through scientific writing, literature reviews, data review, and collaboration with internal teams and external authors.
• Contribute to compilation and organization of clinical evidence supporting regulatory submissions, clinical evaluations, reimbursement activities, and regulatory authority responses.
• Support maintenance of clinical study documentation, inspection readiness activities, audit activities, and compliance with quality system requirements.
• Participate as an active member of study teams and contribute scientific input during protocol development, study execution, data analysis, and reporting activities.
• Communicate scientific findings, study progress, and project updates to department stakeholders.
• Develop working knowledge of electrophysiology therapies, cardiovascular disease states, product technologies, clinical evidence, and evolving treatment paradigms.
• Build collaborative working relationships with investigators, research coordinators, study sites, and cross-functional business partners.

The job will be performed in a quality system environment. Failure to adequately perform tasks can result in noncompliance with governmental regulations.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Public Health, Epidemiology, Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline.

• Foundational understanding of clinical research methodology, clinical trial design, and evidence generation.
• Ability to critically evaluate scientific literature and apply findings to scientific and clinical research questions.
• Foundational understanding of statistical concepts including study endpoints, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and interpretation of clinical study results.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate scientific information to cross-functional stakeholders.
• Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice and clinical research regulations.
• Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Broad knowledge and application of business concepts, procedures, and practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree preferred.
• Medical device clinical research experience.
• Knowledge of electrophysiology therapies and cardiovascular clinical research.
• Experience supporting clinical trials or investigator-sponsored research.
• Working knowledge of clinical trial statistics including endpoints, confidence intervals, p-values, and hypothesis testing.

Job Description

Agilent is expanding its oligonucleotide manufacturing capabilities with a new, purpose-built facility designed to support growing demand and innovation in therapeutic development, and we’re looking for a Manufacturing Associate to help bring it to life.

As part of the initial startup team, you’ll play an important role in preparing and maintaining the manufacturing environment and supporting the Manufacturing Chemists who operate our production processes. This position will support cleanroom cleaning, solution preparation, materials stocking and ordering, waste handling, and other activities necessary to keep manufacturing operations safe, compliant, and production-ready.

We value employees who are willing to learn, take initiative, stay organized, and consistently uphold high standards of safety, quality, cleanliness, and documentation. Job Description

Our team is growing, and we are looking for a curious, collaborative, and technically motivated Product Intelligence Consultant. This role will help design, build, enhance, and support internal applications and data-driven workflow solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational processes, and give business partners reliable tools for managing their work.

What You Will Do

•Work with business partners to understand operational pain points, gather requirements, and translate them into practical application, workflow, automation, and data solutions.

•Assist with developing and enhancing internal web applications and workflow tools using technologies such as C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Blazor or Razor, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related frameworks.

•Build user-friendly application features for work intake, queue management, assignment, status tracking, quality processes, and operational support.

•Help design integrations that move data between internal applications, SQL Server or Oracle databases, SharePoint, flat files, and other approved data sources.

•Identify opportunities to replace manual spreadsheets, file transfers, and repetitive tasks with reliable application features, scheduled processes, scripts, or system integrations.

•Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support.

•Investigate application defects, data issues, performance concerns, and user-reported problems; document findings and implement or recommend appropriate corrections.

API and Integration Expectations

•Assist with designing, developing, testing, and documenting secure REST API endpoints for workflow, application, and data integration needs.

•Work with HTTP methods, JSON payloads, status codes, authentication, authorization, input validation, error handling, logging, and versioning.

•Use Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or similar tools to review contracts, test endpoints, and document API behavior.

•Build or support integrations between applications and approved enterprise data sources while following security and access-control requirements.

•Look for opportunities to create reusable services or APIs that reduce duplicate logic and improve consistency across applications.

Application Development Expectations

•Apply foundational object-oriented programming and software development concepts to create clear, maintainable, and reusable code.

•Use Git-based source control, feature branches, pull requests, and peer review practices to manage changes safely.

•Create responsive and accessible user interfaces that provide a consistent experience across supported internal applications.

•Assist with application deployments to development, test, and production environments and perform post-deployment validation.

•Contribute to modernization of legacy applications and adoption of reusable components and current supported frameworks.

What You Bring

•University degree, college diploma, bootcamp credential, or equivalent practical experience in computer science, software development, information systems, analytics, engineering, or a related field.

•Up to 2 years of relevant professional, internship, co-op, academic, or project experience in application development, data development, automation, or systems integration.

•Foundational programming experience in C#, Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, or a similar language, with a willingness to develop deeper C# and .NET skills.

•Foundational SQL skills and an understanding of relational databases, tables, joins, stored procedures, and data integrity.

•Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, client-server concepts, and application-to-application data exchange.

•Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and business processes.

Nice to Have

•Exposure to ASP.NET Core, Blazor, Razor, Dapper, REST APIs, JSON, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or responsive UI frameworks.

•Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, SSIS, SQL Agent, ETL processes, or scheduled automation.

•Familiarity with Visual Studio, Git, CI/CD pipelines, IIS, Windows Server, application logging, or monitoring tools.

What Success Looks Like

•Delivers accurate, tested, and documented application changes on agreed timelines.

•Asks thoughtful questions, learns the business process behind the request, and applies feedback to improve future work.

•Gradually takes ownership of application features, database components, automations, APIs, integrations, and support activities of increasing complexity.

•Builds trusted relationships with teammates and business partners through clear communication and reliable follow-through.

•Contributes ideas that improve application reliability, maintainability, security, user experience, and team efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence Breast & Gynaecology
jobs.description:
We're building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine - uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you'll actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation. If you thrive in high-collaboration environments where your role is to turn complex, cross-functional problems into reusable, enterprise-wide capabilities - and where the measure of success is adoption and scale, not just innovation - you'll have the platform (and sponsorship) to make it real.

As Senior Director, AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence, Breast & Gynaecology, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for generating high-quality clinical intelligence and evidence across the Breast & Gynaecology portfolio. You will combine deep expertise in Real-World Evidence and epidemiology with strong people leadership, strategic prioritisation and an understanding of AI and machine learning to ensure the team focuses on the questions where it can deliver the greatest value.

You will work closely with drug development teams to translate complex clinical and portfolio questions into research objectives that can be addressed through real-world data and advanced methods. You will help determine where RWE and AI can make a meaningful difference, guide the scientific approach, and ensure insights are translated into evidence that supports drug development and better outcomes for patients.

The position sits within AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence, part of AI to Transform Care, whose mission is to apply AI across the care pathway to identify patients faster, guide better treatments and improve outcomes at scale. The function integrates clinical, trial and real-world data to support regulatory, HTA and payer-grade evidence, establish real-time and agentic RWE systems, and generate clinical intelligence for decision-making.

How would you combine AI, real-world data, clinical evidence and scientific judgement to anticipate critical portfolio questions and generate the intelligence needed to answer them?

Accountabilities:

• Breast & Gynaecology CIE Strategy: Define and evolve the Clinical Intelligence & Evidence strategy for Breast & Gynaecology, aligning the team's scientific priorities and capabilities with the needs of the Oncology portfolio.

• Real-World Evidence Leadership: Provide scientific leadership in epidemiology and Real-World Evidence, advising on appropriate study designs, analytical methods and the use of routinely collected healthcare data to address important clinical and development questions.

• Portfolio Partnership: Work closely with drug development teams to understand their priorities, identify where Real-World Evidence, AI and advanced methods can add value, and translate clinical and portfolio questions into clear research objectives.

• Clinical Development: Apply Real-World Evidence to support clinical development questions

• AI and Machine Learning: Shape the appropriate use of machine learning and AI within Real-World Evidence, identifying opportunities where these methods can strengthen evidence generation while distinguishing meaningful scientific applications from technological hype.

• Advanced Methods: Support the application of approaches including predictive modelling, patient subtyping, disease progression modelling, temporal modelling and the extraction of insights from clinical text and other real-world data.

• People Leadership: Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and building an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team environment.

• Strategic Prioritisation: Prioritise the team's work according to its potential impact on the Oncology portfolio and patients, balancing immediate drug development needs with longer-term scientific and capability priorities.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Build strong relationships across drug development, clinical, scientific, data and AI teams, bringing together the expertise required to address complex evidence questions. Influence across Global Product Teams, matrix teams and external partners to keep evidence outputs both technically rigorous and strategically relevant.

• Cross-CIE Collaboration: Partner with other Clinical Intelligence & Evidence teams to share expertise, develop common capabilities and scale valuable AI approaches across therapeutic-area portfolios.

• External Collaboration: Work with external organisations where appropriate to access Real-World Data, expertise and capabilities that strengthen evidence generation, including healthcare organisations, data providers and research collaborators.

• Scientific Impact: Contribute to the scientific advancement of Real-World Evidence and AI-enabled clinical intelligence, ensuring work is rigorous, clinically meaningful and focused on improving drug development and patient outcomes.

• Change Leadership: Help shape the wider Clinical Intelligence & Evidence operating model, promoting collaboration across disease-area teams and accelerating the transition from isolated analyses to scalable, enterprise-level capabilities.

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential

• Advanced degree (PhD, MPH, MD, or MSc) in Statistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field.

• 10+ years of experience in life sciences or healthcare with deep expertise in epidemiology and Real-World Evidence generation, including the use and application of RWD to support clinical decision-making.

• Strong experience with health analytics and routinely collected healthcare data, with the ability to assess different data sources and approaches for fitness for purpose.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to translate clinical and development questions into research objectives that can be addressed using RWD and appropriate epidemiological and statistical methods.

• Experience in quantitative science, including health outcomes modelling, health economics, epidemiology or related disciplines, and familiarity with statistical and scripting languages.

• Understanding of Oncology drug development, particularly Phase 3 and beyond, including the role of RWE in clinical trials, patient recruitment, evidence generation and external or synthetic control approaches.

• Experience with AI/ML methods, or a strong understanding of their principles, strengths, limitations and appropriate application to Real-World Data.

• Experience with regulatory submissions or HTA dossiers leveraging RWE.

• Proven experience line managing direct reports, developing talent and building effective, multidisciplinary teams.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex outputs into clear, decision-ready insights.

• Demonstrated ability to prioritise work strategically, manage competing demands and adapt team focus and resources as Oncology strategy and portfolio needs evolve.

• Ability to work effectively across clinical, scientific, quantitative and technology disciplines within a global, matrixed organisation.

• Strong communication and influencing skills, including the ability to communicate complex scientific topics, evidence and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.

Desirable

• Experience within Oncology, particularly Breast and/or Gynaecological cancers

• Hands-on experience in data science, machine learning and predictive modelling.

• Familiarity with advanced approaches including Bayesian inference, temporal modelling, multimodal modelling, foundation models, and model interpretability and evaluation.

• Experience working with clinical text, electronic health records, imaging or molecular data, including genomics in clinical care or translational medicine.

• Knowledge of clinical data standards, medical terminologies and healthcare ontologies.

• Experience in late-stage drug development and access, including Phase 3 clinical trial design, biomarkers, safety, endpoints, and regulatory, HTA or payer interactions.

• Experience developing or applying external or synthetic control arms and other approaches that integrate RWD with clinical trials.

• Experience working in a patient-care or similar setting, bringing a medical or clinical perspective to RWE generation.

• Experience establishing or managing collaborations with academic institutions, healthcare organisations, technology partners, data providers or industry consortia.

• Up-to-date knowledge of developments in AI and machine learning, with the scientific judgement to distinguish meaningful applications from technological hype.

Are you ready to shape how real-world evidence, data and AI are used to answer some of the most important questions in Breast & Gynaecology Oncology?

Why AstraZeneca:

At AstraZeneca, AI, clinical science and real-world evidence come together to address some of the most important questions in medicine. You will work alongside clinical leaders, data scientists, epidemiologists, statisticians and technology experts to transform complex data into evidence that improves development decisions and, ultimately, patient outcomes.

You will have the opportunity to shape a growing enterprise capability rather than simply deliver individual analyses. The environment combines rich clinical and real-world data, ambitious scientific programmes, advanced AI capabilities and the scale required to move successful approaches across assets and therapeutic areas.

This is a role for a scientific leader who wants to build for the long term: strengthening evidence, developing people, creating reusable capabilities and helping establish a more proactive, continuously learning approach to clinical intelligence.

Office Working Requirements:  When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $ 203.213,60 - 304.820,40  Annual USD. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program. Benefits offered include a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

jobs.title: Director, AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence Lung, Head & Neck
jobs.description:
We're building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine - uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you'll actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation. If you thrive in high-collaboration environments where your role is to turn complex, cross-functional problems into reusable, enterprise-wide capabilities - and where the measure of success is adoption and scale, not just innovation - you'll have the platform (and sponsorship) to make it real.

Introduction to role:

As Director, AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence Lung, Head & Neck, you will work on the end-to-end evidence strategy for the Lung, Head & Neck therapeutic area, spanning the full continuum from R&D to patient care and ensuring evidence is aligned to the highest-priority scientific, medical, and business needs across the product lifecycle.

• You will identify and rank evidence gaps. You will build strategies that bring to bear the PH3ID (Phase 3 Investment Decision) Intelligence Foundation and multimodal data assets. You will translate complex data landscapes into actionable intelligence that develops portfolio investment decisions, regulatory filings, and commercial positioning. You will work at the interface of Translational Science, Clinical Development, and Market Access, influencing senior stakeholders across a matrixed environment.
• You will bring deep expertise in evidence generation, working knowledge of multimodal modeling approaches, and the ability to address both clinical development and market access needs. You will join a team that delivers lifecycle intelligence across development, regulatory, and market access, and that is building AI-enabled evidence designed to extend across future use cases rather than be rebuilt each time.
• The position sits within AI for Clinical Intelligence & Evidence, part of AI to Transform Care, whose mission is to apply AI across the care pathway to identify patients faster, guide better treatments and improve outcomes at scale.

How would you combine AI, real-world data, clinical evidence and scientific judgement to anticipate critical portfolio questions and generate the intelligence needed to answer them?

Accountabilities:

Lung, Head & Neck CIE Strategy

Collaborate with the Lung, Head & Neck CIE team to define and evolve the Clinical Intelligence & Evidence strategy for Lung, Head & Neck, translating portfolio priorities and emerging scientific questions into a clear roadmap.

Prioritization

Identify and prioritize the evidence gaps most likely to influence portfolio investment decisions, particularly at key development milestones (e.g., Phase II-to-III transition: strength of the efficacy signal, its applicability to the intended Phase III population, and its performance relative to an appropriate comparator).

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Translational Science and Clinical Development to integrate relevant multimodal evidence (e.g., clinical, genomic, digital pathology, and radiology imaging data) into asset investment decisions and portfolio risk assessment

Reusable Lung Intelligence

Build Lung-specific intelligence that persists and extends within the PH3ID Intelligence Foundation, so evidence compounds across use cases rather than being rebuilt for each question.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Mobilise relevant scientific, clinical, data and AI expertise around priority Lung, Head & Neck questions and create alignment across multidisciplinary stakeholders.

Cross-CIE Collaboration

Partner with other Clinical Intelligence & Evidence teams to share expertise, develop common capabilities and scale valuable AI approaches across therapeutic-area portfolios.

Value and Impact

Ensure the team's work remains aligned with priority scientific, development and portfolio decisions, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders; adapt priorities as needs and evidence evolve.

Change Leadership

Help shape the wider Clinical Intelligence & Evidence operating model, promoting collaboration across disease-area teams and accelerating the transition from isolated analyses to scalable, enterprise-level capabilities.

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential

• Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics, clinical science, or a quantitative discipline relevant to evidence generation.

• 5+ years of experience in evidence generation, RWE, health outcomes research, or a related function within pharma, biotech, or a leading academic or consultancy environment.

• Track record of translating complex analytical outputs into strategic recommendations that advise portfolio decisions.

• Expert command of oncology real-world data assets and their application to evidence generation

• Experience working at the interface of Translational Science, Clinical Development and Market Access functions, with the ability to distill technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

• Strong foundation in evidence generation methodologies, including observational study design, causal inference and comparative effectiveness research.

• Experience with regulatory submissions or HTA dossiers leveraging RWE.

• Solid understanding of multimodal modeling approaches, and how clinical, imaging, genomic, and real-world data can be integrated to build patient classifiers, prognostic models, and trial simulators.

Desirable

• Experience within Oncology and, particularly, Lung, Head & Neck portfolios.

• Familiarity with AI/ML applications in RWE, including predictive modelling and automated evidence synthesis.

• Prior experience shaping or contributing to AI-enabled evidence platforms.

• Experience working across therapeutic-area, scientific and AI teams in a global matrix organisation.

• Experience supporting complex research questions and portfolio-level decision-making.

• Experience building advanced scientific or analytical capabilities within multidisciplinary teams.

Are you ready to transform how clinical and real-world data are used to shape the development of medicines for patients with lung, head and neck cancers?

Why AstraZeneca:

At AstraZeneca, AI, clinical science and real-world evidence come together to address some of the most important questions in medicine. You will work alongside clinical leaders, data scientists, epidemiologists, statisticians and technology experts to transform complex data into evidence that improves development decisions and, ultimately, patient outcomes.

You will have the opportunity to shape a growing enterprise capability rather than simply deliver individual analyses. The environment combines rich clinical and real-world data, ambitious scientific programmes, advanced AI capabilities and the scale required to move successful approaches across assets and therapeutic areas.

Office Working Requirements:  When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program. Benefits offered include a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

jobs.title: Sr Buyer
jobs.description:
To manage the buying process for a given set of goods, apply sourcing policies and acting as the key interface between suppliers and the business with respect to specifications, schedules, priorities, and budgets.

The Senior Buyer is responsible for the end-to-end operational execution and performance of an assigned procurement portfolio, ensuring Purchase Orders are placed, maintained, and executed accurately, suppliers meet their commitments, ERP information remains current, and procurement risks and exceptions are proactively identified and resolved.

The position requires a thorough understanding and practical application of procurement approaches, theories, and methodologies within a complex organizational environment, combined with strong analytical capabilities, supplier management, sense of urgency and cross-functional leadership.

Responsibilities, Authorities and Accountabilities

• Place and follow up on Purchase Orders and manage supplier relationships throughout PO execution.
• Manage PO problems, schedule changes, acknowledgements, cancellations, push-outs, pull-ins, and other approved purchasing requirements.
• Maintain accurate and current PO information in ERP/SAP.
• Maintain end-to-end visibility of assigned POs, open actions, priorities, risks, delays, dependencies, and escalations.
• Proactively follow up with suppliers on open orders, delivery commitments, and PO acknowledgements.
• Identify material availability and delivery risks before they impact operations and drive suppliers toward timely resolution.
• Review and execute assigned MRP exception messages and approved Planning requirements, including schedule changes, cancellations, quantity changes, push-outs, and pull-ins.
• Communicate PO changes to suppliers and follow through to confirmation or documented exception.
• Monitor PO and PIR alignment and coordinate the resolution of discrepancies with the appropriate Sourcing stakeholders.
• Investigate and support resolution of blocked invoices, PO/invoice discrepancies, quantity differences, Goods Receipt issues, and other transactional exceptions.
• Partner with Suppliers, Planning, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Accounts Payable, Finance, and other Supply Chain stakeholders to drive issues to closure.
• Monitor Procurement KPIs and use data to identify priorities, exceptions, recurring issues, and operational risks.
• Use SAP, Excel, Power BI, and other Procurement systems and dashboards to analyze the assigned portfolio and support fact-based decision making.
• Identify root causes of recurring issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
• Maintain reliable Procurement data and supporting documentation for assigned purchasing activities.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and continuously improve Procurement processes.
• Handle communication with direct colleagues, suppliers, and the business regarding Procurement activities, priorities, risks, and issues.
• Provide clear, fact-based escalations that identify the issue, root cause, business impact, actions taken, and recommended next steps.
• Influence stakeholders and suppliers to drive timely resolution of operational issues.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college, or a high school diploma / GED with at least 4 years of relevant Sourcing or Procurement experience.

• Demonstrated experience in Purchase Order management and supplier execution.

• Strong understanding of Procurement and Supply Chain processes.

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
• Demonstrated ownership and accountability with the ability to independently drive issues to closure.
• Ability to influence others and lead small teams or initiatives.
• Ability to lead projects of moderate scope and impact.
• Effective problem identification, root-cause analysis, and solution skills.
• Proven analytical and organizational capabilities.
• Strong working knowledge of SAP, Microsoft Excel, and Power BI.
• Experience with MRP, materials planning, and supplier delivery management.
• Understanding of invoice, GR/IR, and Accounts Payable exception resolution.
• Ability to analyze large datasets and translate information into clear priorities and actions.
• Strong supplier management and negotiation skills.
• Ability to identify operational risks and escalate them proactively with clear recommendations.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to challenge inefficient processes and implement practical solutions.
• Ability to work effectively across Planning, Sourcing, Procurement, Finance, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain organizations.

What Success Looks Like

• A successful Senior Buyer demonstrates ownership beyond transactional PO processing and takes accountability for the performance of the assigned procurement portfolio.
• The Senior Buyer is expected to:
• Maintain accurate and current information in SAP/ERP.
• Understand the status, priorities, and risks of the assigned portfolio.
• Execute PO and MRP actions accurately and on time.
• Proactively manage suppliers rather than react to delivery issues.
• Maintain strong PO acknowledgement and supplier delivery performance.
• Ensure transactional and pricing data are accurate and appropriately aligned.
• Identify procurement and material availability risks early.
• Drive issues through closure without requiring continuous management follow-up.
• Resolve problems through root-cause analysis rather than temporary workarounds.
• Use data and KPIs to prioritize workload and focus on the areas with the greatest business impact.
• Escalate issues early with clear facts, business impact, actions taken, and proposed solutions.
• Build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Procurement activities.
• Continuously improve the performance, reliability, and efficiency of the assigned portfolio.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer flexible working patterns while balancing the importance of collaboration and on-site engagement for project delivery and stakeholder alignment.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
• Comprehensive private medical care options
• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
• Tailored financial programs
• Additional elected or voluntary benefits

Additional Information

This position requires valid work authorization in the country of employment.
The employer is unable to sponsor work authorization for this role at any time.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

jobs.title: Productivity Data Science, Analytics & AI Specialist
jobs.description:
Productivity Data Science, Analytics & AI Specialist

Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about sales and proposals?

Would you like to be a part of successful team?

Join our team!

This role sits within the SP&S Integrated Supply Chain Operations Excellence team and will focus on using advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI to improve decision-making, reduce cost / value leakage, and support stronger delivery performance.

Partner with the best

As the Productivity Data Science, Analytics & AI Specialist, you will develop applied data science and AI solutions that address real operational and financial challenges across the business. You will work across functions to identify high-value use cases, build trusted analytical tools, and support responsible adoption of AI in ways that improve outcomes.

As a Productivity Data Science, Analytics & AI Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Develop AI agents, prompt-engineered workflows and automated solutions tailored to business-specific use cases.
• Focusing on business-led use cases that solve slow, repetitive, fragmented, or decision-heavy processes, with a clear link to time, quality, risk, insight, or customer benefit.
• Working with teams across the value stream to identify opportunities, surface dependencies, and help shape practical pilots, standards, and scalable approaches.
• Supporting responsible AI adoption by considering governance, data quality, privacy, consistency, and alignment with wider business and digital standards. As part of this, you'll help raise the standard of data and AI literacy within the wider team to drive the business on it's journey to be AI-native.
• Applying statistical and machine learning techniques to operational, business and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities across the project lifecycle.
• Designing and developing AI-powered solutions using large language models to support activities such as document analysis, summarization, insight extraction, and workflow acceleration.
• Building predictive and diagnostic models that help identify margin erosion, cost leakage, delivery risk, and leading indicators of project performance.
• Design and maintain Power BI dashboards and semantic models that combine descriptive analytics with predictive and data science outputs.
• Translating analytical and AI outputs into clear, actionable insight for operational, project, finance, and leadership stakeholders.

Position Summary

The Technician QC Systems and Support is responsible for performing routine activities such as handling samples and retains throughout the sample lifecycle, including proper labelling and sample tracking. The Technician is also responsible for the visual inspection of incoming goods, ensuring correct labelling and accurate sample tracking. Additionally, the Technician manages the shipping of materials to off-site locations. Other responsibilities include performing routine maintenance of equipment and instruments, as well as housekeeping tasks such as cleaning equipment and restocking laboratory supplies.

Duties/Responsibilities

• Handle test samples and retains throughout the sample lifecycle: receipt, storage, distribution, transfer, and disposal. Facilitate cold chain transfers of samples.
• Ensure samples and materials are appropriately labelled and maintain sample tracking, labelling and chain of custody records in accordance with written procedures.
• Maintain inventory and support distribution of QC samples and materials to functional groups as scheduled or requested. Record performance metrics for the sample management group.
• Follow lab procedures to maintain a safe and organized lab.
• Perform visual inspection of incoming goods.
• Ship samples to outside testing labs, as needed.
• Perform routine lab maintenance activities per procedure.
• Use electronic systems such as CELabs, SAP, SmartQC to perform and document the activities.
• Perform other tasks as required to support the QC laboratories.

Reporting Relationship

The Technician QC Systems and Support will report into QC Management

Qualifications

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

• Reliable and detail oriented with organizational skills.
• Ability to understand and follow procedures.
• Ability to communicate effectively with peers and management regarding task completion, roadblocks, and needs.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment, meet deadlines and changing priorities.

Education/Experience/ Licenses/Certifications:

NL: MLO level 3 with 2+ years experience in a regulated environment preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience, preferably in a regulated environment will be considered. Knowledge of basic electronic systems (email, MS Office, etc.) required.

Job Safety Requirements & Essential Physical Demands

• Ability to perform lifting tasks up to 20 lbs (9 kg) at floor and waist height. Ability to lift up to 10 lbs (4.5 kg) overhead as well as push or maneuver carts to transport materials between locations.
• Ability to perform frequent pipetting and related laboratory tasks within a biological safety cabinet, including extended periods of seated work.
• Ability to independently don, doff, and wear required personal protective equipment such as but not limited to lab coat/frock, gloves, safety glasses/face shield for prolonged periods while performing laboratory work.
• Ability to safely handle and use chemical disinfectants, flammable materials, and hazardous chemicals.
• Work may involve handling of dry ice, liquid nitrogen, and cryogenically cooled materials.
• Ability to use step stools while reaching and handling materials.
• Ability to work in a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) environment.
• The laboratory employee is responsible for performing work safely in accordance with EHSS procedures. This includes identifying and controlling risks, proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE), safe handling of chemicals and biological agents, compliance with waste and emergency procedures, and active participation in training and safety programs.
• Must be able to work assigned shift (Day, Weekends and/or Holidays)

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician, Days
jobs.description:
A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Shift: 2-2-3 Rotation, 6am - 6pm

Starting Hourly Wage - $37.32/hr

Summary:

Under supervision, performs mechanical repairs, basic electrical troubleshooting, and preventative maintenance on all Packaging Lines equipment and general facility when needed.

Principal Duties/Responsibilities:

• Responsible for promoting a safety culture and awareness within all assigned job duties.
• Performs entry to mid-level repairs to packaging lines during production. This could include but is not limited to troubleshooting, machine repairs, machine adjustments and fine tuning.
• May be required to setup and operate simple machining operations including but not limited to: drill press, grinder, lathe and other metal working tools to make and repair parts.
• May perform basic welding tasks.
• Performs Preventative Maintenance or Work Order support as scheduled. Coordinates assigned work with needs of the plant and labor availability.
• Review POKA at least every other day and update the status on pending action.
• Verifies and ensures documentation of all repair records.
• Monitors and minimizes down time, identifies and advocates for improvement opportunities.
• Identifies needed parts, supplies, and repair items.
• Participates in process improvement teams, 5S & Kaizen events all while promoting teamwork.
• Assures compliance with 5S, housekeeping standards and CI activities.
• Works and trains on all maintenance related activities – pairs with other MT’s to gain knowledge and experience on all facets of production extending beyond packaging lines into the processing and support areas.
• Uses computer to update CMMS.
• Provides support and back up to other members of the department as needed by leadership
• Completes technical self-study programs for career development.
• Regular and predictable attendance is required.
• Follows all safety related policies, participates in required safety training, always remains observant and aware.

Knowledge Skills, Abilities

• Good oral and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills.
• Mechanical aptitude.
• Knowledge of industrial controls and pneumatics.
• Three phase electrical knowledge required: PLC knowledge desired.
• 480 volt electrical knowledge required.
• Machine tool experience.
• Ability to read electrical/mechanical drawings.
• Ability to use TIG Welding
• Ability to prioritize work assignments in a fast-paced work environment.
• Ability to effectively interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
• Ability to work for long periods of time, under pressure to produce results.
• Ability to make decisions and demonstrate ambiguity.
• If male, must be willing to shave facial hair at least once per year for respirator testing.

Education and Experience

• High school diploma and 1+ years proven maintenance experience working within a related manufacturing environment.
• Three phase electrical knowledge required with a demonstrated understanding of industrial controls and pneumatics preferred.
• Allen-Bradley PLC & Hydraulic experience desired.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong attention desired.
