jobs.title: Master Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Shift: Mon - Fri, 2:00pm – 10:30pm

Starting Hourly Wage - $47.02/hr.

General Summary:

Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the Master Maintenance Technician is primarily responsible for maintaining and repairing the production equipment. The technician will develop and implement the maintenance programs necessary to ensure the short-term and long-term reliability of the equipment, as well as lead the effort to optimize maintenance costs, maximize equipment availability and reduce unsafe conditions.

Essential Job Functions:

• Locate and diagnose failures, replace defective components, and perform basic troubleshooting using standard equipment, detailed drawings, diagrams, sketches, specifications, prints, manuals, and verbal and/or written instructions.
• Review POKA at least every other day and update the status on pending action.
• Repairs and maintains machinery and mechanical equipment such as motors, industrial transfer equipment, conveyance and production/processing machines and equipment using testing instruments, hand/power tools and precision-measuring instruments.
• Performs a wide variety of functions such as installation, maintenance, and repair of equipment for generating, distributing, and utilizing electrical energy. Uses instruments to test circuits and replaces or installs new power, light, electronic and control circuits.
• Troubleshoots electrical malfunctions, inspects circuits and wiring for shielding and grounding, and tests electrical equipment for safety and efficiency.
• Repairs complex electrical equipment, including motors, switches, switchboards, electrical mechanisms, automated machines, controls, panels, relays, circuit breakers, communication systems and alarms.
• Installation, repair and troubleshooting of safety circuits.
• Performs complex wiring assignments.
• Installs measures, cuts, bonds, threads, assembles and installs electrical conduit.
• Works from schematics, drawings, layouts, or other specifications to locate and diagnose trouble in the electrical system or equipment.
• Improvises acceptable fixes to get equipment running promptly.
• Assists engineers/controls team in diagnosing problems, suggesting corrective action and projects implementation.
• Cleans and lubricates parts.
• Inspects completed repairs.
• Properly inspect and maintain shop equipment, in accordance with OSHA regulations and C&D Standards.
• Prepare new machines and production equipment for operation.
• Follow a strict preventive maintenance schedule to lessen exposure to downtime related repairs and maintenance.
• Orders replacement parts. Requisition new parts and equipment.
• Report shift metrics to capture the performance and/or areas for improvement. (Breakdown – Downtime) (Part Availability) (Works carried out during their shift).
• Maintains appropriate maintenance and repair logs.
• Maintain a clean, organized and safe shop and production floor.
• Consistently work in a safe manner with regard to self, co-workers, and manufacturing systems.
• Perform general housekeeping tasks and waste removal within department/group and assists other areas as required.
• Continuously review current processes and search out improvement methods to improve product/process quality and reduce waste, rework, and unnecessary work that adds no value to the work or process.
• Assists with a quality control process on repairs made in house. Uses results from inspections to help develop the other maintenance technicians and further refine processes and maintenance documents.
• Assist and support other team members in meeting department and site goals.
• Contribute and participate in team decision making. Provide support in project work and other special requests.
• Provide support to the production team to produce superior quality materials that meet/exceed client needs. This role supports the needs of manufacturing and facilities equipment (steam generators, air compressors, dust collectors, HVAC, etc.) to ensure both are in top working order.
• Work with outside contractors.
• Participates in process improvement teams, 5S & Kaizen events all while promoting teamwork.

• Performs other duties as assigned by the Facilities and Maintenance Manager.

• Be on call if needed.
• Regular and predictable attendance is required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Good oral and written communication skills.
• Good organizational and time management skills.
• Mechanical/Electrical aptitude.
• Ability to effectively interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
• Ability to read electrical/mechanical drawings and schematics.
• General knowledge of welding and machining.

Education and Experience:

• High school diploma or equivalent and 5 – 7 years of industrial experience.
• Associate’s degree or vocational certificate preferred.
• PLC troubleshooting experience and three-phase electrical knowledge is required along with a demonstrated understanding of industrial controls, hydraulics, and pneumatics.

jobs.title: Market Surveillance Analyst - Registrar
jobs.description:
The Market Surveillance Registrar Analysts are deeply engaged with the markets each day. They are responsible for monitoring and reviewing activity in CME Group markets related physically delivered markets. They are tasked with ensuring the integrity of our CME approved facilities and appropriateness of CME delivery functions. They have the ability to perform the task required of an Analyst, as well as being able to work independently and interact more proactively with other Market Regulation staff regarding market events.

What you'll get:

• ​Exposure to CME's vast number of products and asset classes.
• A supportive environment that promotes career progression.
• The ability to have a direct impact on the markets by ensuring it's free from manipulation.
• The opportunity to work with several functional groups across departments.
• Competitive salary & comprehensive benefits package.
• Hybrid work schedule.

What you'll do:

• Review applications of firms applying to be part of the CME delivery process.
• Analyze if they comply with rules and making a recommendation to management for approval/denial.
• Perform physical inspections of approved and new facilities. This includes high level interaction with facilities, knowledge of delivery process and ability to detect potential issues.
• Evaluate inventory reports and understanding the impact and affects the supply will have on the corresponding derivatives market. Provide those findings to areas of Market Reg.
• Conduct investigations into breaches of delivery or facility rules with minimal supervision.
• Responding to customer inquiries regarding deliveries with minimal supervision.

What you'll need:

• 1 - 3 years related work experience
• Background with regards to specific physical markets is required (Metals and Grain a plus).
• Ability to travel; about 15% travel required to set up inspections and to onboard new facilities.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in an analytical field.

#LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Seasonal Sales Associate, UGG
jobs.location: UGG Pleasant Prairie Premium Outlets (Pleasant Prairie, WI)
jobs.description:
About UGG

At UGG, a division Deckers Brands, we exist to transform the lives of our customers and each other by sharing our passion and love for UGG. We’re driven by a clear mission: to bring the UGG brand to life through every interaction and evolve industry ideas by delivering experiences our customers desire.  As a member of the Deckers Family, you represent our brands and deliver unique, personalized shopping experiences.

Summary

Our Seasonal Sales Associates are critical to the success of our stores. As a Sales Associate, it’s your job to create the best possible customer experience. It’s your job to listen to each customer and offer recommendations and current product knowledge in response to their needs. You also know how to communicate the brand’s sustainability initiatives and social and ethical commitments to our customers while sharing your love and passion for our products. As a Sales Associate, you operate as part of dynamic team and you cooperate to achieve business goals.

Description

As a Sales Associate, you create personalized shopping experiences for our customers that drive brand loyalty. You understand the importance our modeling our Service Training Program and you greet customers promptly and courteously as they enter the store. You ensure that all customer questions are addressed accurately and responded to before they leave. You provide exceptional service from start to finish, including effectively communicating our return policy.  You maintain a positive, cheerful attitude with customers and team members and promote the store and brand image in all interactions including adhering to a dress code. You provide exceptional customer service to both our in-store customers and those who call on the phone.

In your role as a Sales Associate, you understand that your role extends beyond the sales floor. You know how to operate the cash register, handle money accurately, check inventory daily and ensure products are stocked and available for customers, and merchandize product in accordance with Visual Merchandising standards.  You also maintain a clean and well-organized back-stock area and employee break area, which includes daily vacuuming, sweeping, and dusting. You practice safety-consciousness and respond to theft in accordance with our policies. As a Sales Associate you understand that you are an integral part of a team; you report to work on time and notify your Store Manager in advance if you will be late or absent.

Core Competencies

As a successful Sales Associate, you know how to:

• Ensure the highest level of customer service possible as outlined in our Service Training Program
• Prioritize brand and product knowledge training in customer interactions
• Communicate effectively with customers, team members, management, and corporate stakeholders

• Contribute to a team and cooperate to achieve goals
• Multi-task in a fast-paced environment
• Respond to problem situations with professionalism
• Think critically to solve problems and approach challenges with agility

Key Qualifications

• Two (2) years of retail store experience preferred.
• High School Diploma
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to convey the Deckers Brands Vision and Mission to your team members and customers
• Highly motivated team player and self-starter

Additional Requirements

• Flexibility of schedule and hours to meet the needs of the business.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of tools and applications.
• Valid driver’s license.

As part of our Deckers Family, you belong to more than a lifestyle company. From our corporate offices to our multi-branded retail stores across the globe, we value giving people the freedom to pursue their passions, express their individuality, and are committed to helping them succeed. We’re proud to offer a wide range of benefits to best recognize the important role each person plays in the Deckers Brands mission. You’ll discover many benefits of working at Deckers Brands including competitive pay, discounts, perks, global contests, as well as opportunities for growth and development.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Store Manager in Training

Your natural leadership skills and ability to inspire teams to deliver exceptional customer service make you the right person for our Store Manager in Training position. Join our team today and let’s create a welcoming and positive environment for customers and associates alike.

As a Store Manager in Training at Dollar Tree, you’ll engage in on-the-job training to learn how to manage the profitable operations of your assigned store by maintaining a high standard for merchandising, placement, and store signage and by using proper display techniques to create an inviting atmosphere for customers. • Oversee and delegate all store activities to ensure smooth daily operations

• Ensure full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, while enforcing company policies and procedures

• Help your store reach its maximum profit contribution

• Protect company assets

• Maintain a high level of customer service across the store

• Ensure a positive, safe, and respectful environment while maintaining professional and friendly interactions with customers, associates, and leaders

• Experience with hardlines or variety merchandise; BIG BOX experience a plus is preferred

• Strong productivity management in freight processing is required

Onsite: This role is categorized as onsite. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to our Detroit/Hamtramck plant location

The Role:
The Launch Quality Engineer will be responsible for leading and delivering the body & exterior systems and components as well as ensuring conformance of NVH, Wind & Water Performance to factory zero by meeting all manufacturing integration requirements with Quality on time by collaborating with SMT DRE's, IRT, VSE, Development team, Program team, Manufacturing Core Team, Launch Coordinators etc. Manage daily requests for problem solving issues affecting production and warranty. In a similar manner, present the Assembly Plant and Engineering Staff with clear problem definition and technical guidance on issues affecting throughput till steady state production and metrics are met. The individual will also be responsible for overlooking BIW stamping facilities (internal & external) & Exterior component suppliers have quality systems in place to ensure defect free shipments to the assembly plant by working with respective SQE's.

What You'll Do:

• Develop quality standards and procedures for the plant during Weld assessments.

• Engage in CIT meetings to provide key mentorship to Body in white (BIW) & Exterior from a manufacturing integration perspective.

• Work with PPO QE, CME, IRT, DRE's during IV (Integration vehicle) builds, document all issues on Easel board and PRC/PRTS.

• Work closely with Vehicle Performance Engineers to ensure manufactured product is complying to the VTS and use their support as required for vehicle performance concerns identified.

• Effectively engage in IRT, VIRT meetings to drive all open Easel board, PRTS issues to closure at the earliest and call out issues that need help.

• Generate unique technical solutions applying 7 Diamonds Process, Red X and other tools as applicable.

• Work with suppliers and engineering to develop inspection standards for parts and subassemblies, address SPPS/PRR issues, and ensure robust countermeasures are implemented.

• Share lessons learned with Engineering & plants with similar products to prevent repeat design or build issues.

• Review of nonconforming parts and sub-assemblies for accurate initial disposition and root cause follow-up.

• Coordinate periodic system and process audits at the plant and at suppliers.

• Coordinate quality evaluation of new vehicles with engineering and production, as well as the engineering change implementation- TWO, EWO etc.

• Manage a clean transition of components with zero open item to continuous improvement after launch team release.

• Write/Audit Product Quality Standards (PQS).

• Support SCCT/PIR/OIR meetings for potential safety issues.

• Performance issue resolver at plant primarily for NVH, Wind noise & water leaks.

• Work Off-Shifts as required

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience in Automotive Engineering space

• Thorough understanding of welding, stamping, body framing & Exterior systems (Fascia, Moldings, Wiper & Washer System, Exterior Lighting), NVH, Wind & Water Performance

• Demonstrate ability to attain results, while balancing technical solutions with business imperatives (cost, mass, quality, performance)

• Must excel at problem solving – root cause, containment, robust long-term solutions

• Thorough understanding of GD&T (Geometric Dimension & Tolerance)

• Understanding of lean manufacturing concepts

• Thorough understanding and capacity to effectively operate in all areas of the launch and plant production process

• Advanced degree in Engineering.
• 5+ years in an Automotive Engineering space

jobs.description:
Job Description

About GM
We’re dedicated to achieving our vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion. We are looking for people who are passionate about helping us create safer, better and more sustainable solutions for personal mobility. Our bold vision won’t happen overnight, but just as we transformed how the world moved in the last century, we are committed to transforming how we move today and in the future.

Why Work for Us
Our culture is focused on building inclusive teams, where differences and unique perspectives are embraced so you can contribute to your fullest potential as you pursue your career. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open work spaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support our employees volunteer interests, and make it a priority to join efforts that give back to our communities
As we move towards GM’s vision of zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion, we are looking to add creative, dynamic individuals to our ET&E (Engines, Transmissions, and Electrification) team!
As a Design Release Engineer in the RESS Thermal Management Product Management Team (PMT), you will head up all activities for the Design, VDDV (Analysis), Development, Validation, and production implementation of cooling components (cold plates, cooling lines (metal and plastic) for one of the GM Products related to Propulsion. This could mean working on Internal Combustion engines or Batteries and Drive Units. By acting as the “CEO” of your parts/systems, your technical and project management skills will be key to the success of our current and future propulsion programs.
This position does not require you to be on-site full-time to perform effectively. This role enables you to work at a GM facility and off-site on a 60/40 time split.

Job Description
Responsible for specifying and balancing requirements, execution and evaluation of designs, analysis, development, testing and validation of major engineering projects where creativity and initiative are involved. Position also requires the ability to work with independent judgment with minimal input from supervisor. The broad scope of responsibilities covers one or more of the following: coolant pumps, coolant control valves, thermostats, and other key thermal components for Drive Units and Internal Combustion Engines. Exercise technical direction and collaboration over other engineers or engineering support personnel to meet specific engineering objectives. Capable of managing projects with high degree of difficulty. Actively engage both internal and supplier teams in issue resolution. Work cohesively with engineering peers responsible for similar components for other applications.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead overall communication, coordination, and consultation with engineering departments and customers
• Establish designs that meet program performance and timing requirements with compliance to BOM/BOP/BOD and serviceability requirements
• Balance requirements across systems
• Analyze designs through design failure modes effects analysis (DFMEA)
• Plan and implement complex test and/or development programs
• Demonstrate that designs meet requirements through analysis (VDDV), development and validation processes
• Represent business unit in vendor and/or customer contacts
• Release final designs for manufacturing or purchase as appropriate
• Conduct incident analysis and ensure problem resolution through PRTS+ system
• Implement engineering changes as required
• Participate in cost studies, product suggestions and value analysis
• Define hardware and budget requirements for experimental build programs
• Actively participate in product management team and leads product development team(s) as appropriate
• Support supplier quality assurance process
• Lead warranty issue resolution
• Participate in work groups with interactive/interfacing hardware/software teams as required
• Lead the overall execution of new RESS, Drive Unit and Internal Combustion Engine thermal and cooling components throughout the Global Powertrain Development Process (GPDP)
• Define hardware and budget requirements for experimental build programs
• Lead warranty issue resolution and cost/quality improvements with suppliers and in-house manufacturing
• Travel as required, domestic and international

Required Skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering required
• Minimum 4 years of Engineering experience
• Knowledge of propulsion systems and basic controls
• Appropriate interpersonal styles and communication methods to work effectively with business partners to meet mutual goals.
• Knowledge of computer software as it pertains to engineering
• High level of social skills to enable effective collaboration within a team environment and with all levels of the organization, both in person and remotely.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering preferred
• Master’s degree in Engineering is preferred
• DFSS Black Belt Certification
• Design Release experience with Propulsion based components
• 5 years of Engineering experience
• Comprehensive understanding of Product Engineering Tools/ Processes (ECM, TWO, GPDP, PRTS, DFMEA/PFMEA, P-Release, etc.)
• Cross-functional experience in Calibration, Manufacturing, Validation, VDDV, etc., with proven results and outstanding team-based achievements
• Prior experience in thermal components utilized in Drive Units, Batteries and Internal Combustion Engines

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Help define the future of flight at GE Aerospace! The Technical Manager will lead a Network Switch engineering team within the ION (Input/Output & Networking) organization. The team will deliver network switch products for civil and military platforms. The role supports the business and Application Engineering teams in defining a strategy for growth, drives continuous improvement of performance and processes, and ensures successful project execution that delivers value for the company and our customers.

This is a People Leader role for a new team of roughly 8–10 interdisciplinary engineers, including Subject Matter Experts, Systems Engineers, and project managers. It requires a talented individual who uses experience, knowledge, influence, and initiative to set strategy, build the team, manage competency development, and drive engineering execution excellence. The manager will lead daily execution, conduct performance reviews, and serve as the technical escalation point for the team. The role reports directly to the ION Section Manager with moderate autonomy and requires high levels of operational judgment.

This opportunity is bonus eligible. This position is based on-site in Grand Rapids, MI. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Lead a Network Switch Product engineering team to deliver engineering excellence across bids and proposals, program execution, product development, integration, verification, certification, and customer support.

• Sustain a team through workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and technical mentoring, establishing a healthy, inclusive, high-performing culture from program start.

• Drive execution of safety-critical avionics networking programs requiring compliance with DO-178C and DO-254, with particular emphasis on the rigor, planning, traceability, verification discipline, and cross-functional coordination expected in DAL A environments.

• Provide leadership for development and execution strategies covering requirements definition, system architecture, integration, verification, validation, certification support, and lifecycle planning for network switch products.

• Lead daily execution rhythms, including stand-ups and FLIGHT DECK Daily Management, and serve as the technical escalation point to speed decision-making and problem resolution.

• Manage the sub-section to achieve functional, business, and company objectives, including engineering planning, staffing, budgeting, culture development, process discipline, and execution excellence.

• Create and execute structured development plans for each team member, and conduct performance reviews with clear expectations and defined metrics.

• Partner closely with the Product Line Leader and Engineering Project Manager to balance multi-platform product line development with firm customer commitments.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, technical rigor, lean principles, and clear communication.

• Ensure engineering execution complies with internal engineering processes, customer contractual requirements, and applicable aerospace development and certification standards.

• Allocate qualified engineering resources and manage outsourced activities to meet project needs.

• Support reporting and escalation rhythms with clear communication, a firm understanding of status, active issue ownership, and disciplined risk and opportunity management.

• Hold teams accountable for delivering measurable results against Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) objectives.

• Assist project and program leadership in resolving engineering issues related to design, validation, integration, verification, safety, certification, closure, and field support.

• Develop influential working relationships with customers and stakeholders at multiple levels.

• Help define engineering strategies that differentiate GE Aerospace in the avionics networking market and strengthen the organization for the future.

• Bachelor’s degree in Aviation, Aerospace, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related technical field from an accredited college or university.

• Minimum of 8–10 years of systems engineering, embedded software, or technical/project leadership experience in a highly technical engineering environment, preferably in avionics or safety-critical aerospace applications.

• Demonstrated experience leading or supporting development of complex avionics, networking, or integrated hardware/software systems.

• Demonstrated experience working on programs governed by aerospace development and certification processes, including DO-178C.

• Strong ability to partner across matrixed organizations and drive alignment among engineering, program, business, and customer stakeholders.

Help define the future of flight at GE Aerospace! As Product Line Leader for Networking Products, you will own the technical vision and multi-platform architecture of GE Aerospace’s new ARINC 664 Network Switch Product Line. This strategic, internally developed product line supports a firm Commercial Aircraft commitment and positions GE Aerospace as a strategic networking partner for Next-Generation civil aircrafts through the 2040s.

You will serve as the Design Technical Authority (DTA) for the product line. In that role you will govern architecture decisions, the A664 technical baseline, and the DO-254/DO-178C certification approach, so that the product line is reusable, competitive, and certifiable across platforms. Early architecture decisions are foundational, and this role sets the direction the engineering team will build on through production.

This position is based on-site in Grand Rapids, MI. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates.

The specialist will work closely with the Customer Success team to support calculation sheets, account, asset, and opportunity validation, renewal pricing calculations, and the preparation of renewal proposals and related quoting information.

Acting as the site's Local Process Digital Authority, this role bridges factory operations and enterprise digital standards, partnering closely with DPE Global Process Digital Authorities, the Master Data Governance team, and site leadership to ensure digital solutions enable operational excellence locally.

Job Description

What will you do:

Digital Operations Leadership

• Serve as the site's Local Process Digital Authority for digital systems and processes across materials management, manufacturing operations, quality, and maintenance.
• Lead local deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement activities related to ERP, MES and other digital manufacturing systems and initiatives.
• Partner with site leadership to drive adoption of standardized business processes and digital solutions.
• Represent site operational requirements, risks, and opportunities within enterprise transformation programs, ensuring the site's voice is heard when global standards are defined or updated.

Digital Systems & Process Governance

• During deployment, serve as the site's primary resource for data conversion activities: validate legacy data against new system requirements, make practical decisions on data cleansing scope and prioritization, and own the classification and enrichment decisions needed to load accurate, usable data into the new system before go-live.
• Validate that global process designs, system configurations, and localization requirements support site operational needs across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance systems while maintaining compliance with enterprise standards.
• Partner with Global Process Digital Authorities and the Master Data Governance team to ensure process consistency, data integrity, and operational readiness throughout deployment and beyond.
• Support system testing, user acceptance activities, deployment readiness reviews, and go-live preparation. Maintain site governance tools, including process documentation and decision-support guides.

Capability Development & Operational Support

• Own the site digital systems capability strategy once systems are live, ensuring employees have the knowledge and skills required to operate effectively within standardized digital processes across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance.
• Lead the development and execution of role-based training programs for materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance teams, maintaining training curricula aligned with global standards.
• Serve as the primary functional escalation point for digital systems and user-support issues across all covered domains, distinguishing between a local training gap, a process gap, and a standard that needs updating, and routing each to the right resolution path.

Continuous Improvement & Cross-Site Collaboration

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, inventory management, production execution, and master data governance.

HITACHI HIGH-TECH AMERICA, INC.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE:                            Manager, Facilities & General Affairs       DIV/DEPARTMENT NAME:           (HTA) Corporate CSR/GA

REPORTS TO:                                  General Manager, Corporate Services, IT &                                               Sustainability

The pay ranges listed above are for each position’s base pay only.  This position may be eligible for other compensation including incentive pay and/or allowances.  Candidates will receive additional information during the interview and selection process.

POSITION SUMMARY

The position provides leadership and operational ownership of General Affairs (GA) functions across HTA, including facilities and workplace operations, building leases and capital projects, fleet management, mobile device programs, general insurance administration, security and janitorial services, and related corporate support activities.

This role is responsible for leading and developing the General Affairs team, establishing priorities, assigning work, managing workloads, setting performance expectations, and ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery across supported locations. The position requires a strong people leader who can balance strategic planning with hands-on operational management while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The position serves as a key business partner to management and works closely with internal departments, Legal, vendors, contractors, landlords, and other external partners. While the role has company-wide responsibilities, it serves as the primary General Affairs and facilities leadership contact for the Oregon location.

A key expectation of the role is to continually evaluate how General Affairs services are delivered, identifying opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology and automation, optimize costs, strengthen controls, and enhance the employee and workplace experience.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership and Team Management:

·       Provide leadership and direction to General Affairs staff, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, service expectations, and performance standards.

·       Assign and prioritize work, manage team workloads and resources, and ensure consistent service delivery across supported locations and functions.

·       Coach, mentor, and develop employees to strengthen capabilities, encourage professional growth, and build organizational depth and succession readiness.

·       Establish individual and team objectives, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and manage employee performance in accordance with company policies and management practices.

·       Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, responsiveness, innovation, and continuous improvement.

·       Partner with management and internal business groups to understand evolving business requirements and align GA resources and services with organizational priorities.

Building Leases, Workplace Planning & Capital Projects:

·       Own and manage the General Affairs aspects of the company’s building lease portfolio, including lease administration, service and maintenance agreements, and coordination with Legal and other stakeholders.

·       Lead facility projects from initial business requirements and planning through design, construction, commissioning, and employee move-in.

·       Coordinate space planning, workplace layouts, facility modifications, expansions, schedules, budgets, and related project requirements.

·       Develop and review project cost estimates, budgets, invoices, schedules, specifications, contracts, subcontracts, and related documentation.

·       Manage project scope, cost, schedule, risks, vendors, and stakeholder communication to support successful project execution.

·       Establish and maintain effective relationships with landlords, architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

Facilities, Security & Workplace Operations:

·       Provide oversight and operational leadership for company facilities, ensuring office buildings, workplace systems, and related services are effectively maintained.

·       Ensure preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facility service requirements are completed in a timely and effective manner.

·       Oversee building and office security operations, including third-party security providers and building access requirements.

·       Manage emergency facility repairs, alarms, and other building-related incidents, coordinating insurance notification or escalation when required.

·       Oversee external contractors and service providers to ensure performance against contractual requirements and applicable safety, security, and regulatory requirements.

·       Coordinate with Hitachi laboratory and cleanroom support teams regarding building mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and related facility requirements.

Oversee outsourced security and janitorial services supporting HTA locations and monitor service quality, cost, and vendor performance.

Fleet & Driver Programs:

·       Own the administration and operational management of the company leased-vehicle program, including policies, procedures, leasing, deployment, billing, budgeting, and vendor relationships.

·       Negotiate fleet-related agreements and identify opportunities to improve service levels and optimize fleet costs.

·       Provide guidance to employees concerning vehicle ordering, lease terms, costs, policies, maintenance, and program requirements.

·       Oversee the Driver Safety Program and annual motor vehicle record requirements for employees with company vehicles or applicable vehicle allowances.

·       Coordinate response to employee vehicle accidents, provide guidance and follow-up, and work with the corporate risk team on related claims.

Mobile Device Program:

·       Manage the company mobile phone program, including service delivery, administration, policies, and program requirements.

·       Coordinate policy and program changes and identify opportunities to improve service, controls, employee experience, and cost efficiency.

General Insurance & Risk Support:

·       Coordinate day-to-day general insurance activities, including certificates of insurance, claims follow-up, incident reporting, and related inquiries working closely with the HTA Credit & Risk Team.

·       Work with internal stakeholders, insurance providers, and the corporate risk team to ensure insurance-related requirements and incidents are addressed in a timely manner.

·       Maintain appropriate documentation and follow-up for insurance matters within the scope of General Affairs.

Financial Management, Purchasing & Controls:

jobs.description:
Function

Our Company

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks ­– can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Meet our Team

The Revenue Performance Organization in Controllership is a dynamic, stakeholder and customer-oriented team in Finance that works with sales and services on customer contracts, orders, and structures and manages these deals from Quote to Cash with specialization in revenue recognition. We value business-focus while ensuring that we meet compliance and revenue standards under IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards). We collaborate with legal, logistics, FP&A, broader controllership, change management, shared services, and audit associates.

What you will be doing

In this role, you will perform repeatable transactional order processing, financial, and contract review of order intake with ownership for the end-to-end processing of complex Customer arrangements that may involve non-standard complex commercial terms.

You will support sales campaigns in the Opportunity, Quote and Order phases and engage with Hitachi Vantara Sales and external Customers, as necessary. The key responsibilities of this role will involve transactional analysis, order processing and revenue recognition of Product and Services engagements that involve commercial terms, deal structuring, Tenders & RFP (Request for Proposal) responses, quotes and orders for proper accounting and adherence to Company Policies. You will have opportunities to collaborate with Global Revenue Performance colleagues to achieve consistent best practices and judgement.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

jobs.title: VRO Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

In the Value Realization Office at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in ensuring that our customers achieve and maximize the tangible business outcomes promised in their digital transformation journeys. You will act as the strategic driver behind establishing, measuring, and protecting value across complex IT outsourcing, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and large-scale infrastructure engagements post-contract signature.

In this role, you will define and execute the VRO operating model from the ground up, establishing governance cadences, RACI frameworks, and executive escalation paths tailored to each engagement. You will partner closely with client finance and operations leaders to rigorously construct and validate operational baselines, translating overarching deal cases into transparent, actionable benefits registers equipped with defined KPIs, milestones, and auditable proof points.

Your financial acumen and analytical rigor will be central to defining robust measurement models for hard cost savings, risk and cost avoidance, productivity uplift, and service quality enhancements. By designing automated scorecards and dashboards, tracking realized gains, and diagnosing root causes behind value leakage or process drift, you will keep critical customer engagements on course. Furthermore, you will lead high-impact value reviews with C-suite stakeholders and Kyndryl account executives, turning proven realized value into a catalyst for account renewals, expansion, and long-term client advocacy.

Key Responsibilities

• VRO Governance & Operating Model: Establish and lead the VRO governance framework across major IT outsourcing and transformation accounts, including meeting cadences, RACI matrices, roles, and escalation workflows.
• Baseline Validation & Benefits Architecture: Partner directly with client finance and operational teams to construct baseline metrics; convert complex deal value propositions into operational benefits registers with designated owners, timing, and verifiable evidence standards.
• Value Modeling & Auditable Tracking: Define rigorous measurement methodologies for hard savings, cost avoidance, operational productivity, and service quality; maintain financial models (TCO, ROI, payback periods) and establish auditable evidence trails for formal sign-offs.
• Executive Reviews & Leakage Mitigation: Facilitate monthly and quarterly value realization reviews with C-level client executives and Kyndryl leadership; identify root causes of value leakage (e.g., scope creep, process drift, delayed adoption) and enforce recovery action plans.
• Analytics & Tooling: Build dynamic value dashboards and scorecards using Power BI or equivalent platforms to deliver single-pane visibility into target versus realized gains.
• Cross-Functional Synergy & Practice Growth: Collaborate with delivery and Organizational Change Management (OCM) leads to tie workforce adoption metrics to benefit realization; coach VRO analysts and package frameworks into standardized practice IP.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Kyndryl’s mission to modernize enterprise IT and drive business transformation means that within the Value Realization Office, you will be positioned at the vital intersection of technology, finance, and client strategy. You will lead high-profile transformation initiatives, mentor and direct VRO analysts across concurrent engagements, and actively contribute to building reusable assets, benchmark repositories, and measurement standards that scale across our global practice.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You are good at what you do and possess the proven consulting and financial depth to prove it. You bring a growth mindset, navigating complex transformation headwinds with clarity and decisive problem-solving. You are relentlessly customer-focused—committed to ensuring our clients see verifiable return on investment and financial transparency. Finally, you are empathetic, collaborative, and borderless, partnering seamlessly across organizational change management (OCM), delivery, and executive teams to build trust and achieve shared success.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred.
• 12+ years in consulting, transformation, or managed services, with at least 5 years leading benefits realization, value management, or financial tracking on large engagements.
• Proven experience building baselines, KPI frameworks, and benefits registers that have held up under client finance scrutiny.
• Strong financial modeling skills covering TCO, ROI, and payback, with working knowledge of IT outsourcing commercial structures.
• Track record presenting value results to client executives and managing difficult conversations about shortfalls.
• Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt preferred.

The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is -

$143,640 to $273,000 based on a full-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting.

Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California (San Francisco Bay Area): $172,440 to $327,600

California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360

Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000

Massachusetts/ Virginia: $143,640 to $300,360

New York City: $172,440 to $327,600

Washington: $158,040 to $300,360

Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

• Build and lead presentations with suppliers and merchants to support strategic plans and analyze execution

jobs.title: Merchandising Service Associate - Plant Service Lead
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Always provide SMART customer service through the daily execution of Lowe's customer service policies, procedures, and programs.

• Build relationships with vendors by providing direction and checking to ensure merchandise resets are completed according to Lowe’s specifications.

• Collaborate with the Merchandising Service team and Manager by communicating project priorities, schedule, and project needs (e.g., materials, supplies, time)

• Although most of the time will be spent in activities that do not involve the direct interaction with customers, the individual in this role is expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. This includes:

• Understand customers’ needs and assists in locating, demonstrating, selecting, carrying, and/or loading merchandise.

• Engage with customers to understand his/her needs and assists in locating, demonstrating, selecting, carrying, and/or loading merchandise.

• Listen to and responds knowledgeably and promptly to customer questions, taking them to areas of the store when necessary.

• Demonstrate sincere appreciation to customers.

• Communicate information to customers regarding all stock, special order merchandise, feature benefits, application, and warranty information related to Lowe’s programs.

• Empty plant racks onto plant tables merchandising by planogram, price, and color block as they arrive.

• Identify damaged or missing signage, displays, collateral and orders replacements in accordance with merchandising standards and planogram details.

• Update/validate wayfinding and product location signage as well as digital maintenance of this information throughout the store.

• Ensure cross merchandise, side stack products, j-hooks and gravity feed bins are placed appropriately, helping to drive add-on sales.

• Assist with culling and pricing dead and distressed plants.

• Maintain a high level of communication and partnership with MSM and red vest associates.

• Identify and communicate issues with quality, quantity, and additional needs to Outside Garden Supervisor and MSM.

• Adjust fixtures, rotates stock, displays products and support materials using power equipment (e.g., lifts, order pickers) per service expectations and processes.

• Review, complete, and enter completion details (when, what, amount of time spent, taking and uploading photographs to confirm servicing completion, etc.) for all assigned service and maintenance tasks.

• Ensure all displays are safe and in working order and repaired/replaced as needed.

• Repair/seal damaged packaging and boxes including peg-hook items.

• Remove all trash, moves cardboard boxes to the bailer and moves plastic wrap and other debris to the compactor.

• Replace light bulbs and alerts the appropriate contact when additional maintenance issues are noted (lights out, painting, etc.).

• Detect common signs of shoplifting, theft, and other security risks, and promptly communicates them to management and/or Asset Protection.

jobs.title: Cash Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Cash Portfolio Manager
Investment Management

Boston, MA

The Opportunity

MassMutual is seeking a highly motivated, solution-oriented investment professional to join MassMutual Investment Management’s Fixed Income Portfolio Management team. In this newly created role, you will optimize cash in portfolios for MassMutual’s $250 billion General Investment Account (GIA) by partnering with internal investment teams and outside investment managers to fund investments, reduce cash drag, minimize overdrafts and keep portfolio cash percentages within predefined targets.  The new function will operate in the Aladdin platform. The role will have front and middle office functions as part of the daily responsibilities.

The Team

The Fixed Income Portfolio Management (FIPM) team is responsible for asset allocation, fundamental credit underwriting and monitoring, ESG investment strategy, and macroeconomic research. FIPM is a small, highly collaborative team that works with partners across Investment Management to manage the product segment portfolios within the GIA. The team combines fundamental investment analysis and asset allocation skills with quantitative and asset/liability management expertise. This high-profile group works across Investment Management and with internal stakeholders in product, actuarial, treasury, accounting, risk, legal, compliance, and other areas.

The Impact

• Lead the build of the Cash Portfolio Management function utilizing the Aladdin platform, including the design, processes, workflows and proceduresRole will be critical in defining the architecture of the short-term cash ecosystem, including workflows, cash and allocation processes, etc
• Accountable for decisions related to MassMutual’s investment cash position; directly impacting financial results (cash yield) as well as and reportable cash for investment managers to make investment decisions
• Accountable for the daily monitoring of cash balances to cash targets and overdrafts via the Aladdin cash Ladder, including Transferring cash and rebalancing portfolios as needed to maintain cash targetsAs required, transfer cash to prefund investments executed by the outside investment managers, requiring extensive communication and collaboration across the broader MassMutual organization and asset managersBuild trade orders to strategically invest cash balances across a complex portfolio structureFor non-dollar investments, coordinate cash movements to ensure settlements of investments and hedges
• Within guardrails, execute small (less than $1MM USD) cleanup SPOT FXs
• As part of enterprise asset liability process, work closely with other leaders in the organization, including Treasury Operations, Liquidity Management, Portfolio Management, Quantitative Portfolio Management, etc. treasury and liability management to update Aladdin with liability forecasts as required. These decisions impact the profitability and risk of the underlying portfolios
• For large volumes of cash movements, build and execute Aladdin Application Programing Interface (APIs) to quasi automate; this accountability requires close coordination with leaders in the Treasury area, Portfolio Managers, external custodians; and outside asset managers
• Maintain cash targets and other Aladdin configuration
• Measure Portfolio performance via key risk indicators (KRI)

The Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree
• 7+ years of relevant experience within institutional investment management, asset management, treasury, portfolio management, trading, investment operations, or a related investment function
• Hands-on experience working with BlackRock Aladdin within an investment environment

The Ideal Qualifications

• 10+ years of investment experience, including 5+ years of meaningful cash, liquidity, or short-term portfolio management experience
• Deep expertise in Aladdin, ideally including cash ladders, cash management, portfolio/account structures, configuration, investment workflows, or platform implementation/transformation
• Prior experience building, transforming, or materially enhancing a cash-management function, investment operating model, or related investment infrastructure
• Experience managing cash across complex portfolio, account, legal-entity, or insurance investment structures
• Insurance General Account investment experience or experience within a similarly complex institutional asset-owner environment
• Experience with G7/multi-currency cash management, FX activity, and non-USD investment settlement
• Strong knowledge of custody-bank cash operations and interaction with external asset managers and custodians
• Experience with Bloomberg, advanced Excel, and API-enabled workflow/process automation
• MBA, CFA designation, or other relevant advanced degree or professional credential
• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a high-pressure, highly collaborative environment requiring strong attention to detail, controls, and execution

What You Can Expect at MassMutual

MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:

• Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes A collaborative environment where perspectives are welcomed Access to learning, development, and internal networks that support continuous growth and skill-building over time Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion across the organization A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship—supported by a company with a strong legacy and a future-focused mindset

jobs.description:

Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Huningue, France

Relocation Support: This role is based in Huningue, France. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Bring your biotech and data expertise to the heart of biopharmaceutical manufacturing. As a Biotech Engineer/PAT Specialist, you will take a leading technical role in developing and implementing Process Analytical Technologies (PAT) for real-time analytics and process control. You will apply your experience in biotech processes,Multivariate Data Analysis (MVDA) and statistical process control to turn complex process data into practical solutions for manufacturing. Working with automation engineers, process experts and scientists, you will help implement data-driven tools that strengthen decision-making and improve manufacturing efficiency.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Implement high-throughput approaches for real-time bioprocess monitoring and optimization, leveraging automation, online analytics and advanced data analysis.
• Lead technology development and continuous improvement initiatives supporting process intensification.
• Develop and deploy spectroscopy-based Process Analytical Technology methods, including Raman and dielectric spectroscopies.
• Support the implementation of innovative technologies that advance manufacturing processes and operational performance.
• Interpret spectral data and establish secure data management and analysis procedures aligned with Good Manufacturing Practice requirements.
• Apply multivariate data analysis methods for model development, validation and ongoing maintenance.
• Partner with Production, , Engineering and Automation teams to integrate new technologies in commercial manufacturing processes
• Analyze and communicate complex datasets through clear technical reports and presentations to support informed decision-making.

Essential Requirements

• University degree in Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific field.
• 2–5 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with practical experience in biotechnology processes.
• Strong knowledge of advanced statistical methods and Multivariate Data Analysis, applied within a biotechnology environment.
• Proven experience with cell culture and/or purification processes, including process scale-up and scale-down.
• Experience working with complex process and spectral datasets, including developing, validating and interpreting data models.
• Good understanding of the pharmaceutical regulatory environment, including Good Manufacturing Practices, Quality Assurance, Quality Control and International Council for Harmonisation guidelines.
• Fluent English, with strong communication, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience with Raman spectroscopy or other spectroscopy-based Process Analytical Technology methods.
• Experience with online biomass monitoring or related real-time bioprocess analytical technologies.
• Previous experience with technology integration in GMP environments is a plus.

Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid

Internal title: REP Lead Americas

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives and this starts with attracting the best talent. As the Recruitment Experience Partner (REP) Americas Regional Lead, you will lead, empower, and develop a high-performing Recruitment Experience Partner (REP) team to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes across the region.

You will shape how we attract talent at scale, drive consistent excellence in recruitment processes, and partner closely with Recruitment Business Partners (RBPs) Teams to anticipate business needs and solve future workforce challenges.

This is a role for a collaborative talent leader who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment, balancing strong leadership of the regional REP team with close partnership across the global Recruitment Solutions organization. You will work closely with peer Regional REP Leads based in Prague and Hyderabad, and the global REP leader based in Dublin, helping to ensure alignment, consistency and shared ways of working across regions.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop the regional REP team to deliver high-quality, high-volume recruitment outcomes.
• Drive capacity and performance management, ensuring effective workload allocation, prioritization, and achievement of hiring targets.
• Build a high-performing team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and excellence.
• Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, performance metrics, automation, and AI-enabled recruitment solutions.
• Develop a forward-looking regional recruitment strategy, translating future business demand into clear capacity, capability, and talent pipeline plans.
• Leverage data, market intelligence, and hiring trends to anticipate risks, identify opportunities, and continuously improve recruitment delivery.
• Build strong partnerships with Recruitment Business Partners and global Recruitment Solutions teams, connecting regional business needs with global priorities and best practices.
• Ensure outstanding end-to-end recruitment delivery, including senior and critical hiring, proactive sourcing, candidate management, and proactive mitigation of delivery risks.

Essential Requirements

• 8+ years’ experience in recruitment, either within an agency or in-house talent acquisition team.

• Minimum 3+ years’ recent experience leading a sizable recruitment team across a region or globally.

• Demonstrated ability to lead regional teams while operating effectively within a global, matrixed organization.

• Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior stakeholders and peers across countries, cultures and time zones.
• Knowledge of the US market would be an advantage.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

jobs.description:

Job Description Summary

#LI-Onsite

Locatie: Puurs, België

Ondersteuning bij relocatie: Deze functie is gevestigd in Puurs, België. Novartis kan geen ondersteuning bieden bij relocatie; solliciteer daarom alleen als de locatie voor u bereikbaar is.

Wat als jouw wetenschappelijke expertise ervoor kan zorgen dat patiënten de geneesmiddelen krijgen waarop ze vertrouwen, precies op het moment dat ze die het hardst nodig hebben?

Als QC Specialist II - Aseptic Processing speel je een belangrijke rol in het bewaken van productkwaliteit en patiëntveiligheid. Je doet dit via laboratoriumtesten, wetenschappelijke onderzoeken en het opvolgen van aseptische processen. Je genereert, beoordeelt en interpreteert belangrijke analytische data en helpt zo garanderen dat elk product voldoet aan hoge normen voor kwaliteit, compliance en betrouwbaarheid voordat het bij de patiënt terechtkomt.

In deze rol werk je op het kruispunt van laboratoriumwetenschap, kwaliteit en productie. Je gebruikt je wetenschappelijke kennis om complexe uitdagingen aan te pakken, contaminatiecontrole te versterken en laboratorium- en aseptische processen continu te verbeteren. Jouw impact gaat dus verder dan het lab: je draagt rechtstreeks bij aan de betrouwbare levering van levensveranderende geneesmiddelen aan patiënten wereldwijd.

Job Description

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

• Afhandeling van OOx/deviaties, definiëren van CAPA’s en opvolgen van KPI-trends
• Ervoor zorgen dat alle activiteiten voldoen aan cGxP, inclusief data-integriteitscontrole en goedkeuring van analytische data/tests (analytische vrijgave) en stabiliteit
• Stabiliteitstesten binnen projecten: opstellen van protocollen, evaluaties en rapporten
• Rapportage, waaronder het opstellen van stabiliteitsplannen, trendanalyses en evaluaties
• Uitvoeren van stabiliteitsstudies, protocollen en vergelijkende rapporten voor leverancierskwalificatie
• Beoordelen en goedkeuren van analytische testen (analytische vrijgave)
• Microbiologische QC: uitvoeren van microbiologische testen op materialen en utilities, evenals omgevings- en personeelsmonitoring
• Bieden van deskundige ondersteuning bij kwalificatie- en validatieactiviteiten op de site
• Onderhouden en kalibreren van apparatuur, inclusief het opstellen van plannen
• Ondersteunen bij leverancierskwalificatie
• Opvolgen en analyseren van KPI’s/KQI’s
• Ondersteunen bij monsterplanning en uitvoering van monstername
• Rapporteren van technische klachten, bijwerkingen en bijzondere situaties met betrekking tot Novartis-producten binnen 24 uur na ontvangst
• Verspreiden van marketingmonsters, indien van toepassing

Belangrijkste prestatie-indicatoren:

• De relevante KPI’s die binnen de Quality Control-afdelingen zijn gedefinieerd, zijn van toepassing, bijvoorbeeld analytische doorlooptijden
• Tijdige en GMP-conforme analyse en documentatie van de resultaten
• Foutpercentage: aantal OOS-resultaten als gevolg van analysefouten in verhouding tot het aantal analyses
• Geen klachten naar aanleiding van officiële inspecties
• Individuele prestaties worden beoordeeld via de PMP-performance dialoog samen met de manager

Essentiële vereisten:

• Bachelordiploma in Farmaceutische Laboratoriumtechnologie, Microbiologie, Biotechnologie, Chemie of een andere relevante wetenschappelijke richting
• Relevante ervaring in een farmaceutisch laboratorium of een vergelijkbare gereguleerde laboratorium- of kwaliteitsomgeving
• Ervaring met analytische vrijgave, stabiliteitstesten, microbiologische testen, omgevingsmonitoring of testen van utilities
• Kennis van aseptische verwerking, contaminatiecontrole, omgevingsmonitoring en laboratoriumactiviteiten
• Ervaring met het onderzoeken van deviaties en het definiëren van effectieve corrigerende en preventieve maatregelen
• Vermogen om wetenschappelijke data te interpreteren, trends te identificeren en nauwkeurige protocollen en technische rapporten op te stellen
• Kennis van actuele Good Manufacturing Practice-vereisten, principes rond data-integriteit en beoordeling van analytische data
• Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, met goede vaardigheden op het gebied van planning, samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement

Wat je van ons kan verwachten

Een open bedrijfsklimaat en een stimulerende bedrijfscultuur. Kansen om jezelf te ontplooien en je kennis te verruimen op diverse domeinen. In Puurs bieden we je een aangepaste omkadering om het fysieke en mentale welzijn van onze collega’s te bevorderen. Zo hebben we onder andere een fietslease programma, een lokale fitness die onze werknemers kunnen gebruiken en is er een mental coach aanwezig op de site.

Benefits & Verloning

Bij Novartis zetten we ons in om samen de geneeskunde van morgen vorm te geven – en om de mensen die dit mogelijk maken passend te waarderen en te belonen.

Verwachte jaarlijkse basissalarisrange voor deze functie:

Total Base Pay Range: 47,100.00 - 67,300.00 - 87,500.00 EUR

Het aangeboden basissalaris wordt vastgesteld op basis van objectieve en gederneutrale criteria, zoals relevante vaardigheden, competenties en ervaring, in overeenstemming met het beloningsbeleid van Novartis. Na indiensttreding wordt het salaris periodiek geëvalueerd.

Naast het basissalaris kun je, afhankelijk van vooraf bepaalde prestatiecriteria, in aanmerking komen voor een prestatiegerichte bonus.

De voordelen van werken bij Novartis gaan echter veel verder dan alleen salaris en bonussen. Wij bieden een uitgebreid pakket aan secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden om je zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ondersteunen, waaronder verzekeringen, pensioenregelingen, welzijnsprogramma’s en wereldwijde erkenningsprogramma’s.

Inzet voor diversiteit & inclusie:

Novartis omarmt diversiteit, gelijke kansen en inclusie. We zijn toegewijd aan het opzetten van diverse teams, die een weerspiegeling zijn van de patiënten en gemeenschappen die we ondersteunen, we streven ernaar een inclusieve werkplaats te creëren die innovatie triggert door samenwerking en onze mensen in staat stelt hun volledige potentieel te ontketenen.

jobs.description:
Job Description & Summary

PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement.

Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences.

Ce que nous recherchons ?  Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble.

Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.

Votre équipe :

Notre Business Unit Compliance regroupe près de 300 collaborateurs autour des métiers de l’Expertise Comptable et de l’Externalisation de la Paie.

L’Expertise Comptable chez PwC c’est plus particulièrement 130 personnes, dont plus de 20% d’experts-comptables diplômés qui co-construisent des solutions sur-mesure grâce à une approche collaborative unique, véritable marque de fabrique de PwC.

Nous intervenons dans un environnement digital auprès de nos clients avec une forte dimension internationale.

Vos missions :

• Être quotidiennement au cœur de la relation client, dans un environnement international
• Gérer en autonomie l’organisation des missions : planifier, superviser la réalisation des travaux de votre équipe sur des missions d’Expertise Comptable tels que la préparation des états financiers, l’établissement des déclarations fiscales, la préparation de reporting périodiques, les missions de compilation, le passage des normes étrangères aux normes françaises, etc.
• Vous positionner en tant que référent technique sur les missions de votre portefeuille
• Interagir avec les autres équipes de PwC (Consulting, PwC Société d’Avocats) pour porter une offre globale de services innovants
• Encadrer et accompagner les collaborateurs plus juniors dans le développement de leurs compétences
• En parallèle, participer au développement du cabinet en intégrant des équipes projets (formation, amélioration des process, IT, etc)

La pluridisciplinarité de notre réseau vous aidera à optimiser votre approche conseil.

Nous assurons le développement de vos compétences techniques et managériales au travers d’un parcours de formation dédié et évolutif selon le grade.

Votre profil :

• Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation Bac+5 avec une spécialisation Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA, ou École de Commerce)
• Vous avez au moins 3 années d'expérience dans un environnement similaire
• Vous avez une expérience en encadrement de collaborateurs
• Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral et idéalement une seconde langue (allemand ou chinois)
• Vous faites preuve de rigueur, de curiosité, d’adaptabilité et d’esprit d’initiative

Vos avantages :

• Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain.
• Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu.
• Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour.
• Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap).

Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.

Notre processus de recrutement :

Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes :

1.         Évaluation en ligne avec un test d’anglais

2.         Entretien RH

3.         Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique)

4.         Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV

Vuoi guidare operazioni straordinarie che supportano la crescita e la trasformazione di aziende, imprenditori e investitori?

Nel team Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) di PwC Advisory Corporate Finance, avrai l'opportunità di lavorare su operazioni di acquisizione, cessione, raccolta di capitali e altre transazioni strategiche, affiancando clienti nazionali e internazionali nei momenti più significativi del loro percorso di crescita.

Il team M&A supporta aziende, gruppi industriali e fondi di Private Equity lungo l'intero ciclo di vita di una transazione, dall'origination all'execution, attraverso attività di analisi strategica e finanziaria, valutazione d'impresa, coordinamento della due diligence, negoziazione e closing. In un contesto dinamico e internazionale, collaborerai con professionisti specializzati nelle diverse aree della Corporate Finance e del network PwC globale.

Come Manager, avrai un ruolo chiave nella gestione delle operazioni di M&A e nella relazione con clienti e stakeholder, coordinando i team di progetto e lavorando a stretto contatto con Director e Partner.

In particolare, ti occuperai di:

• Gestire in autonomia l’execution di operazioni di M&A buy-side e sell-side, assicurando il coordinamento delle diverse fasi del processo.
• Coordinare e revisionare lo sviluppo di modelli finanziari, analisi valutative e business plan.
• Supervisionare la predisposizione della documentazione di marketing e di processo, tra cui teaser, information memorandum e management presentation.

• Gestire direttamente le interazioni con clienti, investitori, fondi di Private Equity, advisor legali e finanziari, diventando un punto di riferimento operativo durante l’intero processo.

• Supportare Director e Partner nella gestione delle relazioni con clienti e stakeholder strategici e nello sviluppo del network

.

Cerchiamo professionisti con una solida esperienza in Corporate Finance e M&A, in grado di gestire con crescente autonomia operazioni complesse, coordinare team di progetto e costruire relazioni solide con clienti e stakeholder.
